items.title: 美中半導體設備攻防長期化！美智庫稱中國囤343台DUV、日媒指陸廠靠ASML設備庫存爭取時間
items.title_en: U.S.-China Semiconductor Equipment Conflict Becomes Prolonged: U.S. Think Tank Says China Has Stockpiled 343 DUV Machines, Japanese Media Says Chinese Foundries Rely on ASML Inventory to Buy Time
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，中國大陸半導體製造企業在美國與荷蘭出口管制下，仍以個案審批、既有庫存與國產研發「兩條腿走路」推進光刻能力。
綜合美國智庫報告、《南華早報》及《日經亞洲》相關報導，外界估算中國目前取得的浸沒式深紫外(DUV)光刻機合計約343台，其中約270台為艾司摩爾(ASML)Twinscan NXT:1980i，這批設備雖非極紫外(EUV)，但配合多重曝光已可支撐7奈米邏輯、先進記憶體與AI加速器量產，並為中國國產整機研發爭取緩衝期。
根據華府智庫「技術與中國國家安全中心」(CTS)報告，截至今年初，中國晶圓廠透過管制缺口取得共343台浸沒式DUV，其中艾司摩爾 NXT:1980i約270台。
2024年，中國花費超過130億美元採購90台NXT:1980i，2025年再增購89台，其餘為更早取得或其他合規型號。荷蘭自2019年起應美國要求禁售EUV，但NXT:1980i等較先進浸沒式機型初期仍得以個案審批出口；CTS認為，這是中國得以持續擴充中高階產能的關鍵。
浸沒式DUV在鏡頭與晶圓間注水提升折射率，解析度低於EUV但高於乾式DUV；透過多重曝光重疊線路層，可用於7奈米級邏輯、高階NAND/DRAM及AI晶片。
報告指出，華為昇騰等加速器即依此路線量產。CTS預測，若中國每年維持引進90台NXT:1980i，至2035年年產輝達H100等級AI晶片可達4.34億顆。若自2027年起全面切斷新機進口，同等級產能將降至約1.53億顆。
美國商務部出口管制官員Nicholas Brown與白宮前技術政策顧問Saif Khan因此在報告中呼籲，對浸沒式DUV、低溫蝕刻等一併實施全面封鎖。
美國國會今年4月提出《MATCH法案》，要求荷蘭、日本等盟國150天內擴大對中國設備限制，範圍由EUV延伸至先進DUV與部分蝕刻、量測設備。報告顯示，華府正把管制重心由「禁止最先進」轉向「堵中國先進」。
《日經亞洲》亦報導指出，中國企業確實全力投入國產光刻，但短期仍須依賴ASML成熟機台。光刻機並非單一零件，而是光源、物鏡、工件台、浸潤、計算光刻與控制軟體的系統工程。193奈米浸沒式需ArF光源、高精度投影物鏡、雙工件台與水膜穩定；EUV更涉及13.5奈米雷射等離子光源、真空反射鏡組與極複雜計算光刻。
國際半導體微影技術與計算光學領域享譽盛名的Andreas Erdmann曾說，機械、電子、化學、數學與計算必須協同，才有機會讓整機穩定運行，這也是全球僅ASML、尼康、佳能具整機能力的原因。
ASML優勢在整合全球頂級供應鏈，而尼康、佳能較多自研自產，卻未完全接軌國際分工，先進度被拉開。
中國早期乾式DUV最高約90奈米，而2024年工信部公告新型乾式DUV，鏡頭解析度達65奈米，今年王陽元、陳南翔等產業報告則指出，中國國產浸沒式DUV已完成研發並進入測試；另有外媒稱中國在政府支持下自行組裝DUV系統，去年底曾傳EUV原型機，引發全球晶片股波動，但相關進度尚未獲獨立量產驗證。
日本專家指出，既有的ASML庫存讓中國晶圓廠維持產能與現金流，同時在光源、物鏡、工件台、計算光刻各子系統分頭攻關；「能造整機」與「可替代ASML量產」是兩回事，良率、產能、穩定運行與軟體生態仍需年限。
ASML財報曾顯示中國一度佔其營收約41%，隨著管制收緊，公司預期2026年中國佔比降至約兩成。
中國策略是合規採購DUV保產能、自研整機保長期：先以NXT:1980i與其他浸沒機支援7奈米與儲存擴產，再以國產乾式、浸沒式逐步切入成熟與中階先進線。
除光刻機外，美國分析師稱中國在蝕刻、沉積、清洗、量測等大多設備領域進步明顯。中微、北方華創、盛美、拓荆、華海清科、中科飛測等已進入部分產線；日本設備業者擔心，若中國光刻突破，材料、沉積、量測將連帶國產化，衝擊東京電子、Screen等出口。
南韓媒體亦報導指出，三星、SK海力士因美國限制其在中國的合資廠採購先進設備，已評估採用中微等中國蝕刻與部分製程設備，顯示替代由「非光刻」向更廣設備圈擴散。
整體來看，343台浸沒式DUV與持續採購，使中國在中長期AI晶片、7奈米邏輯與先進儲存上具中端自主能力；若美國推動DUV全面封鎖，2027年後新增產能將受抑，但存量機台、多重曝光與國產機試製可維持基本盤。中國國產光刻機的變數不在理論路線，而在整機穩定性、產出吞吐量、缺陷密度與供應鏈協同。
分析人士認為，美國出口管制短期拖慢中國先進化，長期卻把中國市場讓給本土設備商，加速全鏈替代；若中國國產浸沒式量產、EUV原型轉商用，ASML壟斷溢價與全球晶片定價邏輯都可能重估。半導體設備競爭正由「賣機台」轉為「系統整合與產能自主」的持久戰。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Chinese mainland semiconductor manufacturers, despite U.S. and Dutch export controls, are advancing lithography capability through case‑by‑case approvals, existing inventory and domestic R&D – a two‑track approach.

Based on U.S. think‑tank reports, the South China Morning Post and Nikkei Asia, analysts estimate China now possesses roughly 343 immersion deep‑ultraviolet (DUV) lithography tools, about 270 of which are ASML Twinscan NXT:1980i units. Although not extreme‑ultraviolet (EUV), these machines can, with multiple‑exposure techniques, support volume production of 7‑nm logic, advanced memory and AI accelerators, giving China a buffer for domestic full‑system development.

According to the Washington‑based Center for Technology and National Security (CTS) report, by early this year Chinese wafer fabs have obtained a total of 343 immersion DUV tools through regulatory loopholes, including about 270 ASML NXT:1980i units.

In 2024 China spent more than $13 billion to buy 90 NXT:1980i machines and plans to purchase another 89 in 2025, with the remainder coming from earlier acquisitions or other compliant models. The Netherlands has banned EUV sales since 2019 at U.S. request, but the more advanced immersion models like the NXT:1980i were still allowed to leave on a case‑by‑case basis; CTS says this has been key for China to keep expanding its mid‑to‑high‑end capacity.

Immersion DUV injects water between the lens and wafer to raise the refractive index, offering resolution lower than EUV but higher than dry DUV. By overlapping multiple exposures, it can pattern 7‑nm‑class logic, high‑end NAND/DRAM and AI chips.

The report notes that Huawei’s Ascend accelerators are already being mass‑produced using this route. CTS projects that if China continues to import 90 NXT:1980i units per year, by 2035 it could produce AI chips comparable to Nvidia H100 at a rate of 434 million units annually; cutting off new imports from 2027 would reduce that capacity to about 153 million units.

U.S. Commerce Department export‑control official Nicholas Brown and former White House technology adviser Saif Khan call in the report for a comprehensive ban on immersion DUV, low‑temperature etch and related equipment.

In April the U.S. Congress introduced the MATCH Act, demanding that allies such as the Netherlands and Japan expand equipment restrictions on China within 150 days, extending the scope from EUV to advanced DUV and certain etch and metrology tools. The report shows Washington is shifting its focus from “blocking the most advanced” to “blocking China’s advanced” gear.

Nikkei Asia also reports that Chinese firms are pouring resources into domestic lithography but still rely on mature ASML machines in the short term. A lithography tool is not a single component but a system comprising light source, projection optics, wafer stage, immersion fluid, computational lithography and control software. A 193‑nm immersion system needs an ArF source, high‑precision projection optics, dual wafer stages and a stable water film; EUV adds a 13.5‑nm laser‑plasma source, vacuum reflective mirrors and far more complex computational lithography.

Andreas Erdmann, a renowned expert in semiconductor lithography and computational optics, has said that mechanics, electronics, chemistry, mathematics and computation must work together for a full‑system to run stably – a reason why only ASML, Nikon and Canon have full‑machine capability worldwide.

ASML’s advantage lies in integrating a global top‑tier supply chain, whereas Nikon and Canon develop more in‑house but have not fully aligned with the international division of labor, leaving them behind in advanced technology.

China’s early dry DUV tools topped out at about 90 nm. In 2024 the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology announced a new dry DUV with 65‑nm lens resolution. Industry reports by Wang Yangyuan and Chen Nanxiang say Chinese domestic immersion DUV has completed development and entered testing. Foreign media also claim China, with government backing, assembled its own DUV system and even hinted at an EUV prototype late last year, which rattled global chip stocks, though independent mass‑production verification is still lacking.

Japanese experts note that existing ASML inventory lets Chinese fabs maintain capacity and cash flow while they tackle the light source, optics, wafer stage and computational lithography subsystems separately. “Being able to build a full machine” and “being able to replace ASML at volume” are different; yield, throughput, stable operation and software ecosystem will still take years to mature.
ASML’s financial reports once showed China accounting for roughly 41 % of its revenue; as controls tighten the company expects China’s share to fall to about 20 % by 2026.

China’s strategy is to compliantly purchase DUV tools to keep capacity while developing full‑system domestic machines for the long term: first use NXT:1980i and other immersion tools to support 7‑nm logic and storage expansion, then gradually introduce domestic dry and immersion equipment into mature and mid‑range advanced nodes.

Beyond lithography, U.S. analysts say China has made noticeable progress in etch, deposition, cleaning and metrology equipment. Companies such as SMIC, North Huachuang, Shengmei, Tuojing, Huahai Qingke and Zhongke Feice have entered some production lines. Japanese equipment makers fear that if Chinese lithography breakthroughs occur, related materials, deposition and metrology will also become domestic, hurting exporters like Tokyo Electron and Screen.

South Korean media report that Samsung and SK Hynix, constrained by U.S. limits on buying advanced gear for their Chinese joint ventures, are evaluating Chinese etch and some process equipment from SMIC, showing substitution is spreading from “non‑lithography” to a broader equipment ecosystem.

Overall, the stock of 343 immersion DUV machines and ongoing purchases give China a mid‑term autonomous capability for AI chips, 7‑nm logic and advanced storage. If the U.S. imposes a full DUV embargo, new capacity after 2027 would be curbed, but existing machines, multiple‑exposure techniques and domestic prototypes can sustain a basic production base. The variable for Chinese domestic lithography is not the theoretical approach but the stability of full machines, output throughput, defect density and supply‑chain coordination.

Analysts argue that U.S. export controls will slow China’s advanced progress in the short run but ultimately hand the market to domestic equipment vendors, accelerating full‑chain substitution. If China manages to mass‑produce domestic immersion tools and turn EUV prototypes into commercial products, ASML’s monopoly premium and global chip pricing logic could be reassessed. The semiconductor‑equipment battle is shifting from “selling machines” to a prolonged “system integration and capacity autonomy” fight.

items.title: 中國PCB鑽針如何從日本手中奪下全球市占 龍頭業者股價暴漲150%？
items.title_en: How Chinese PCB Micro‑Drills Overtook Japan to Capture Global Market Share, Leading Firm’s Stock Soars 150%?
paras: 印刷電路板(PCB)作為各類電子元件運作之基礎基板，內部透過微孔鍍銅連接多層線路，而微型鑽針(PCB鑽針)即為實現跨層信號導通的關鍵高頻耗材。
過去，全球高階微型鑽針及直徑0.2公釐以下的高端鎢鋼棒材市場主要由日本企業(如住友、三菱等)掌控，中國雖為全球最大PCB生產國，但在高階鑽針與關鍵原料上長期依賴進口。

全球市占率結構重組

近年來，此一市場結構出現顯著變化。《新浪財經》報導指出，鑽針龍頭業者鼎泰高科市值大幅增長，反映出其全球市場影響力提升。產業統計資料顯示，2025年鼎泰高科以29.2%的全球PCB鑽針銷售市占率位居第一，金洲精工則以約20.8%緊隨其後，兩家企業合計占據全球近半數市場。
相較之下，日本傳統龍頭佑能(Union Tool)的全球市占率降至約一成，主要保留在0.03公釐以下的超微鑽領域。
這一發展，幫助鼎泰高科的股價在年內上漲接近 150%，總市值達到 1,446 億元人民幣。
報導分析，本土企業的突破源於全產業鏈的自主化整合。在原料端，已實現鎢鋼棒材自主生產；在設備端，鼎泰高科自研自產設備比例超過95%，使設備製造成本降至進口設備的三分之一，大幅降低產能擴充的門檻。
在產品性能與品質控制方面，本土微型鑽針在每分鐘數十萬轉的高速運轉下，展現出良好的品質穩定度。數據顯示，本土產品的斷針率控制在萬分之三(0.03%)，良率達99.7%；而日本同類產品的斷針率約為萬分之五(0.05%)，良率約為98%。
此外，鼎泰高科官方聲明指出，其技術加工最小直徑可達0.01公釐，目前已批量交付0.03公釐(遠小於一般頭髮絲約0.07公釐之直徑)的超微鑽針。2026年1月，鼎泰高科微鑽針單廠月產量突破1億支，鑫寰宇、湖北妙殼等企業亦具備0.03公釐產能。

AI伺服器需求爆發與供應鏈近場優勢

全球人工智慧(AI)算力需求蓬勃發展，帶動AI伺服器專用PCB鑽針的需求大增。傳統伺服器PCB主機板層數約12至16層，而AI伺服器主機板堆疊達24至40層，單板鑽孔數高達數萬至十幾萬個。
同時，為了減少高頻信號損耗，AI伺服器採用含有石英布的M9高硬度板材，使單支鑽針的耐用度由傳統板材的2000至3000孔劇降至100至200孔。
浙商證券發布之研究報告預測，AI伺服器專用PCB鑽針需求量將從2026年的8億支成長至2030年的39.2億支。
由於全球多數AI伺服器PCB生產基地集中於中國本土，鑽針作為高頻消耗品，下游印刷電路板廠對供貨及時性要求極高。本土鑽針廠可實現同一工業區或2至3天內快速補貨與現場技術支援，相較於日本跨海運輸需耗時數周，具備顯著的近場供應鏈優勢。
paras_en: Printed circuit boards (PCBs) serve as the foundational substrate for all electronic components, with internal copper‑plated micro‑holes connecting multiple layers of circuitry, and the tiny micro‑drill (PCB drill) is the key high‑frequency consumable that enables inter‑layer signal conduction.

Historically, the global market for high‑end micro‑drills and tungsten‑steel rods under 0.2 mm in diameter has been dominated by Japanese companies such as Sumitomo and Mitsubishi. Although China is the world’s largest PCB producer, it has long relied on imports for high‑end drills and critical raw materials.

Global market‑share structure reshuffle
In recent years, this market structure has changed markedly. A report by Sina Finance noted that the leading drill maker DingTai High‑Tech saw its market value surge dramatically, reflecting its growing global influence. Industry statistics show that in 2025 DingTai High‑Tech held a 29.2% share of global PCB drill sales, ranking first, while Jinzhou Precision followed with about 20.8%, together accounting for nearly half of the worldwide market.
By contrast, Japan’s traditional leader Union Tool’s global share has fallen to roughly 10%, now mainly confined to ultra‑micro drills under 0.03 mm.
This development helped DingTai High‑Tech’s share price climb close to 150% within the year, pushing its total market capitalization to RMB 144.6 billion.

The analysis attributes the domestic firms’ breakthrough to a fully integrated supply chain. On the raw‑material side, tungsten‑steel rod production is now self‑sufficient; on the equipment side, DingTai High‑Tech’s in‑house‑designed and manufactured equipment accounts for over 95% of its needs, cutting equipment costs to one‑third of imported alternatives and dramatically lowering the barrier to capacity expansion.

In terms of product performance and quality control, domestic micro‑drills operating at several hundred thousand RPM demonstrate strong stability. Data show the break‑rate of domestic products is controlled at 0.03% (3 in 10,000) with a yield of 99.7%, whereas comparable Japanese products have a break‑rate of about 0.05% (5 in 10,000) and a yield around 98%.

Furthermore, DingTai High‑Tech states its technology can process diameters as small as 0.01 mm and is already delivering 0.03 mm ultra‑micro drills in volume (far smaller than a typical hair strand of about 0.07 mm). In January 2026, the company’s single‑plant monthly output of micro‑drills exceeded 100 million pieces, and firms such as Xinhuanyu and Hubei Miaoke also have 0.03 mm production capacity.

AI server demand explosion and near‑shore supply‑chain advantage
The booming global demand for AI compute power is driving a sharp rise in demand for PCB drills dedicated to AI servers. Traditional server PCBs typically have 12–16 layers, whereas AI server motherboards stack 24–40 layers, with each board requiring tens of thousands to over a hundred thousand drill holes.

At the same time, to reduce high‑frequency signal loss, AI servers use M9 high‑hardness boards containing quartz cloth, which reduces the usable lifespan of a single drill from the traditional 2,000–3,000 holes to just 100–200 holes.
Research from Zheshang Securities forecasts that demand for AI‑server‑specific PCB drills will grow from 800 million units in 2026 to 3.92 billion units by 2030.

Because most AI server PCB manufacturing bases are located in China, drill supplies—being high‑frequency consumables—require extremely timely delivery. Domestic drill makers can replenish stock within the same industrial park or within 2–3 days with on‑site technical support, a stark contrast to the several‑week lead times for Japanese shipments across the sea, giving them a significant near‑shore supply‑chain advantage.

items.title: 智邦9月營收403億元年增逾6成 創歷史次高
items.title_en: Accton September Revenue Hits NT$40.399 Billion, Up Over 60% YoY, Marks Second-Highest Ever
paras: 網通廠智邦(2345-TW)今(6)日公布9月營收為403.99億元，受惠於客戶需求增加，年增逾六成，並創歷史次高，累計前三季營收2,864.02億元，年增62.45%；隨著800G交換器出貨強勁，1.6T交換器也開始量產，持續挹注智邦未來營運。
法人指出，北美CSP業者維持強勁的資本支出，除了800G主力交換器出貨續處高檔，新一代1.6T規格與人工智慧加速卡亦加入量產放量陣容。同時，因應大型算力叢集對頻寬與低延遲的嚴苛要求，光路交換器等光通訊產品線出貨同步增溫，有效推升高單價與高毛利產品比重。
智邦日前甫啟動新竹縣AI智慧園區第二期工程，擴大竹北高階研發與創新育成能量，並同步在全球推進跨國生產基地。隨著產業架構加速往1.6T、液冷散熱及共同封裝光學推進，可延續未來成長軌跡。
paras_en: Network equipment maker Accton (2345-TW) today (6th) announced September revenue of NT$40.399 billion, benefiting from increased customer demand, up more than 60% year‑over‑year and reaching the second‑highest level in its history. Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$286.402 billion, up 62.45% year‑over‑year; with strong shipments of 800 Gbps switches and the start of volume production of 1.6 Tbps switches, the company continues to fuel future operations.

Accton’s September revenue was NT$40.399 billion, down 1.16% month‑over‑month but up 66.1% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$120.74 billion, up 26.4% quarter‑over‑quarter and 65.5% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters this year was NT$286.402 billion, up 62.45% year‑over‑year.

Institutions noted that North American CSP operators are maintaining strong capital expenditures. In addition to continued high‑end shipments of the flagship 800 Gbps switches, the next‑generation 1.6 Tbps specifications and AI acceleration cards have also entered volume production. At the same time, to meet the stringent bandwidth and low‑latency requirements of large compute clusters, shipments of optical‑communication products such as optical route switches have risen, effectively increasing the proportion of high‑price, high‑margin items.

Accton recently launched the second phase of its AI Smart Park in Hsinchu County, expanding high‑end R&D and innovation incubation capabilities in Zhubei, while simultaneously advancing multinational production bases worldwide. As the industry architecture accelerates toward 1.6 Tbps, liquid‑cooling heat dissipation and co‑packaged optics, the company can sustain its future growth trajectory.

items.title: 勤凱Q3營收創單季新高 產能滿載、獲利再拚高
items.title_en: Qingkai Q3 Revenue Hits Seasonal High, Capacity Full, Profit Set to Rise Further
paras: 電子材料大廠勤凱(4760-TW)今(6)日公布9月營收3.04億元，年增76.3%、月減0.4%，營收為歷史次高，第三季營收8.79億元，季增23.6%，年增82%，創歷史單季新高。同時，累計前三季營收22.2億元，年增66.9%，已超越去年全年。勤凱受惠被動元件MLCC等需求旺盛，營收節節攀升，法人看好，勤凱第三季、前三季獲利有機會創歷史新高，第四季營運展望維持正向。
勤凱副董事長莊淑媛表示，9月營收略減，主要受到國際銀價自高檔小幅回落影響，產品售價隨原料價格略為調整，不過整體出貨動能依舊強勁，整體銅膏客戶需求旺盛、銀膏出貨量也持續成長，第四季有機會維持高峰水準。
法人推估，隨被動元件市況火熱，第三季獲利可期。儘管因發放股票股利造成股本增加影響，但每股獲利仍將維持成長，今年前三季獲利有望挑戰去年全年。
莊淑媛指出，由於MLCC市況熱絡，目前工廠產能維持滿載，公司已緊急增購新產線設備，以提升供應能力，因應客戶需求。部份客戶已表達明年將進一步擴大拉貨，公司將持續依市場需求彈性調整產能規劃，為後續營運成長預作準備。
勤凱未來營運除AI伺服器的新產品「合金膏」外，包括TGV、TIM1、PTFE等新品在客戶驗證作業持續推進中，將成為明年營運成長的重要基石。
paras_en: Qingkai (4760-TW), a major electronic materials manufacturer, announced today (the 6th) that its September revenue was NT$304 million, up 76.3% year‑over‑year but down 0.4% month‑over‑month, marking the second‑highest figure in its history. The third‑quarter revenue reached NT$879 million, a 23.6% increase from the previous quarter and an 82% rise year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑quarter record. Cumulatively, the first three quarters delivered NT$2.22 billion in revenue, up 66.9% year‑over‑year and already surpassing last year’s total. Benefiting from strong demand for passive components such as MLCCs, Qingkai’s sales have been climbing steadily, and analysts are optimistic that Q3 and the year‑to‑date profit could hit historic highs, with a positive outlook for Q4 operations.

Vice Chairman Zhuang Shuyuan said the slight dip in September revenue was mainly due to a modest pull‑back in international silver prices from peak levels, which led to a small adjustment in product pricing as raw‑material costs fell. Nevertheless, overall shipment momentum remains robust, with strong demand from copper‑paste customers and continued growth in silver‑paste shipments, giving the fourth quarter a chance to maintain peak levels.

Analysts estimate that, given the hot market for passive components, Q3 profit looks promising. Although the issuance of a stock dividend increased share capital and thus impacts per‑share figures, earnings per share are still expected to keep growing, and profit for the first three quarters this year could challenge last year’s full‑year total.

Zhuang Shuyuan noted that, because the MLCC market is booming, the factory’s capacity is currently running at full load. The company has urgently purchased new production‑line equipment to boost supply capability in response to customer demand. Some customers have already indicated they will further increase their orders next year, and the company will continue to flexibly adjust its capacity plans according to market needs, preparing for future operational growth.

Beyond the new AI‑server product “Alloy Paste,” Qingkai is advancing verification of other new items such as TGV, TIM1 and PTFE with customers, which are expected to become key pillars for growth in next year’s operations.

items.title: 從文科生到AI巨擘 Anthropic總裁阿莫迪成為美國富豪榜最年輕白手起家女性
items.title_en: From Liberal Arts Student to AI Giant: Anthropic President Daniela Amodei Becomes the Youngest Self‑Made Female Billionaire on the U.S. Rich List
paras: 根據《Forbes》近期公布的美國富豪榜，現年 39 歲的人工智慧企業 Anthropic 聯合創辦人兼總裁阿莫迪(Daniela Amodei)，以估算達 155 億美元的身價，位居全美白手起家女性富豪第 2 名，並在全美 400 大富豪榜中並列第 75 名，成為榜單中最年輕的白手起家女性億萬富豪。
隨著 Anthropic 在融資中籌集 650 億美元，推升估值至 9,650 億美元，其身價在一年內成長近 13 倍。

跨領域歷程與通才管理哲學

與典型矽谷科技創辦人不同，阿莫迪未持有電腦科學或法律學位，而是畢業於加州大學聖克魯斯分校英國文學系。其父親為皮革工匠，母親從事圖書館建設管理。
在談及個人背景時，阿莫迪於史丹佛大學訪談中表示：「在某些方面，我真的認為自己是一個通才……能夠保持好奇心、跨領域學習，並建立渴望帶來影響力的堅實基礎，是一種被低估的特質。」
阿莫迪早期曾參與國際發展與政治競選工作，2013 年加入支付新創 Stripe 負責人才招募與風險營運，管理詐欺與合規業務。2018 年她進入 OpenAI 擔任安全政策與工程管理副總裁，並於 2020 年底與哥哥達里奧·阿莫迪(Dario Amodei)等七人離職，共同創立 Anthropic。

營運成長與 IPO 規畫

作為 Anthropic 總裁兼董事會主席，阿莫迪負責公司日常營運與高管團隊。財務數據顯示，Anthropic 年化營收自 2025 年 1 月的 10 億美元，成長至 2026 年 7 月底的 650 億美元以上。
市場消息指出，Anthropic 計畫於 2026 年 11 月進行首次公開發行(IPO)，預期上市估值可能達 2 兆美元以上。主要投資方包括 Google、Amazon、NVIDIA 與紅杉資本等。

商業倫理與財富影響

針對商業營運與社會責任，阿莫迪受訪時說明：「我們將成為商業實體，人工智慧將創造巨大經濟價值，但以正確的方式做到這一點非常重要。商業營運與做好事之間並不一定存在衝突。」
此外，Anthropic 創辦團隊宣布未來將捐出 80% 財富。這種對財富回饋的看法獲其他企業家迴響。例如 Epic Systems 創辦人Judy Faulkner在「贈予誓言」信中表示：「我從未想過要成為過著奢華生活的富豪，我承諾捐出 99% 資產的目標是幫助他人獲得溫飽與教育等基礎。」
伴隨 AI 產業擴張，財富累積延伸至企業員工。據報導，Anthropic 部分技術人員因估值成長，股權價值顯著增加；OpenAI 亦透過股權買賣允許員工套現約 66 億美元。
同時，全美白手起家女性億萬富豪人數已自 2015 年的 12 位增至 43 位，資產創下 1,663 億美元新高，反映科技創新對財富結構的重塑。
paras_en: According to Forbes' recently released U.S. Rich List, 39‑year‑old Anthropic co‑founder and president Daniela Amodei, whose net worth is estimated at $15.5 billion, ranks second among self‑made women in the United States and ties for 75th place on the overall U.S. 400 richest list, making her the youngest self‑made female billionaire on the ranking.
As Anthropic raised $6.5 billion in financing, its valuation jumped to $965 billion, causing Amodei’s net worth to grow almost 13‑fold in a single year.

Cross‑disciplinary Journey and Generalist Management Philosophy
Unlike typical Silicon Valley tech founders, Amodei does not hold a degree in computer science or law; she graduated from the University of California, Santa Cruz with a major in English literature. Her father is a leather craftsman and her mother works in library construction management.

When discussing her background in a Stanford interview, Amodei said, “In some ways I really consider myself a generalist… being able to stay curious, learn across fields, and build a solid foundation for wanting to make an impact is an undervalued trait.”

Amodei’s early career included work in international development and political campaigns. In 2013 she joined payments startup Stripe, overseeing talent acquisition and risk operations, including fraud and compliance. In 2018 she moved to OpenAI as vice president of safety policy and engineering management, and at the end of 2020 she left with her brother Dario Amodei and five others to co‑found Anthropic.

Operational Growth and IPO Plans
As Anthropic’s president and chair of the board, Amodei oversees daily operations and the senior leadership team. Financial data show Anthropic’s annualized revenue grew from $10 billion in January 2025 to over $650 billion by the end of July 2026.

Market sources indicate Anthropic plans to launch its initial public offering in November 2026, with a projected listing valuation that could exceed $2 trillion. Major investors include Google, Amazon, NVIDIA and Sequoia Capital.

Business Ethics and Wealth Impact
On business operations and social responsibility, Amodei explained, “We will become a commercial entity; AI will create massive economic value, but doing it the right way is crucial. Business operations and doing good don’t necessarily have to be at odds.”

The Anthropic founding team also announced it will donate 80 % of its wealth in the future. This view on wealth redistribution resonated with other entrepreneurs. For example, Epic Systems founder Judy Faulkner wrote in a “Giving Pledge” letter, “I never imagined living a lavish billionaire life; my commitment to give away 99 % of my assets is aimed at helping others secure basic needs and education.”

With the AI industry’s expansion, wealth accumulation is extending to company employees. Reports say some Anthropic engineers have seen their equity values surge dramatically as the valuation rose; OpenAI also allowed employees to cash out roughly $6.6 billion through equity sales.

At the same time, the number of self‑made female billionaires in the United States has risen from 12 in 2015 to 43, with total assets reaching a new high of $166.3 billion, reflecting how technological innovation is reshaping the wealth landscape.

items.title: 亞洲AI建設上看8.2兆美元 銀行搶做高風險GPU融資
items.title_en: Asian AI Build-Up Seen at $8.2 Trillion, Banks Rush to Offer High‑Risk GPU Financing
paras: 下一波人工智慧（AI）債務融資浪潮正在亞洲興起。
在亞洲各地興建數百座資料中心的企業，也正籌措資金，購買驅動這些設施的先進晶片。透過借款購入圖形處理器（GPU）的模式，已在美國快速成長；亞洲目前少數完成的相關貸款，多半由願意承擔較高風險的私募信貸基金提供。
如今，銀行對GPU融資的接受度逐漸提高，大幅擴充下一階段AI競賽可取得的資金來源。這些資金將至關重要，因為資誠（PwC）估計，到2050年，亞洲資料中心支出可能達8.2兆美元，其中絕大多數將用於GPU、伺服器等硬體。
近幾個月，銀行在GMI Cloud及另外兩家AI基礎設施供應商Zankore、PaleBlueDot AI合計約38億美元的GPU貸款案中，扮演關鍵角色。
花旗是Zankore在印尼取得31億美元貸款的唯一債務顧問，摩根大通則擔任PaleBlueDot AI授信案的安排機構。
亞洲六名銀行業者與財務顧問表示，他們正在洽談，或知悉更多GPU相關融資案。不過，由於晶片長期估值，以及地緣政治與AI本身的風險仍難以評估，這類貸款仍處於起步階段。
Hogan Lovells Cadwalader銀行與金融業務合夥人Eric Tan表示：「隨著交易規模擴大，借款人要求更具競爭力的融資條件，銀行將愈來愈重要。」但他也指出，技術變化快速，使GPU融資的貸款機構面臨「快速折舊、技術淘汰及租金波動」等風險。
國際投行率先布局 亞洲銀行跟進
知悉相關洽談的人士表示，在已投入亞洲GPU融資的傳統貸款機構中，全球投資銀行目前是主要參與者，因為它們具備處理複雜融資架構的專業能力。一名銀行業者指出，部分美國貸款機構也借重總部專家，評估晶片價值。
知情人士透露，花旗、摩根大通、巴克萊、德意志銀行、桑坦德銀行及日本三井住友銀行，目前都在評估GPU相關貸款。另有知情人士上月表示，GMI Cloud正與銀行及民間貸款機構洽談一筆新的3億美元貸款，用於購買泰國資料中心所需晶片。
花旗、巴克萊及德意志銀行代表拒絕置評。摩根大通、桑坦德及三井住友銀行未立即回應置評請求。
亞洲銀行也開始更積極參與。Zankore董事長Vikram Sinha表示，新加坡大華銀行先前與另外四家銀行共同承銷Zankore的31億美元貸款，如今正主導新一輪洽談，協助這家資料中心業者向銀行籌措60億美元。
Sinha在9月22日的一場會議上表示，與銀行合作是「正確的方式」，因為Zankore計劃將AI資料中心容量擴大至目前的10倍、達到1吉瓦，未來仍須持續籌資。
他說：「我們非常清楚自己追求的規模。我們想走較艱難的路，也就是與銀行及銀行聯貸團合作。」
資金增加 還款能力要求也提高
隨著銀行成為更重要的資金來源，企業若想借款購買晶片，就必須更充分證明，專案能創造足夠營收償還貸款。傳統貸款機構可能採取更保守的授信審核標準，並要求提存更多償債準備金。
亞洲最大私募信貸業者之一Ares Management的執行長Mike Arougheti表示，即使GPU融資是AI熱潮中資金缺口最大的領域，公司仍維持高標準。
Arougheti在9月的巴克萊全球金融服務會議上說：「你必須以願意承擔的風險為依據，而不是以投放資金的意願為依據。」
他表示：「至少對我而言，沒有人能真正說清楚這項技術的折舊曲線。」他並補充，這類貸款的報酬溢價有限，通常僅比其他AI基礎設施貸款高出100至200個基點。
亞洲GPU貸款大多沿用CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 率先採用的架構。CoreWeave是最早、也是規模最大的此類融資使用者之一。許多交易以資料中心出售算力的收入償還貸款，客戶合約及晶片本身則經常作為貸款擔保。
因此，對貸款機構而言，最重要的問題是：這些客戶有多可靠，合約期限又有多長？
輝達提供保障 中國客戶帶來需求
有輝達(NVDA-US) 支持的交易，較容易獲得貸款機構同意。在GMI Cloud與Zankore上月完成的貸款案中，輝達同意購買任何未售出的算力，若客戶合約未能履行，便可提供保障。
作為交換，這些參與輝達雲端合作夥伴計畫的企業，將以高於輝達承諾支付的價格向買家收費，並與輝達分享營收。
中國大型科技公司也成為亞洲算力需求的另一個重要來源。一家歐洲銀行的貸款業務人士表示，這些企業相對可靠，因為它們也能吸引中國銀行參與融資。
知情人士上月表示，GMI Cloud計劃為泰國資料中心購買的晶片，最終使用者將是騰訊。另有知情人士去年12月透露，中國熱門社群平台小紅書，預計購買PaleBlueDot AI日本專案所採購晶片提供的算力。
中國客戶的監管風險仍待釐清
不過，中國客戶也帶來額外風險。美國已限制晶片出口至中國，並正考慮新法案，旨在限制中國企業透過雲端運算遠端使用輝達晶片，進而限制它們租用位於其他國家的算力。
標普全球評級分析師Yijing Ng表示：「中國大型雲端業者普遍具備良好的信用體質。」但她指出，銀行必須進行更充分的盡職調查，確保符合監管規定，且算力最終使用者未違反任何制裁或限制。
與此同時，AI是否構成生存威脅，以及是否有必要為其發展設立防護機制的辯論，也將持續影響風險評估。
Hogan Lovells Cadwalader的Tan表示：「市場可能需要一段時間才能找到平衡。交易架構可能變得更嚴格，政府支持可能介入，交易模式也將隨之演變。」
paras_en: The next wave of artificial‑intelligence (AI) debt financing is taking off in Asia.

Companies building hundreds of data centres across Asia are also raising funds to buy the advanced chips that power those facilities. The model of borrowing to purchase graphics processing units (GPUs) has grown rapidly in the United States; the few related loans that have been completed in Asia so far have mostly been supplied by private‑credit funds willing to take higher risk.

Now banks are becoming more receptive to GPU financing, dramatically expanding the pool of capital available for the next stage of the AI race. That capital will be crucial, as PwC estimates that Asian data‑centre spending could reach $8.2 trillion by 2050, with the vast majority earmarked for hardware such as GPUs and servers.
In recent months, banks have played a key role in roughly $3.8 billion of GPU loan transactions involving GMI Cloud and two other AI‑infrastructure providers, Zankore and PaleBlueDot AI.
Citigroup acted as the sole debt adviser for Zankore’s $3.1 billion loan in Indonesia, while JPMorgan served as the arranger for PaleBlueDot AI’s credit facility.

Six Asian banks and financial advisers said they are in talks or are aware of additional GPU‑related financing deals. However, because chip valuations are long‑term, and geopolitical and AI‑specific risks remain hard to gauge, such loans are still in an early stage.

Hogan Lovells Cadwalader banking and finance partner Eric Tan said, “As deal sizes grow, borrowers demand more competitive financing terms, and banks will become increasingly important.” He also warned that rapid technology change exposes GPU lenders to “fast depreciation, technological obsolescence and rent volatility.”
International investment banks are moving first; Asian banks are following.

Sources familiar with the discussions said that among traditional lenders that have entered Asian GPU financing, global investment banks are currently the main participants because they have the expertise to structure complex financing. One banker noted that some U.S. lenders also rely on head‑office specialists to assess chip values.

Insiders disclosed that Citigroup, JPMorgan, Barclays, Deutsche Bank, Santander and Japan’s Sumitomo Mitsui Bank are all evaluating GPU‑related loans. Another source said that last month GMI Cloud was negotiating a new $300 million loan with banks and private lenders to buy chips for a data centre in Thailand.
Representatives of Citigroup, Barclays and Deutsche Bank declined to comment. JPMorgan, Santander and Sumitomo Mitsui Bank did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Asian banks are also becoming more active. Zankore chairman Vikram Sinha said that Singapore’s United Overseas Bank, which previously syndicated Zankore’s $3.1 billion loan together with four other banks, is now leading a new round of talks to help the data‑centre operator raise $6 billion from banks.
Sinha told a meeting on September 22 that working with banks is “the right way” because Zankore plans to expand AI data‑centre capacity ten‑fold to 1 GW and will need ongoing financing.
He added, “We are very clear about the scale we are chasing. We want to take the harder road, which means working with banks and a bank‑loan syndicate.”
More Funding, Higher Repayment Standards

As banks become a more important source of capital, companies that want to borrow to buy chips must more convincingly demonstrate that projects will generate enough revenue to repay the loans. Traditional lenders may adopt more conservative credit standards and require larger debt‑service reserves.

Mike Arougheti, CEO of Ares Management, one of Asia’s largest private‑credit firms, said that even though GPU financing is the biggest funding gap in the AI boom, the firm still maintains high standards.

Speaking at Barclays’ Global Financial Services conference in September, Arougheti said, “You have to base your underwriting on the risk you are willing to take, not on the willingness to deploy capital.”

He added, “At least for me, no one can really predict the depreciation curve of this technology.” He noted that the risk premium on such loans is limited, typically only 100 to 200 basis points above other AI‑infrastructure loans.

Most Asian GPU loans follow the structure pioneered by CoreWeave (CRWV‑US). CoreWeave was one of the earliest and largest users of this financing model. Many transactions repay the loan from revenue generated by selling compute capacity, while customer contracts and the chips themselves often serve as collateral.
Thus, for lenders the key questions are: how reliable are these customers and how long are the contracts?
Nvidia Provides Guarantees, Chinese Customers Drive Demand

Deals backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US) are easier for lenders to approve. In the loan transactions completed last month for GMI Cloud and Zankore, Nvidia agreed to purchase any unsold compute capacity, providing a safety net if a customer contract falls through.
In return, the companies participating in Nvidia’s cloud partner program will charge buyers at rates higher than Nvidia’s committed price and share revenue with Nvidia.

Large Chinese tech firms are also becoming a major source of compute demand in Asia. A loan‑officer at a European bank said these firms are relatively reliable because they can also attract Chinese banks to participate in financing.

Sources said that the end‑user of the chips GMI Cloud plans to buy for a Thai data centre will be Tencent. Another source disclosed in December that China’s popular social platform Xiaohongshu plans to purchase compute capacity from the chips procured for PaleBlueDot AI’s Japan project.
Regulatory Risks From Chinese Customers Remain Unclear

However, Chinese customers also bring additional risk. The United States has restricted chip exports to China and is considering new legislation aimed at limiting Chinese firms’ remote use of Nvidia chips via cloud services, thereby curbing their ability to rent compute located abroad.

S&P Global Ratings analyst Yijing Ng said, “Large Chinese cloud providers generally have solid credit profiles,” but she warned that banks must conduct thorough due‑diligence to ensure compliance with regulations and that the ultimate compute users do not violate any sanctions or restrictions.
At the same time, the debate over whether AI poses an existential threat and whether protective mechanisms should be built into its development will continue to shape risk assessments.

Tan of Hogan Lovells Cadwalader concluded, “The market may need time to find a balance. Deal structures could become stricter, government support may intervene, and transaction models will evolve accordingly.”

items.title: 沙烏地輸油管再遇襲停運 胡塞放話：領空將成戰場
items.title_en: Saudi Oil Pipelines Hit Again, Houthi Says Saudi Airspace Will Become Battlefield
paras: 葉門戰事升溫。胡塞武裝持續推進塔伊茲前線，政府軍消息人士稱，城內部隊已遭圍困。沙烏地阿拉伯主導的多國聯軍則宣布，出動100架戰機執行「葉門黎明」行動，支援政府軍反攻。胡塞武裝隨後警告，沙烏地領空將成為作戰區域；法新社報導稱，沙烏地東西輸油管再度遇襲停運。
根據戰報，胡塞武裝10月4日攻入圖爾巴鎮，沿塔伊茲公路推進，控制哈亞米、納許馬、比林及加札利亞等地，並向阿盧姆地區進攻。至5日，胡塞武裝推進至連接塔伊茲與亞丁的最後一條主要公路部分路段，進一步收緊包圍圈，圖爾巴及南部通道仍持續交戰。
沙烏地支援的部隊同時在塔伊茲其他地區及杜巴卜、曼德海峽附近反攻。聯軍發言人馬利基5日表示，100架戰機當天凌晨參與「葉門黎明」行動，已摧毀324個「高價值目標」，並持續打擊移動目標。聯軍另稱，正為政府軍提供全天候空中支援，同時保護曼德海峽。
葉門軍方發言人努扎伊利表示，包括南方巨人旅及民族之盾部隊在內的政府軍已控制曼德海峽。地面部隊從卡赫布山脈發動側翼包抄，控制杜巴卜區及當地戰略機場，隨後切斷通往北部港口城市摩卡的公路。
政府軍宣稱，已在杜巴卜地區包圍數百名胡塞武裝人員，截斷撤退路線並要求投降。胡塞武裝發布的影片則顯示，聯軍車隊遭飛彈與無人機攻擊。
胡塞武裝透過旗下薩巴通訊社發布警告，稱沙烏地領空已不再安全，將成為其部隊作戰區域，並向在該空域營運的航空公司示警，利雅德與吉達的民航運作受到影響。
法新社報導，沙烏地官方確認東西輸油管因再度遇襲而停運，其他受損泵站仍在修復，又有一座泵站遭到攻擊。
葉門總統領導委員會主席阿里米5日宣布，發動「葉門黎明」行動，目標是恢復國家機構運作、收復首都薩那並結束胡塞武裝叛亂。
paras_en: Yemen’s war is heating up. Houthi forces continue to advance on the Taiz front, and government‑military sources say city troops are now besieged. The Saudi‑led multinational coalition announced it deployed 100 warplanes for the “Yemen Dawn” operation to support the government’s counter‑offensive. The Houthis then warned that Saudi airspace would become a combat zone; AFP reported that Saudi east‑west oil pipelines were hit again and shut down.

According to battle reports, on October 4 the Houthis entered the town of Turba, pushing along the Taiz highway and taking control of Hayami, Nashma, Biling and Gazzalia, and advancing toward the Al‑Ulum area. By the 5th they had reached sections of the last main road linking Taiz and Aden, tightening the encirclement, while fighting continued in Turba and the southern corridor.

Saudi‑backed forces were also counter‑attacking in other parts of Taiz as well as near Duba and the Mandeb Strait. Coalition spokesman Malikhi said on the 5th that 100 aircraft took part in the “Yemen Dawn” operation in the early hours, destroying 324 “high‑value targets” and continuing to strike moving targets. The coalition added it is providing round‑the‑clock air support to government forces while also protecting the Mandeb Strait.

Yemen’s military spokesperson Nuzaili said government forces, including the Southern Giant Brigade and the National Shield units, have secured the Mandeb Strait. Ground troops launched a flanking maneuver from the Kahab mountains, seized the Duba area and its strategic airfield, and then cut the road to the northern port city of Mokha.

Government forces claim they have surrounded hundreds of Houthi fighters in the Duba area, cut off their retreat routes and called for their surrender. Houthi‑released video shows coalition convoys being hit by missiles and drones.

The Houthis, via their Saba news agency, warned that Saudi airspace is no longer safe and will become a combat zone for their forces, alerting airlines operating in the area that civil aviation in Riyadh and Jeddah is being affected.

AFP reported that Saudi officials confirmed the east‑west oil pipelines were shut down after being hit again; other damaged pump stations are still being repaired and another station has also been attacked.

Ali Mi, chairman of Yemen’s Presidential Leadership Council, announced on the 5th the launch of the “Yemen Dawn” operation, aimed at restoring state institutions, recapturing the capital Sana’a and ending the Houthi rebellion.

items.title: 南俊國際9月營收2.7億元年增3成 AI伺服器新品逐月出貨Q4重返成長
items.title_en: Nan Jun International September Revenue Hits NT$270 Million, Up 30% YoY; AI Server Rail Products Ship Monthly, Q4 Returns to Growth
paras: 伺服器導軌廠南俊國際(6584-TW)今(6)日公布9月營收為2.7億元，年增約3成，今年累計前三季營收25.45億元，年增47.69%；南俊國際指出，由於伺服器供應鏈缺料，導致9月營收不如預期，不過隨著Vera Rubin以及ASIC等新品AI伺服器導軌逐月出貨，營運將重返成長軌道。
南俊國際9月營收2.7億元，月減3.30%、年增30.48%；第三季營收8.3億元，季減1.79%、年增33.61%；今年累計前三季營收25.45億元，年增47.69%。
南俊國際表示，9月份營收受到整體通用型伺服器供應鏈缺料影響，終端CSP客戶拉貨狀況不穩定，造成營收未如預期成長。
南俊提到，輝達AI新產品Vera Rubin導軌已於今年8月份開始少量出貨，並陸續增加幾家大型新客戶。此外，ASIC導軌將於10月份正式量產並開始少量出貨。展望第四季，隨著Vera Rubin以及ASIC等AI伺服器導軌出貨量逐月增加，營運將重回上升趨勢。
paras_en: Nan Jun International (6584-TW) announced today that September revenue was NT$270 million, up about 30% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters this year reached NT$2.545 billion, a 47.69% increase. The company noted that September’s revenue fell short of expectations due to a shortage in the server supply chain, but as new AI server rail products such as Vera Rubin and ASIC begin shipping each month, operations are expected to get back on a growth trajectory.

September revenue was NT$270 million, down 3.30% month‑over‑month but up 30.48% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$830 million, down 1.79% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 33.61% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters this year was NT$2.545 billion, up 47.69% year‑over‑year.

Nan Jun International said September’s revenue was impacted by a general‑purpose server supply‑chain shortage, which made end‑customer CSP pull‑in orders unstable and caused revenue to fall short of expectations.

The company added that Nvidia’s new AI product Vera Rubin rail began limited shipments in August and has since added several large new customers. Additionally, ASIC rails will enter full‑scale production in October and start limited shipments. Looking ahead to Q4, as shipments of Vera Rubin and ASIC AI server rails increase month by month, operations are expected to return to an upward trend.

items.title: 藥華藥(6446)前三季營收197億！美、日核准ET超預期，正式啟動PV+ET雙適應症時代
items.title_en: Yao Hua Pharma (6446) Q3 Revenue Hits NT$19.7B! US, Japan Approve ET Beyond Expectations, Launching Dual Indication Era for PV+ET
paras: 藥華藥(6446-TW)營運迎來結構性突破，前三季累計營收達197億元，年增逾80%，9月單月營收更繳出年增近100%的佳績。營收跳增的背後，是公司正式從真性紅血球增多症(PV)單一市場，跨入「PV+ET(原發性血小板增多症）」的雙適應症時代。
其中，影響市場價值重估關鍵，在於美國與日本對其新藥Ropeg在ET適應症上的核准範圍，遠超市場預期。

美日核准涵蓋所有成人ET患者，直攻一線用藥龐大市場
藥華藥今年在全球市場佈局的最大亮點，在於新藥Ropeg (Besremi) 在ET適應症的核准範圍遠超市場預期。藥華藥雖於今年5月率先在台灣取得ET藥證，但受限於「二線用藥」定位（限用於對傳統藥物HU產生抗藥性或無法耐受的患者），市場原先對海外進度抱持保守態度。
然而，日本與美國FDA分別於8月24日與29日，相繼核准Ropeg適用於「所有成人ET患者」，範圍涵蓋新診斷及尚未接受傳統治療的病患。這意味著Ropeg成功切入美、日市場病患基數最龐大的一線用藥族群。做為近30年來首款獲准的ET新藥，Ropeg不僅取得美國市場7年的孤兒藥獨佔期保護，也宣告藥華藥在台、日、美，三大市場的佈局已到位。

注射筆結合適應症擴張，1%滲透率上看140億年營收
美國市場目前PV實際治療人數，推估僅約3,635人，滲透率仍具極大成長空間；而美國ET患者數高達約17萬名，以每人每年藥價約26萬美元估算，潛在市場規模超過400億美元。財務模型指出，美國ET滲透率每提升1個百分點(約1,700名患者），即可為公司帶來約4.4億美元(折合新台幣約140億元)的年營收。
為加速市場滲透，藥華藥於6月獲美國FDA核准、7月正式上市「一次性預充填注射筆(Pre-filled Pen)」。此項給藥工具的改良，大幅降低了病患自行施打的門檻與恐懼感，與8月通過的ET適應症形成完美的商業戰略結合，有望進一步提升 Ropeg市場滲透率。

放眼2027年後 PMF三期達陣
展望未來，中國大陸、韓國審查同步進行中。在臨床試驗方面，針對原發性骨髓纖維化(PMF)三期臨床試驗(HOPE-PMF)，已於6月完成收案，預計於2027年完成數據分析、2028年中遞交藥證申請。若順利獲批，Ropeg將成為，全球首個完整涵蓋骨髓增生性腫瘤(MPN)三大適應症的藥物。

paras_en: Yao Hua Pharma (6446-TW) is experiencing a structural breakthrough in operations, with cumulative revenue of NT$19.7 billion for the first three quarters, up more than 80% year‑over‑year, and September alone delivering nearly a 100% annual increase. The revenue surge stems from the company’s move from a single‑indication market for polycythemia vera (PV) into a dual‑indication era covering both PV and essential thrombocythemia (ET).
The key driver of market‑value re‑assessment is the approval scope for its new drug Ropeg in the ET indication by the United States and Japan, which far exceeds market expectations.

The most notable highlight of Yao Hua Pharma’s global rollout this year is that Ropeg (Besremi) received approval for the ET indication far beyond what the market anticipated. Although the company secured an ET drug certificate in Taiwan in May, it was limited to a second‑line use (for patients resistant to or intolerant of the traditional drug hydroxyurea), leading to a conservative outlook on overseas progress.

However, Japan and the U.S. FDA approved Ropeg for “all adult ET patients” on August 24 and 29, respectively, covering newly diagnosed patients and those not yet on conventional therapy. This means Ropeg has entered the largest first‑line patient pool in the U.S. and Japan. As the first ET drug approved in nearly 30 years, Ropeg not only gains a seven‑year orphan‑drug exclusivity in the U.S. but also confirms Yao Hua Pharma’s presence in Taiwan, Japan and the United States.

In the U.S., the actual treated PV population is estimated at only about 3,635 patients, leaving ample room for penetration growth; by contrast, there are roughly 170,000 ET patients, and at an annual price of about US$260,000 per patient, the potential market exceeds US$40 billion. The financial model shows that each 1‑percentage‑point increase in U.S. ET penetration (about 1,700 patients) could generate roughly US$440 million (approximately NT$14 billion) in annual revenue.

To accelerate market penetration, Yao Hua Pharma received FDA clearance in June and launched a pre‑filled injection pen in July. This delivery device greatly lowers the barrier and fear for patients self‑administering, complementing the August ET indication approval and is expected to further boost Ropeg’s market penetration.

Looking ahead, regulatory reviews are underway in mainland China and South Korea. Clinically, the Phase III trial for primary myelofibrosis (PMF) (HOPE‑PMF) completed enrollment in June, with data analysis slated for 2027 and a drug‑application filing planned for mid‑2028. If approved, Ropeg would become the world’s first drug covering all three major myeloproliferative neoplasm (MPN) indications.

items.title: 智邦9月營收403億元年增逾6成 創歷史次高
items.title_en: Accton September Revenue Hits NT$40.399 Billion, Up Over 60% YoY, Marks Second-Highest Ever
paras: 網通廠智邦(2345-TW)今(6)日公布9月營收為403.99億元，受惠於客戶需求增加，年增逾六成，並創歷史次高，累計前三季營收2,864.02億元，年增62.45%；隨著800G交換器出貨強勁，1.6T交換器也開始量產，持續挹注智邦未來營運。
法人指出，北美CSP業者維持強勁的資本支出，除了800G主力交換器出貨續處高檔，新一代1.6T規格與人工智慧加速卡亦加入量產放量陣容。同時，因應大型算力叢集對頻寬與低延遲的嚴苛要求，光路交換器等光通訊產品線出貨同步增溫，有效推升高單價與高毛利產品比重。
智邦日前甫啟動新竹縣AI智慧園區第二期工程，擴大竹北高階研發與創新育成能量，並同步在全球推進跨國生產基地。隨著產業架構加速往1.6T、液冷散熱及共同封裝光學推進，可延續未來成長軌跡。
paras_en: Network equipment maker Accton (2345-TW) today (6th) announced September revenue of NT$40.399 billion, benefiting from increased customer demand, up more than 60% year‑over‑year and reaching the second‑highest level in its history. Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters was NT$286.402 billion, up 62.45% year‑over‑year; with strong shipments of 800 Gbps switches and the start of volume production of 1.6 Tbps switches, the company continues to fuel future operations.

Accton’s September revenue was NT$40.399 billion, down 1.16% month‑over‑month but up 66.1% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$120.74 billion, up 26.4% quarter‑over‑quarter and 65.5% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters this year was NT$286.402 billion, up 62.45% year‑over‑year.

Institutions noted that North American CSP operators are maintaining strong capital expenditures. In addition to continued high‑end shipments of the flagship 800 Gbps switches, the next‑generation 1.6 Tbps specifications and AI acceleration cards have also entered volume production. At the same time, to meet the stringent bandwidth and low‑latency requirements of large compute clusters, shipments of optical‑communication products such as optical route switches have risen, effectively increasing the proportion of high‑price, high‑margin items.

Accton recently launched the second phase of its AI Smart Park in Hsinchu County, expanding high‑end R&D and innovation incubation capabilities in Zhubei, while simultaneously advancing multinational production bases worldwide. As the industry architecture accelerates toward 1.6 Tbps, liquid‑cooling heat dissipation and co‑packaged optics, the company can sustain its future growth trajectory.

items.title: 勤凱Q3營收創單季新高 產能滿載、獲利再拚高
items.title_en: Qingkai Q3 Revenue Hits Seasonal High, Capacity Full, Profit Set to Rise Further
paras: 電子材料大廠勤凱(4760-TW)今(6)日公布9月營收3.04億元，年增76.3%、月減0.4%，營收為歷史次高，第三季營收8.79億元，季增23.6%，年增82%，創歷史單季新高。同時，累計前三季營收22.2億元，年增66.9%，已超越去年全年。勤凱受惠被動元件MLCC等需求旺盛，營收節節攀升，法人看好，勤凱第三季、前三季獲利有機會創歷史新高，第四季營運展望維持正向。
勤凱副董事長莊淑媛表示，9月營收略減，主要受到國際銀價自高檔小幅回落影響，產品售價隨原料價格略為調整，不過整體出貨動能依舊強勁，整體銅膏客戶需求旺盛、銀膏出貨量也持續成長，第四季有機會維持高峰水準。
法人推估，隨被動元件市況火熱，第三季獲利可期。儘管因發放股票股利造成股本增加影響，但每股獲利仍將維持成長，今年前三季獲利有望挑戰去年全年。
莊淑媛指出，由於MLCC市況熱絡，目前工廠產能維持滿載，公司已緊急增購新產線設備，以提升供應能力，因應客戶需求。部份客戶已表達明年將進一步擴大拉貨，公司將持續依市場需求彈性調整產能規劃，為後續營運成長預作準備。
勤凱未來營運除AI伺服器的新產品「合金膏」外，包括TGV、TIM1、PTFE等新品在客戶驗證作業持續推進中，將成為明年營運成長的重要基石。
paras_en: Qingkai (4760-TW), a major electronic materials manufacturer, announced today (the 6th) that its September revenue was NT$304 million, up 76.3% year‑over‑year but down 0.4% month‑over‑month, marking the second‑highest figure in its history. The third‑quarter revenue reached NT$879 million, a 23.6% increase from the previous quarter and an 82% rise year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑quarter record. Cumulatively, the first three quarters delivered NT$2.22 billion in revenue, up 66.9% year‑over‑year and already surpassing last year’s total. Benefiting from strong demand for passive components such as MLCCs, Qingkai’s sales have been climbing steadily, and analysts are optimistic that Q3 and the year‑to‑date profit could hit historic highs, with a positive outlook for Q4 operations.

Vice Chairman Zhuang Shuyuan said the slight dip in September revenue was mainly due to a modest pull‑back in international silver prices from peak levels, which led to a small adjustment in product pricing as raw‑material costs fell. Nevertheless, overall shipment momentum remains robust, with strong demand from copper‑paste customers and continued growth in silver‑paste shipments, giving the fourth quarter a chance to maintain peak levels.

Analysts estimate that, given the hot market for passive components, Q3 profit looks promising. Although the issuance of a stock dividend increased share capital and thus impacts per‑share figures, earnings per share are still expected to keep growing, and profit for the first three quarters this year could challenge last year’s full‑year total.

Zhuang Shuyuan noted that, because the MLCC market is booming, the factory’s capacity is currently running at full load. The company has urgently purchased new production‑line equipment to boost supply capability in response to customer demand. Some customers have already indicated they will further increase their orders next year, and the company will continue to flexibly adjust its capacity plans according to market needs, preparing for future operational growth.

Beyond the new AI‑server product “Alloy Paste,” Qingkai is advancing verification of other new items such as TGV, TIM1 and PTFE with customers, which are expected to become key pillars for growth in next year’s operations.

items.title: AI晶片越貴，測試時間越長！雍智科技、矽格、京元電子誰最受惠？
items.title_en: More Expensive AI Chips, Longer Test Times! Which Company Benefits Most: Yungzhi Technology, Siliconware, or Jingyuan Electronics?
paras: 2026年10月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI晶片測試需求持續升溫，雍智科技(6683-TWO)今日早盤攻上1,580元漲停，矽格(6257-TW)一度大漲逾6%，京元電子(2449-TW)也維持高檔震盪，測試族群再度成為盤面焦點。
雍智科技9月營收2.47億元，月增5.9%、年增33.6%，連續兩個月創下歷史新高；第三季營收7.11億元，季增9.1%、年增27.9%，單月與單季同步刷新紀錄。
矽格9月營收20.89億元，月增約1%、年增26.3%，連續三個月站穩20億元以上；第三季營收61.72億元，季增5%、年增27%，同樣寫下單季新高。
不過，三家公司雖然同屬AI晶片測試概念股，實際賺到的商機並不相同：雍智科技供應探針卡與測試載板，受惠規格升級；矽格及京元電子則提供晶圓與成品測試服務，受惠測試時間延長及產能需求增加。

AI晶片愈複雜，為何測試產值跟著提高？
嚴格來說，不是晶片售價愈高，測試時間就一定愈長，而是AI晶片通常具有更多核心、更高腳數、更大功耗及更複雜的高速傳輸介面，測試項目與可靠度要求也隨之提高。
此外，AI加速器及ASIC封裝成本高昂，如果瑕疵晶片進入後續封裝，不僅造成晶片損失，還可能連帶報廢昂貴的先進封裝與HBM。因此，客戶更願意在晶圓測試、老化測試及成品測試投入較多時間與成本。
這使測試產業同時出現兩項變化：
測試介面必須升級，帶動高階探針卡與測試載板需求。
單顆晶片占用測試機台的時間增加，推升測試產能與服務單價。

雍智科技：規模最小，成長彈性最大
雍智科技主要提供Load Board、Probe Card及Burn-in Board等測試介面，產品位於晶片與測試機台之間。當AI晶片的腳數、功耗及傳輸速度提高，測試介面也必須重新設計，規格與單價因而同步上升。
公司今年規劃整體產能至少增加五成，並持續擴充高階探針卡製程；ASIC新專案預計逐步貢獻，2027年進入放量階段，矽光子相關探針卡也已出貨美系客戶。
雍智科技的優勢是營收基期較小，只要大型ASIC專案量產，就可能明顯推升成長率；但客製化程度高，營收也較容易受到專案時程及大客戶拉貨節奏影響。

矽格：AI、記憶體與先進製程多線成長
矽格受惠AI、HPC與高速互連晶片測試需求增加，第三季相關營收較去年同期成長約40%；記憶體營收同期也成長32%，並開始交付採用2奈米製程的旗艦手機應用處理器，低軌衛星晶片則已進入量產。
公司今年啟用湖口新廠，7月投入量產，8月產出已達該廠總產能約40%，後續仍有爬坡空間。
相較雍智科技，矽格的產品線與客戶較分散，除AI晶片外，還有記憶體、手機晶片、矽電容及低軌衛星等動能，成長穩定度較高，但單一AI專案帶來的爆發力相對有限。

京元電子：AI測試規模最大、受惠最直接
若從AI測試營收規模及量產確定性觀察，京元電子仍是三家公司中最直接的受惠者。
京元電子8月營收40.8億元，年增31.6%，前八月營收294.04億元、年增35.5%；市場預期2026年AI相關營收占比有機會超過七成。公司也將全年資本支出由393.72億元提高至500億元，創下歷史新高，主要投入測試設備與廠務產能。
京元電子同時承接GPU、AI ASIC及高效能運算晶片測試，當晶片測試時間拉長，客戶需要投入更多機台才能維持相同出貨量，直接推升其產能利用率與擴產需求。
不過，京元電子規模較大，股價與市場預期也已反映部分AI成長題材，後續仍要觀察新設備到位、客戶產品遞延及折舊增加對獲利的影響。

誰最受惠？答案取決於投資人看的是規模還是彈性
綜合比較，三家公司的成長含金量各有不同：
若看AI測試的訂單規模與直接受惠程度，京元電子最強；若看營收成長率與股價彈性，雍智科技更具爆發力；若重視產品分散與成長穩定度，矽格相對均衡。
換句話說，AI晶片測試並非只有一家贏家，而是從測試介面到測試產能全面升級。真正的觀察重點，在於新增資本支出能否轉化為營收，以及高階測試帶來的單價提升，能否跑贏設備折舊與擴產成本。

paras_en: October 6, 2026 (U-Analysis / Industry Data Center report) – Demand for AI chip testing continues to heat up. Yungzhi Technology (6683‑TWO) surged to a limit-up at NT$1,580 in early trading, Siliconware (6257‑TW) jumped more than 6% at one point, and Jingyuan Electronics (2449‑TW) remained in a high‑range oscillation, putting the testing sector back in the market spotlight.

Yungzhi Technology posted September revenue of NT$2.47 billion, up 5.9% month‑over‑month and 33.6% year‑over‑year, marking a historic high for the second consecutive month; Q3 revenue reached NT$7.11 billion, up 9.1% sequentially and 27.9% YoY, setting new records for both the month and the quarter.

Siliconware recorded September revenue of NT$20.89 billion, up roughly 1% month‑over‑month and 26.3% YoY, staying above NT$20 billion for the third straight month; Q3 revenue was NT$61.72 billion, up 5% sequentially and 27% YoY, also a quarterly record.

However, although the three firms are all classified as AI‑chip‑testing concept stocks, the actual business opportunities they capture differ: Yungzhi Technology supplies probe cards and test load boards and benefits from specification upgrades; Siliconware and Jingyuan Electronics provide wafer‑level and finished‑product testing services and benefit from longer test times and higher capacity demand.

Why does testing output rise as AI chips become more complex? Strictly speaking, it’s not that a higher chip price automatically means longer test time; rather, AI chips typically have more cores, higher pin counts, greater power consumption, and more intricate high‑speed interfaces, which raise both the number of test items and reliability requirements.

In addition, AI accelerators and ASIC packages are costly; if defective chips proceed to packaging, not only are the chips lost, but expensive advanced packages and HBM can also be scrapped. Consequently, customers are willing to invest more time and money in wafer testing, burn‑in testing, and final‑product testing.
This leads to two concurrent shifts in the testing industry:
Test interfaces must be upgraded, driving demand for high‑end probe cards and load boards.
Each chip occupies testing equipment for a longer period, pushing up testing capacity needs and service pricing.

Yungzhi Technology: Smallest scale, greatest growth flexibility – Yungzhi mainly offers load boards, probe cards and burn‑in boards that sit between the chip and the tester. As AI chips increase in pin count, power and transmission speed, the test interfaces must be redesigned, causing specifications and prices to rise together.

The company plans to boost overall capacity by at least 50% this year and continue expanding high‑end probe‑card processes; a new ASIC project is expected to contribute gradually, reaching volume production in 2027, and silicon‑photonics‑related probe cards have already been shipped to U.S. customers.

Yungzhi’s advantage lies in its relatively small revenue base – a large ASIC project moving into mass production could markedly lift its growth rate – but its high degree of customization also makes revenue more sensitive to project schedules and the ordering rhythm of major customers.

Siliconware: Multi‑line growth in AI, memory and advanced processes – Siliconware benefits from rising demand for AI, HPC and high‑speed interconnect chip testing, with Q3 related revenue up about 40% YoY; memory revenue also grew 32% YoY, and the firm has begun delivering flagship 2‑nm smartphone application processors, while low‑earth‑orbit satellite chips have entered mass production.
The company launched a new plant in Hukou this year, began mass production in July, and by August had reached roughly 40% of the plant’s total capacity, with further ramp‑up potential.

Compared with Yungzhi, Siliconware’s product lines and customer base are more diversified – beyond AI chips it serves memory, mobile chips, silicon capacitors and LEO satellites – giving it more stable growth, though the explosive impact of any single AI project is relatively limited.

Jingyuan Electronics: Largest AI testing scale, most direct beneficiary – Looking at AI testing revenue size and production certainty, Jingyuan remains the most directly advantaged of the three companies.

Jingyuan posted August revenue of NT$40.8 billion, up 31.6% YoY; revenue for the first eight months totaled NT$294.04 billion, up 35.5% YoY. The market expects AI‑related testing to account for over 70% of its 2026 revenue. The firm also raised its full‑year capital expenditure from NT$393.72 billion to NT$500 billion, a historic high, mainly for testing equipment and plant capacity.

Jingyuan also handles GPU, AI ASIC and high‑performance computing chip testing; as test times lengthen, customers need more machines to maintain output, directly boosting capacity utilization and expansion demand.

However, Jingyuan’s larger scale means its share price and market expectations already reflect part of the AI growth theme; future performance will depend on new equipment rollout, delayed customer product launches and higher depreciation impacting profitability.
Who benefits the most? The answer depends on whether investors prioritize scale or flexibility – In a comprehensive comparison, each company’s growth “gold content” differs:

If the focus is on AI‑testing order volume and direct benefit, Jingyuan is strongest; if the focus is on revenue growth rate and stock‑price elasticity, Yungzhi offers more explosive potential; if product diversification and stable growth are valued, Siliconware appears the most balanced.

In other words, AI‑chip testing does not have a single winner; it involves a full upgrade from test interfaces to testing capacity. The real watch‑points are whether new capital spending can be turned into revenue and whether the price premium from high‑end testing can outpace equipment depreciation and expansion costs.
