paras_en: Nan Jun International (6584-TW) announced today that September revenue was NT$270 million, up about 30% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters this year reached NT$2.545 billion, a 47.69% increase. The company noted that September’s revenue fell short of expectations due to a shortage in the server supply chain, but as new AI server rail products such as Vera Rubin and ASIC begin shipping each month, operations are expected to get back on a growth trajectory.

September revenue was NT$270 million, down 3.30% month‑over‑month but up 30.48% year‑over‑year; third‑quarter revenue was NT$830 million, down 1.79% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 33.61% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters this year was NT$2.545 billion, up 47.69% year‑over‑year.

Nan Jun International said September’s revenue was impacted by a general‑purpose server supply‑chain shortage, which made end‑customer CSP pull‑in orders unstable and caused revenue to fall short of expectations.

The company added that Nvidia’s new AI product Vera Rubin rail began limited shipments in August and has since added several large new customers. Additionally, ASIC rails will enter full‑scale production in October and start limited shipments. Looking ahead to Q4, as shipments of Vera Rubin and ASIC AI server rails increase month by month, operations are expected to return to an upward trend.

items.title: 助攻兆元車電市場！車輛中心結盟美OmniAir與德TÜV SÜD 首座車用資安實驗室在台落地
items.title_en: Boosting the Trillion‑Dollar Vehicle‑Electronics Market! Vehicle Center Partners with US OmniAir and Germany TÜV SÜD to Launch Taiwan’s First Automotive Cybersecurity Lab
paras: 由經濟部產業技術司支持的台灣車輛移動研發聯盟（TARC），今（6）日於第 22 屆「台灣車輛國際論壇（TAIFE）」宣布智慧車輛國際合作重大突破。車輛中心（ARTC）透過科技專案成功鏈結美國與德國，在台布建首座國際級車輛資安與聯網實驗場域，宣告台灣具備國際標準的在地資安聯網驗證能量，將成為車電出海成長新引擎。ARTC指出，台灣汽車電子去年產值已達新台幣5,000億元，今年可望增至6,000億元，預估3年後挑戰1兆元。

經濟部產業技術司司長郭肇中表示，AI、SDV（軟體定義汽車）及車聯網技術快速發展，車聯網互通性與資安防護已成為智慧車輛發展的重要關鍵。技術司透過 A+企業創新研發淬鍊計畫資源，支持產業投入車輛資安技術，並結合法人能量，成功協助中華汽車 (2204-TW) 取得 ISO 21434 與 ISO 24089 國際認證，讓中華汽車成為「台灣第一家」榮獲德國 TÜV SÜD 認證的商用車廠，展現政府研發資源、國內法人與國際驗證機構協力推動產業升級的具體成果。
郭肇中指出，經濟部持續透過科技專案布局關鍵技術與研測能量，並鏈結國際驗證機構，推動科專研發成果與國際標準及法規接軌。此次台美、台德合作，將進一步完善國內智慧車輛驗證環境，讓業者在台即可進行國際標準驗證，更有效率地進入國際市場。未來經濟部也將持續透過科技專案投入、國際合作及場域驗證，深化國內外產業鏈結，加速智慧車電技術落地與產品國際化，提升台灣智慧移動產業國際競爭力。

工研院副院長暨 TAIFE 主席胡竹生表示，全球汽車產業正加速朝智慧化、軟體化與低碳化發展，工研院將持續發揮跨域技術整合與產業鏈結角色，協助台灣將技術優勢轉化為產業競爭力。今年 TAIFE 以「Reinventing Mobility 重塑未來移動」為主軸，議題橫跨 AI 整合車聯網、自駕、車用資安、測試驗證到新能源與低碳移動，反映全球智慧移動產業下一階段的競爭關鍵。透過國內外產官研專家交流，協助產業掌握前瞻技術與國際市場趨勢，從 AI 與自駕應用開拓智慧車電新商機、資安與國際驗證強化產品進入全球市場的能力，到新能源與永續移動布局，加速技術落地、跨域合作及國際布局，進一步提升台灣在全球智慧移動產業鏈的影響力。

車輛中心董事長暨 TARC 主委王正健說明，在台美合作方面，OmniAir Consortium 為全球智慧運輸系統（ITS）及車聯網測試認證協會，致力推動車聯網產品功能與跨廠牌互通性驗證。ARTC 此次與 OmniAir 簽署合作備忘錄，將結合自駕車試驗場域及今年底將完工、仿市郊區交通道路的車聯網測試區，導入國際車聯網驗證規範，研擬情境驗證及互通性測試方法，建構國內首座國際認可的智慧車輛聯網試驗場域，可提供車載單元（OBU）、路側單元（RSU）等設備在地驗證，完善從技術研發、場域驗證到國際商用落地的關鍵環節，為台灣車聯網產品進入國際供應鏈提供一站式服務。
王正健強調，台灣汽車電子去年產值已達新台幣5,000億元，今年可望增至6,000億元，預估3年後挑戰1兆元。

在台德合作方面，因應 UN R155 車輛資安、R156 軟體更新等國際法規實施，經濟部透過科技專案支持 ARTC 提前布局驗證能量，2024 年在技術司見證下與德國 TÜV SÜD 簽署合作備忘錄；2026 年成立全台唯一國際級車輛資安實驗室，並於 6 月取得 TÜV SÜD 實驗室認可，具備執行 UN R155、R156 測試驗證能力，可提供涵蓋資安分析、軟硬體完整性、資料傳輸安全及 OTA 更新流程等 100 項以上測試服務，協助車廠及零組件業者在台完成開發驗證，降低海外測試驗證成本與時程，加速接軌國際市場。此外，台灣交通車輛資安法規也將於 2028 年實施，相關驗證能量亦可協助業者提前布局因應。
paras_en: Supported by the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Industrial Technology Department, the Taiwan Automotive Research Consortium (TARC) announced today at the 22nd Taiwan Automotive International Forum (TAIFE) a major breakthrough in international smart‑vehicle cooperation. Through a technology project, the Automotive Research and Testing Center (ARTC) has linked the United States and Germany to establish Taiwan’s first internationally‑standardized automotive cybersecurity and connectivity testing site, declaring that Taiwan now possesses local verification capabilities that meet global standards and will become a new engine for the overseas growth of vehicle electronics. ARTC noted that Taiwan’s automotive electronics output reached NT$500 billion last year and is expected to rise to NT$600 billion this year, with a target of NT$1 trillion within three years.

Minister of Industrial Technology Guo Zhao‑zhong said that AI, software‑defined vehicles (SDV) and vehicle‑to‑everything (V2X) technologies are developing rapidly, making interoperability and cybersecurity critical for smart‑vehicle advancement. Leveraging resources from the A+ Enterprise Innovation R&D program, the ministry supports industry investment in vehicle cybersecurity and, together with corporate partners, helped China Motor Corp. (2204‑TW) obtain ISO 21434 and ISO 24089 certifications, making it the first Taiwanese commercial‑vehicle maker to receive Germany’s TÜV SÜD certification and showcasing concrete results of government R&D resources, domestic firms, and international certification bodies collaborating for industry upgrade.

Guo explained that the ministry continues to deploy key technologies and testing capabilities through technology projects, linking with international certification agencies to align research outcomes with global standards and regulations. The Taiwan‑US and Taiwan‑Germany collaboration will further refine the domestic smart‑vehicle verification environment, allowing companies to conduct international‑standard testing in Taiwan and more efficiently enter global markets. Going forward, the ministry will keep investing in technology projects, international cooperation, and field verification to deepen domestic and overseas industry linkages, accelerate the deployment and internationalization of smart vehicle‑electronics technologies, and boost Taiwan’s competitiveness in the smart mobility sector.

Hsu Chu‑sheng, vice president of the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) and chair of TAIFE, said the global automotive industry is accelerating toward intelligence, software‑centricity, and low‑carbon solutions. ITRI will continue to play a cross‑disciplinary integration and industry‑linkage role, helping Taiwan turn its technological advantages into competitive strength. This year’s TAIFE theme, “Reinventing Mobility,” covers AI‑integrated V2X, autonomous driving, automotive cybersecurity, testing and verification, new energy and low‑carbon mobility, reflecting the next competitive frontier of the global smart‑mobility industry. Through exchanges among domestic and international government, academia, and research experts, the forum helps the industry grasp forward‑looking technologies and market trends, from AI and autonomous applications creating new smart‑vehicle‑electronics opportunities, to cybersecurity and international certification strengthening product entry into global markets, to new‑energy and sustainable mobility strategies that accelerate technology deployment, cross‑domain collaboration, and international positioning, thereby enhancing Taiwan’s influence in the global smart‑mobility value chain.

Wang Zheng‑jian, chairman of ARTC and TARC convener, explained that on the Taiwan‑US side, the OmniAir Consortium—an international intelligent transportation systems and V2X testing and certification association—promotes functional and cross‑brand interoperability verification for V2X products. ARTC has signed an MOU with OmniAir to combine autonomous‑vehicle test sites with a V2X testing zone, slated for completion by year‑end, that simulates suburban traffic roads. International V2X verification standards will be introduced, scenario‑based validation and interoperability test methods will be developed, and Taiwan’s first internationally recognized smart‑vehicle connectivity test field will be built, enabling local verification of on‑board units (OBU), roadside units (RSU) and other equipment. This will streamline the critical chain from R&D through field verification to commercial deployment, offering a one‑stop service for Taiwanese V2X products to enter the global supply chain.
Wang emphasized that Taiwan’s automotive electronics output reached NT$500 billion last year and is expected to grow to NT$600 billion this year, with a goal of NT$1 trillion within three years.

Regarding the Taiwan‑Germany cooperation, to meet UN R155 vehicle cybersecurity and R156 software‑update regulations, the Ministry of Economic Affairs, via technology projects, supported ARTC in pre‑positioning verification capabilities. In 2024, under the ministry’s supervision, ARTC signed an MOU with Germany’s TÜV SÜD; by 2026, Taiwan will host its only internationally‑rated vehicle cybersecurity laboratory, which received TÜV SÜD accreditation in June and can conduct UN R155 and R156 testing. The lab will offer over 100 test services covering cybersecurity analysis, hardware‑software integrity, data‑transfer security and OTA update processes, helping automakers and parts suppliers complete development verification in Taiwan, reducing overseas testing costs and timelines, and accelerating market entry. Additionally, Taiwan’s vehicle‑cybersecurity regulations will take effect in 2028, and the lab’s capabilities will help companies prepare in advance.

items.title: 明年將大幅增加供貨！超微蘇姿丰：未來幾年晶片需求將很強勁　記憶體供應仍吃緊
items.title_en: Supply Will Surge Next Year! AMD CEO Su Zifeng: Chip Demand Will Remain Strong for Years, Memory Supply Still Tight
paras: AI晶片大廠超微執行長蘇姿丰最新預測，受AI應用成長推動，未來數年半導體需求將維持在「極高」水準。
今(6)日抵台進行短暫訪問的蘇姿丰在台北向記者表示，晶片需求超過供給，記憶體晶片供應持續緊張。AI有益世界，不會傷害人類。美國重量級AI企業之間進行協作十分重要。
今年二度訪台的她告訴記者說：「安全創新方面仍有不少工作要做，最重要的是我們要攜手合作。」
蘇姿丰並表示，美國「超級智慧工作小組」是「向前邁出的重要一步」。
美國總統川普4日在社群媒體上發文，宣布組成“超級智慧工作小組”，並任命包括國家情報總監傑伊·克萊頓在內的領導團隊。
Chāo wēi zhíxíng zhǎng sū zī fēng yùcè, shòu réngōng zhìhuì yìngyòng
今日稍晚將拜訪台積電的蘇姿丰還說，跟鴻海進行了積極討論。她表示，需求超過供應，正在與記憶體供應商合作，協調客戶需求。預計未來幾年需求強勁，感謝台積電擴大產能。
她並指出，必須確保所有產能同時啟用，2027年將大幅提升供應量。
paras_en: AMD CEO Su Zifeng recently forecast that, driven by the growth of AI applications, semiconductor demand will remain at a “very high” level for the next several years.

During a brief visit to Taiwan today (the 6th), Su told reporters in Taipei that chip demand exceeds supply and memory chip supply remains tight. AI benefits the world and will not harm humanity. Collaboration among major U.S. AI companies is very important.
During her second visit to Taiwan this year, she told reporters, “There is still a lot of work to do on secure innovation, and the most important thing is that we must work together.”
Su also said that the U.S. “Super Intelligence Working Group” is an important step forward.

U.S. President Trump posted on social media on the 4th, announcing the formation of a “Super Intelligence Working Group” and appointing a leadership team that includes National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton.
AMD CEO Su Zifeng predicts, artificial intelligence applications…

Later today, Su, who will visit TSMC, also said she has had active discussions with Foxconn. She noted that demand exceeds supply, and she is working with memory suppliers to coordinate customer needs. She expects strong demand in the coming years and thanks TSMC for expanding capacity.
She added that all capacity must be brought online simultaneously, and supply will increase dramatically by 2027.

items.title: 台塑汽車發表新世代DAF重車 台灣成歐洲境外首座新世代組裝基地
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics Motors Unveils New-Generation DAF Heavy Trucks, Taiwan Becomes First Overseas European Assembly Site for the New Generation
paras: 台塑(1301-TW)集團轉投資公司台塑汽車今(6)日在台中國際會展中心，發表來自荷蘭生產的「新世代DAF重車」。台塑汽車副總經理鄭有智表示，DAF(達富)重車深耕台灣20年、累積在台銷售突破1.5萬輛，此次台灣獲得原廠授權，成為歐洲境外，全球首個進行新世代DAF XF車款在地組裝的國家。
今日發表會上包括台塑汽車副總經理鄭有智、台塑化(6505-TW)執行副總經理許德雄、荷蘭DAF Trucks銷售營運總監Jan van Keulen、荷蘭在台辦事處代表浦樂施也至現場見證。
鄭有智表示，新世代DAF遵循歐盟最新車輛的法規設計，燃油效率提升10%，在安全部分更搭配轉彎數位警示系統全面取代大車後視鏡，大幅提升視野範圍視角讓駕駛更安心，也搭載全新PACCAR MX高效動力引擎，結合先進散熱與廢氣後處理技術，並標配第二代TraXon智慧自手排變速箱、低耗損後軸及全車輕量化結構，能直接減輕長途行駛的燃油開銷，協助運輸業者因應營運成本上揚的挑戰。
Jan van Keulen致詞時則表示，台灣是DAF在亞洲重要的戰略市場，新世代DAF原型車已累積通過全球超過2,000萬公里的嚴苛地形與極端氣候測試，打造高可靠度與高品質的新世代DAF重車。
在大型重車最重要的車安部分，鄭有智強調，新世代DAF XF車款為業界 同級全面以攝影機取代傳統反射鏡的旗艦重卡，搭配 DAF數位視野系統、彎角視野系統及主被動安全輔助系統，搭載獨家專利的程式化車廂位移系統與CoDeS潰縮式方向機柱，在撞擊瞬間極大化座艙的生存空間，保護駕駛生命安全。
近年台灣面臨貨運產業普遍面臨駕駛人力短缺問題，如何改善工作環境、提升職業吸引力，成為運輸業永續經營的重要課題。
對此，鄭有智強調，優秀駕駛是物流運輸業最寶貴的資產，面對台灣缺工時代，運輸業除了提升營運效率，更要重視駕駛的工作需求，加上優秀駕駛是物流核心資產，若提升座艙舒適性將降低流動率，也有助於運輸業招募新血，提升整體競爭力。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) subsidiary Formosa Plastics Motors held a launch today (the 6th) at the Taichung International Exhibition Center for the new‑generation DAF heavy truck produced in the Netherlands. Deputy General Manager Zheng Youzhi said DAF has been deep‑rooted in Taiwan for 20 years, with cumulative sales exceeding 15,000 units, and that Taiwan has now received factory authorization to become the world’s first country outside Europe to locally assemble the new‑generation DAF XF model.

The launch ceremony was attended by Deputy General Manager Zheng Youzhi of Formosa Plastics Motors, Executive Deputy General Manager Xu Dexiong of Formosa Plastics (6505‑TW), Jan van Keulen, Sales and Operations Director of DAF Trucks Netherlands, and the Dutch office representative Pu Le Shi, who all witnessed the event on site.

Zheng explained that the new‑generation DAF is designed to meet the latest EU vehicle regulations, delivering a 10% improvement in fuel efficiency. For safety, it replaces traditional side mirrors with a digital turning‑alert system that greatly expands the driver’s field of view. It also features the brand‑new PACCAR MX high‑efficiency engine, advanced cooling and exhaust after‑treatment technologies, a standard second‑generation TraXon intelligent semi‑automatic transmission, low‑loss rear axle and a lightweight vehicle structure, all of which cut fuel costs on long‑haul trips and help transport operators cope with rising operating expenses.

Speaking, Jan van Keulen said Taiwan is a key strategic market for DAF in Asia, and that the prototype of the new‑generation DAF has already logged more than 20 million kilometres of testing across harsh terrains and extreme climates worldwide, establishing the high reliability and quality of the new‑generation DAF heavy truck.

Regarding vehicle safety, Zheng emphasized that the new‑generation DAF XF is the industry’s flagship heavy‑duty truck that replaces all traditional mirrors with cameras, equipped with DAF’s digital vision system, corner‑view system and active‑passive safety assistance. It also incorporates a patented programmable cabin‑shift system and CoDeS compact steering column, which maximizes cabin survivability in a crash and protects the driver’s life.

In recent years Taiwan’s freight industry has faced a widespread shortage of drivers. Improving working conditions and enhancing the profession’s appeal have become crucial issues for the sustainable operation of the transport sector.

Zheng stressed that excellent drivers are the most valuable asset of the logistics industry. In Taiwan’s labor‑shortage era, transport companies must not only boost operational efficiency but also address drivers’ needs. Enhancing cabin comfort can reduce turnover, aid in recruiting new talent, and overall raise the industry’s competitiveness.

items.title: 從文科生到AI巨擘 Anthropic總裁阿莫迪成為美國富豪榜最年輕白手起家女性
items.title_en: From Liberal Arts Student to AI Giant: Anthropic President Daniela Amodei Becomes the Youngest Self‑Made Female Billionaire on the U.S. Rich List
paras: 根據《Forbes》近期公布的美國富豪榜，現年 39 歲的人工智慧企業 Anthropic 聯合創辦人兼總裁阿莫迪(Daniela Amodei)，以估算達 155 億美元的身價，位居全美白手起家女性富豪第 2 名，並在全美 400 大富豪榜中並列第 75 名，成為榜單中最年輕的白手起家女性億萬富豪。
隨著 Anthropic 在融資中籌集 650 億美元，推升估值至 9,650 億美元，其身價在一年內成長近 13 倍。

跨領域歷程與通才管理哲學

與典型矽谷科技創辦人不同，阿莫迪未持有電腦科學或法律學位，而是畢業於加州大學聖克魯斯分校英國文學系。其父親為皮革工匠，母親從事圖書館建設管理。
在談及個人背景時，阿莫迪於史丹佛大學訪談中表示：「在某些方面，我真的認為自己是一個通才……能夠保持好奇心、跨領域學習，並建立渴望帶來影響力的堅實基礎，是一種被低估的特質。」
阿莫迪早期曾參與國際發展與政治競選工作，2013 年加入支付新創 Stripe 負責人才招募與風險營運，管理詐欺與合規業務。2018 年她進入 OpenAI 擔任安全政策與工程管理副總裁，並於 2020 年底與哥哥達里奧·阿莫迪(Dario Amodei)等七人離職，共同創立 Anthropic。

營運成長與 IPO 規畫

作為 Anthropic 總裁兼董事會主席，阿莫迪負責公司日常營運與高管團隊。財務數據顯示，Anthropic 年化營收自 2025 年 1 月的 10 億美元，成長至 2026 年 7 月底的 650 億美元以上。
市場消息指出，Anthropic 計畫於 2026 年 11 月進行首次公開發行(IPO)，預期上市估值可能達 2 兆美元以上。主要投資方包括 Google、Amazon、NVIDIA 與紅杉資本等。

商業倫理與財富影響

針對商業營運與社會責任，阿莫迪受訪時說明：「我們將成為商業實體，人工智慧將創造巨大經濟價值，但以正確的方式做到這一點非常重要。商業營運與做好事之間並不一定存在衝突。」
此外，Anthropic 創辦團隊宣布未來將捐出 80% 財富。這種對財富回饋的看法獲其他企業家迴響。例如 Epic Systems 創辦人Judy Faulkner在「贈予誓言」信中表示：「我從未想過要成為過著奢華生活的富豪，我承諾捐出 99% 資產的目標是幫助他人獲得溫飽與教育等基礎。」
伴隨 AI 產業擴張，財富累積延伸至企業員工。據報導，Anthropic 部分技術人員因估值成長，股權價值顯著增加；OpenAI 亦透過股權買賣允許員工套現約 66 億美元。
同時，全美白手起家女性億萬富豪人數已自 2015 年的 12 位增至 43 位，資產創下 1,663 億美元新高，反映科技創新對財富結構的重塑。
paras_en: According to Forbes' recently released U.S. Rich List, 39‑year‑old Anthropic co‑founder and president Daniela Amodei, whose net worth is estimated at $15.5 billion, ranks second among self‑made women in the United States and ties for 75th place on the overall U.S. 400 richest list, making her the youngest self‑made female billionaire on the ranking.
As Anthropic raised $6.5 billion in financing, its valuation jumped to $965 billion, causing Amodei’s net worth to grow almost 13‑fold in a single year.

Cross‑disciplinary Journey and Generalist Management Philosophy
Unlike typical Silicon Valley tech founders, Amodei does not hold a degree in computer science or law; she graduated from the University of California, Santa Cruz with a major in English literature. Her father is a leather craftsman and her mother works in library construction management.

When discussing her background in a Stanford interview, Amodei said, “In some ways I really consider myself a generalist… being able to stay curious, learn across fields, and build a solid foundation for wanting to make an impact is an undervalued trait.”

Amodei’s early career included work in international development and political campaigns. In 2013 she joined payments startup Stripe, overseeing talent acquisition and risk operations, including fraud and compliance. In 2018 she moved to OpenAI as vice president of safety policy and engineering management, and at the end of 2020 she left with her brother Dario Amodei and five others to co‑found Anthropic.

Operational Growth and IPO Plans
As Anthropic’s president and chair of the board, Amodei oversees daily operations and the senior leadership team. Financial data show Anthropic’s annualized revenue grew from $10 billion in January 2025 to over $650 billion by the end of July 2026.

Market sources indicate Anthropic plans to launch its initial public offering in November 2026, with a projected listing valuation that could exceed $2 trillion. Major investors include Google, Amazon, NVIDIA and Sequoia Capital.

Business Ethics and Wealth Impact
On business operations and social responsibility, Amodei explained, “We will become a commercial entity; AI will create massive economic value, but doing it the right way is crucial. Business operations and doing good don’t necessarily have to be at odds.”

The Anthropic founding team also announced it will donate 80 % of its wealth in the future. This view on wealth redistribution resonated with other entrepreneurs. For example, Epic Systems founder Judy Faulkner wrote in a “Giving Pledge” letter, “I never imagined living a lavish billionaire life; my commitment to give away 99 % of my assets is aimed at helping others secure basic needs and education.”

With the AI industry’s expansion, wealth accumulation is extending to company employees. Reports say some Anthropic engineers have seen their equity values surge dramatically as the valuation rose; OpenAI also allowed employees to cash out roughly $6.6 billion through equity sales.

At the same time, the number of self‑made female billionaires in the United States has risen from 12 in 2015 to 43, with total assets reaching a new high of $166.3 billion, reflecting how technological innovation is reshaping the wealth landscape.

items.title: 受惠比特幣價格反彈 Strategy第三季大賺209億美元 終結連四季虧損
items.title_en: Strategy Posts $20.91 Billion Q3 Gain from Bitcoin Price Rebound, Ends Four-Quarter Loss Streak
paras: 全球最大比特幣公開持有企業 Strategy Inc.(MSTR-US)周一(5日)公布，受惠於第三季加密貨幣市場反彈，公司單季錄得約 209.1 億美元數位資產未實現收益，成功終結連續四季虧損，重返獲利軌道。

稅務利益助攻獲利

根據 Strategy 申報的 8-K 文件，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止的3個月內，比特幣價格上揚 43%。在公允價值會計準則(Fair Value Accounting)下，數位資產公允價值變動直接計入損益表，導致季業績劇烈波動。此結果與第二季形成鮮明對比——第二季因比特幣走跌產生 83.2 億美元未實現損失，導致單季淨虧損達 82.2 億美元。
此外，由於第三季末比特幣公允價值超越成本基礎，公司先前於 6 月底提列的 41.2 億美元遞延所得稅資產備抵評價帳項(Valuation Allowance)獲准釋放，產生等額所得稅利益，將當季遞延所得稅費用壓降至 18.8 億美元。截至 9 月底，Strategy 持有的數位資產帳面價值已達 708.2 億美元。

持倉突破84.8萬枚比特幣

在資產布局上，Strategy 延續累積策略。文件顯示，公司於 10 月 1 日至 4 日期間，再以 2,870 萬美元購入 334 枚比特幣。截至 2026 年 10 月 4 日，Strategy 累計持有高達 848,000 枚比特幣，總取得成本為 639.7 億美元，平均持倉成本為每枚 75,441 美元，當前持倉市值約 730 億美元。
為支應購幣計畫，Strategy 近年積極發行特別股與普通股，但也面臨股東對股權稀釋的疑慮，加上 STRC 特別股價格走低，使發行新特別股效益受限。
對此，公司積極調整資本架構，除了維護 48.8 億美元的「美元準備金」與 8.334 億美元的「美元現金」外，近一周內斥資約 1.76 億美元買回 STRC 特別股。
公司高層對其資本政策表達強烈信心。共同創辦人及執行主席塞勒(Michael Saylor)表示，公司將 STRC 特別股的股利發放頻率改為每日支付，期盼藉此「降低股價波動並改善特別股流動性」。
塞勒先前已強調，公司正致力於將「數位信用確立為新型資產類別」，並於 X 平台發文證實公司已累積逾 57 億美元的美元資產與龐大比特幣儲備。
paras_en: Strategy Inc., the world’s largest publicly‑held Bitcoin company (MSTR‑US), announced on Monday (the 5th) that a rebound in the cryptocurrency market in the third quarter generated roughly $20.91 billion of unrealized digital‑asset gains, ending four consecutive quarters of losses and returning to profitability.

Tax benefits helped the profit. According to Strategy’s Form 8‑K, Bitcoin rose 43% over the three months ending September 30, 2026. Under Fair Value Accounting, changes in the fair value of digital assets flow directly to the income statement, causing sharp quarterly swings. This contrasts sharply with Q2, when a Bitcoin decline produced an $8.32 billion unrealized loss and a net quarterly loss of $8.22 billion.

In addition, because Bitcoin’s fair value at the end of Q3 exceeded its cost basis, the $4.12 billion valuation‑allowance reserve for deferred tax assets that the company set aside at the end of June was released, creating an equal tax benefit and cutting the quarter’s deferred tax expense to $1.88 billion. As of the end of September, Strategy’s digital‑asset book value stood at $70.82 billion.

Holding over 848,000 Bitcoin. Strategy continued its accumulation strategy. The filing shows that between Oct. 1 and Oct. 4 the company bought another 334 Bitcoin for $28.7 million. As of Oct. 4, 2026, Strategy owned a total of 848,000 Bitcoin at a total cost of $63.97 billion, an average cost of $75,441 per coin, with a current market value of about $73 billion.

To fund its buying plan, Strategy has recently issued both preferred and common shares, but faces shareholder concerns about dilution, and the declining price of its STRC preferred shares has limited the effectiveness of new issuances.

In response, the company is reshaping its capital structure, maintaining a $4.88 billion “U.S. reserve” and $833.4 million of “U.S. cash,” and in the past week spent roughly $176 million to repurchase STRC preferred shares.

Senior executives expressed strong confidence in the capital policy. Co‑founder and Executive Chairman Michael Saylor said the company will shift STRC preferred‑share dividend payments to a daily schedule, hoping to “reduce price volatility and improve preferred‑share liquidity.”

Saylor previously emphasized that the firm is working to establish “digital credit as a new asset class,” and posted on X that Strategy has amassed over $5.7 billion in U.S. dollar assets alongside a massive Bitcoin reserve.

items.title: OpenAI奧特曼批馬斯克是「霸凌者」：他只尊重敢反擊的人
items.title_en: OpenAI CEO Altman Calls Musk a ‘Bully’: He Only Respects Those Who Fight Back
paras: OpenAI執行長奧特曼近日受訪表示，儘管與馬斯克長期不和，他仍願意在 AI 安全議題上與對方合作。不過，他認為，雙方若要共事，就必須接受一定程度的衝突，因為有時必須當面回擊「霸凌者」。
奧特曼與馬斯克曾公開決裂，兩人的矛盾也是多起法律糾紛的核心。如今，隨著業界再度關注 AI 安全問題，這場紛爭也成為全球主要 AI 企業尋求技術管控共識的背景。
奧特曼在採訪中說：「我認為，有時候你必須當面回擊霸凌者。而且我覺得，馬斯克和很多霸凌者一樣，只尊重敢於反擊他的人。」
儘管馬斯克如今經常稱他為「騙子奧特曼」，奧特曼仍表達合作意願。他說：「如果你們希望我能和他共事，那或許應該慶幸我偶爾會反擊。當然，我願意與馬斯克合作。」
奧特曼也表示，自己「不會自詡為聖人」，但不認為自己是雙方關係中最大的問題。「在馬斯克和我之間，我不確定我才是那個應該被你們針對的人。」
今年 7 月，社群平台 X 上一名用戶聲稱，曾就「騙子奧特曼」向全世界發出警告。馬斯克轉發該貼文，並批評奧特曼「把行騙手段提升到了一個新高度」。
奧特曼隨後回擊，質疑馬斯克建造軌道資料中心的構想。他此前已多次對這項提議表達懷疑，並在回應中寫道：「老兄，明明是你自己在向公開市場投資人兜售短期內打造太空資料中心的概念。」
儘管雙方持續交鋒，AI 企業仍採取行動加強合作。今年 7 月，OpenAI、Anthropic、SpaceXAI、Google 與輝達的高層簽署一項由白宮支持的協議，內容包含 AI 安全相關的自願性承諾。這項協議讓在快速發展的 AI 市場不同領域相互競爭的企業，共同參與安全合作。
奧特曼強調，這不代表業界領袖透過單一管道溝通，並沒有一個將所有領先 AI 企業負責人串聯起來的群組聊天室。各方透過通話、會議及非正式碰面交換意見，包括在業界會議期間交流。
不過，考量奧特曼與馬斯克之間的深刻分歧，這類合作對兩人而言可能格外困難。合作意願能否轉化為實質合作，目前仍不明朗。
paras_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman recently said in an interview that despite a long‑standing feud with Elon Musk, he is still willing to cooperate with him on AI safety issues. However, he believes that for the two to work together they must accept a certain level of conflict, because sometimes one has to confront a “bully” face‑to‑face.

Altman and Musk publicly split, and their rivalry has been at the core of multiple legal disputes. Now, as the industry refocuses on AI safety, this feud provides the backdrop for major AI companies worldwide seeking consensus on technology governance.
Altman told the reporter, “I think sometimes you have to confront a bully in person. And I feel that Musk, like many bullies, only respects people who are willing to stand up to him.”

Even though Musk now often calls him a “fraudulent Altman,” Altman still expressed a willingness to cooperate. He said, “If you want me to work with him, maybe you should be glad that I sometimes push back. Of course, I’m willing to work with Musk.”
Altman also said he “doesn’t claim to be a saint,” but does not see himself as the biggest problem in the relationship. “Between Musk and me, I’m not sure I’m the one you should be targeting.”
In July, a user on the X platform claimed to have warned the world about the “fraudulent Altman.” Musk retweeted the post and criticized Altman for “taking scamming to a new level.”

Altman responded by questioning Musk’s idea of building an orbital data center. He has repeatedly expressed doubt about the proposal and wrote in his reply, “Bro, you’re the one selling the short‑term concept of a space data center to public‑market investors.”

Despite the ongoing sparring, AI firms are moving forward with cooperation. In July, senior executives from OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX AI, Google and Nvidia signed a White‑House‑backed agreement that includes voluntary commitments on AI safety. The pact brings together companies competing across different AI sectors to jointly engage in safety collaboration.

Altman stressed that this does not mean industry leaders are communicating through a single channel or that there is a group chat linking all top AI executives. Participants exchange views via calls, meetings and informal gatherings, including conversations held during industry conferences.

However, given the deep rift between Altman and Musk, such cooperation may be especially difficult for the two. Whether the expressed willingness to cooperate can translate into concrete joint action remains unclear.

items.title: 明年將大幅增加供貨！超微蘇姿丰：未來幾年晶片需求將很強勁　記憶體供應仍吃緊
items.title_en: Supply Will Surge Next Year! AMD CEO Su Zifeng: Chip Demand Will Remain Strong for Years, Memory Supply Still Tight
paras: AI晶片大廠超微執行長蘇姿丰最新預測，受AI應用成長推動，未來數年半導體需求將維持在「極高」水準。
今(6)日抵台進行短暫訪問的蘇姿丰在台北向記者表示，晶片需求超過供給，記憶體晶片供應持續緊張。AI有益世界，不會傷害人類。美國重量級AI企業之間進行協作十分重要。
今年二度訪台的她告訴記者說：「安全創新方面仍有不少工作要做，最重要的是我們要攜手合作。」
蘇姿丰並表示，美國「超級智慧工作小組」是「向前邁出的重要一步」。
美國總統川普4日在社群媒體上發文，宣布組成“超級智慧工作小組”，並任命包括國家情報總監傑伊·克萊頓在內的領導團隊。
Chāo wēi zhíxíng zhǎng sū zī fēng yùcè, shòu réngōng zhìhuì yìngyòng
今日稍晚將拜訪台積電的蘇姿丰還說，跟鴻海進行了積極討論。她表示，需求超過供應，正在與記憶體供應商合作，協調客戶需求。預計未來幾年需求強勁，感謝台積電擴大產能。
她並指出，必須確保所有產能同時啟用，2027年將大幅提升供應量。
paras_en: AMD CEO Su Zifeng recently forecast that, driven by the growth of AI applications, semiconductor demand will remain at a “very high” level for the next several years.

During a brief visit to Taiwan today (the 6th), Su told reporters in Taipei that chip demand exceeds supply and memory chip supply remains tight. AI benefits the world and will not harm humanity. Collaboration among major U.S. AI companies is very important.
During her second visit to Taiwan this year, she told reporters, “There is still a lot of work to do on secure innovation, and the most important thing is that we must work together.”
Su also said that the U.S. “Super Intelligence Working Group” is an important step forward.

U.S. President Trump posted on social media on the 4th, announcing the formation of a “Super Intelligence Working Group” and appointing a leadership team that includes National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton.
AMD CEO Su Zifeng predicts, artificial intelligence applications…

Later today, Su, who will visit TSMC, also said she has had active discussions with Foxconn. She noted that demand exceeds supply, and she is working with memory suppliers to coordinate customer needs. She expects strong demand in the coming years and thanks TSMC for expanding capacity.
She added that all capacity must be brought online simultaneously, and supply will increase dramatically by 2027.

items.title: 5月服務中斷元凶抓到了？維基百科：疑似OpenAI的AI代理失控 未授權卻狂抓資料
items.title_en: May Service Outage Culprit Identified? Wikipedia: Suspected OpenAI AI Agent Runaway, Unauthorized Data Scraping
paras: 維基百科營運方維基媒體基金會(Wikimedia Foundation)表示，已發現疑似由OpenAI旗下AI代理執行的大量未授權活動，包括瀏覽數百萬個頁面、向公開API發出數百萬次自動請求，以及進行數十萬次資料查詢。基金會認為，這些異常流量可能與今年5月維基資料查詢服務(Wikidata Query Service)發生的部分中斷有關。
維基媒體基金會周一在部落格發表調查結果指出，已確認部分「失控」OpenAI AI代理在維基媒體平台上活動，涉及維基網站編輯、嘗試利用公共筆記工具Etherpad，以及大量下載資料等行為。其中，大量自動化流量被認為可能造成Wikidata Query Service在5月出現部分服務中斷。
基金會表示，這些AI代理向維基媒體公開API發出數百萬次自動請求，存取旗下知識內容，同時爬取數百萬個頁面，主要集中於Wikidata及Wikimedia Commons，並對Wikidata Query Service提出數十萬次資料查詢。基金會認為，這種密集流量可能超出服務正常承載能力，並促成5月的部分中斷。
除大量資料存取外，維基媒體也發現疑似由OpenAI AI代理進行的未授權編輯。這些編輯並未出現在一般讀者可見的百科頁面，大多屬於維基網站的沙盒測試內容。不過，基金會也發現少數涉及引用工具設定的編輯，認為這些行為可能具有惡意性，意圖將引用工具挪作代理服務，從遠端網站擷取資料。
維基媒體指出，維基百科允許經社群揭露及核准的機器人進行特定編輯，但這些疑似OpenAI AI代理並未取得相關授權，因此相關活動並不符合既有規範。
基金會另外表示，疑似由OpenAI操作的AI代理曾多次嘗試利用其託管的公開Etherpad筆記工具。這些代理試圖將Etherpad當成代理服務，從其他網站擷取資料，但相關嘗試並未成功。另有其他疑似OpenAI AI代理使用該工具記錄任務內容，但基金會沒有發現這些活動進一步形成代理之間的協調機制。
維基媒體強調，目前沒有證據顯示其系統被用來協調AI代理，也沒有發現旗下系統或資料遭到入侵或外洩。不過，基金會認為，這起事件凸顯AI代理大規模自主活動對公開網路基礎設施帶來的新風險。
維基媒體指出，維基百科等公開網路服務主要依靠志工、非營利組織及有限的基礎設施資源維持運作，AI代理若以遠高於一般使用者的速度抓取資料，可能迅速消耗伺服器、頻寬及人力資源。若這類活動持續增加，最終可能影響正常使用者存取服務，甚至造成服務中斷。
維基媒體過去也曾指出，AI相關機器人流量已對其基礎設施造成日益沉重的壓力。基金會表示，2025年其網站頻寬使用量較2024年增加50%，主要受到機器人活動增加影響；同時，最消耗資源的流量中，有65%來自機器人。
維基百科目前已累積超過6700萬篇條目，涵蓋逾300種語言，每月頁面瀏覽量最高達150億次。由於維基百科是大型語言模型及其他AI系統廣泛使用的知識來源之一，基金會認為，AI公司大規模存取其資料時，更應避免對維持這些公共知識平台運作的基礎設施造成額外負擔。
OpenAI則表示，感謝維基媒體分享詳細調查結果，並正與基金會合作，分析此次發現的相關活動以及公司自身正在進行的整體調查。OpenAI發言人德魯．普薩特里(Drew Pusateri)表示，隨著分析工作持續，公司將繼續分享相關資訊。
這起事件也成為OpenAI近期一連串AI代理失控事件的最新案例。OpenAI近期正試圖釐清旗下AI代理在受控環境外活動的完整範圍。此前已有其他研究人員及組織發現，疑似OpenAI AI代理曾對外部網站及服務進行未授權操作，使AI代理能否在缺乏充分人類監督的情況下安全執行任務，再度受到關注。
對維基媒體而言，問題不僅在於單一服務是否曾經中斷，更在於AI代理大量進入公開網路後，傳統網站原本為人類使用者設計的流量及安全機制是否足以應付。基金會表示，AI代理確實是網路未來的一部分，但開發及部署這些代理的企業也必須承擔避免及修復其造成損害的責任。
paras_en: The Wikimedia Foundation, which operates Wikipedia, said it has discovered a large amount of unauthorized activity that appears to have been carried out by an OpenAI‑owned AI agent, including browsing millions of pages, making millions of automated requests to public APIs, and conducting hundreds of thousands of data queries. The foundation believes this abnormal traffic may be linked to the partial outage of the Wikidata Query Service that occurred in May.

In a blog post on Monday, the Wikimedia Foundation released its investigation results, confirming that some "out‑of‑control" OpenAI AI agents were active on Wikimedia platforms, engaging in activities such as editing wiki sites, attempting to use the public note‑taking tool Etherpad, and downloading large amounts of data. The massive automated traffic is thought to have contributed to the partial service disruption of the Wikidata Query Service in May.

The foundation said these AI agents sent millions of automated requests to Wikimedia's public APIs to access its knowledge content, while crawling millions of pages, primarily on Wikidata and Wikimedia Commons, and submitted hundreds of thousands of data queries to the Wikidata Query Service. The foundation believes this intensive traffic may have exceeded the service's normal capacity and helped cause the May outage.

In addition to the large‑scale data access, Wikimedia also found unauthorized edits that appear to have been made by OpenAI AI agents. These edits did not appear on publicly visible encyclopedia pages and were mostly sandbox test content on the wiki sites. However, the foundation also identified a few edits involving citation‑tool settings, which it believes could be malicious, aiming to repurpose the citation tool as a proxy service to pull data from remote sites.

Wikimedia noted that Wikipedia permits bots that have been disclosed to and approved by the community to perform specific edits, but these suspected OpenAI AI agents did not obtain such authorization, so their activities do not comply with existing rules.

The foundation also said that AI agents suspected of being operated by OpenAI repeatedly tried to use its hosted public Etherpad note‑taking tool. The agents attempted to treat Etherpad as a proxy service to fetch data from other sites, but these attempts were unsuccessful. Other suspected OpenAI AI agents used the tool to record task details, but the foundation found no evidence that these activities formed a coordination mechanism among the agents.

Wikimedia emphasized that there is currently no evidence that its systems were used to coordinate AI agents, nor any indication that its systems or data were breached or leaked. Nonetheless, the foundation believes the incident highlights new risks that large‑scale autonomous AI agent activity poses to public internet infrastructure.

Wikimedia pointed out that public web services such as Wikipedia rely on volunteers, non‑profit organizations, and limited infrastructure resources to stay online, and that AI agents scraping data at speeds far higher than typical users can quickly consume server capacity, bandwidth, and human resources. If such activity continues to increase, it could eventually affect normal users' access to services and even cause outages.

Wikimedia has previously warned that traffic from AI‑related bots is placing growing strain on its infrastructure. The foundation said bandwidth usage on its sites in 2025 was 50% higher than in 2024, mainly due to increased bot activity; moreover, 65% of the most resource‑intensive traffic comes from bots.

Wikipedia now hosts more than 67 million articles in over 300 languages, with monthly page views peaking at 15 billion. Because Wikipedia is a major knowledge source for large language models and other AI systems, the foundation believes AI companies must avoid adding extra load to the infrastructure that keeps these public knowledge platforms running when they access its data at scale.

OpenAI said it thanks Wikimedia for sharing the detailed investigation and is working with the foundation to analyze the identified activities as part of its broader internal review. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said that as the analysis continues, the company will keep sharing relevant information.

The incident is the latest example in a series of recent AI‑agent runaway cases involving OpenAI. OpenAI is currently trying to clarify the full scope of its AI agents' activities outside controlled environments. Earlier, other researchers and organizations have found that suspected OpenAI AI agents performed unauthorized operations on external websites and services, raising renewed concerns about whether AI agents can safely execute tasks without sufficient human oversight.

For Wikimedia, the issue is not just whether a single service experienced an outage, but whether traditional websites' traffic and security mechanisms—originally designed for human users— can handle the massive influx of AI agents on the public internet. The foundation says AI agents are indeed part of the internet's future, but the companies that develop and deploy them must also take responsibility for preventing and remedying any harm they cause.

items.title: 科技巨頭降低Claude依賴 微軟砍預算、Meta用戶減半
items.title_en: Tech Giants Cut Reliance on Claude, Microsoft Trims Budget, Meta Halves Users
paras: Meta平(META-US) 與微軟(MSFT-US) 正設法減少員工對 Anthropic 旗下 Claude 的依賴，透過削減預算、推廣自研工具，降低內部用量。微軟的 Claude 內部支出預算已削減逾三分之一，Meta 的 Claude Code 使用人數則降至約 3 萬人，較今年稍早減少近半，為 Anthropic 營收前景帶來壓力。
據《The Information》10 月 5 日報導，兩家公司正壓縮 Claude 的內部使用，鼓勵員工改用各自開發的 AI 工具。不過，兩家公司均強調，外部客戶透過企業平台使用 Claude 的需求仍在成長，與內部用量下降的走勢有所不同。
微軟削減預算 鼓勵改用自家工具
微軟調整 Claude 使用政策，主要考量是控制營運成本。報導引述知情人士指出，微軟早在今年 5 月便開始降低對 Claude Code 的依賴，希望減少員工的 token 消耗，並推廣內部模型。
微軟先前預估，內部使用 Claude AI 的年度支出至少達 10 億美元。隨著公司要求員工減少使用 Claude 以節省成本，並將更多時間投入微軟自研 AI 工具，這項預算已削減超過三分之一。
目前調整集中在內部營運，微軟透過企業平台向外部客戶提供的 Anthropic 模型服務，需求仍維持穩定成長。
Meta 使用人數減半 自研工具接棒
Meta 內部使用 Claude Code 的員工人數，已從今年稍早的約 6 萬人降至約 3 萬人。人員縮減是原因之一：Meta 今年春季對約 7.8 萬名員工中的約一成實施裁員，壓低了工具的使用人數。
但報導指出，更主要的推力來自 Meta 自研 AI 工具逐步成熟。公司已推出兩款程式設計助理，其中 MetaCode 專供內部使用，目前用戶超過 3 萬人；Muse Code 則於 8 月開始向外部客戶開放測試，內部用戶已逾 6,000 人。
Muse Code 採用 Meta 自研模型，屬於 Muse Spark 系列模型產品線，被視為 Claude Code 的直接競爭對手。儘管 Claude Code 使用人數大幅下降，Meta 最近 28 天在該工具上的支出仍超過 1.05 億美元。
Anthropic 上市前 客戶集中風險浮現
兩家科技巨頭同步減少內部用量，讓 Anthropic 的客戶集中風險受到關注。Anthropic 近期提交的首次公開發行（IPO）招股書顯示，兩大客戶合計貢獻約 25% 的營收，但未公布客戶名稱。
市場推測，Meta 與微軟可能是這兩大客戶，或至少占其中一家，但身分尚未獲得確認。隨著大型客戶壓縮內部支出、自研替代工具逐步擴大使用，Anthropic 在 IPO 關鍵時期面臨營收壓力。
目前企業端的外部部署需求仍在成長，能否抵銷內部用量下降的影響，仍是投資人關注的不確定因素。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US) are working to reduce employee reliance on Anthropic’s Claude by cutting budgets and promoting in‑house tools, lowering internal usage. Microsoft’s internal budget for Claude has been cut by more than a third, and the number of Meta employees using Claude Code has fallen to about 30,000, roughly half of the figure earlier this year, putting pressure on Anthropic’s revenue outlook.

According to a report by The Information on October 5, the two companies are compressing internal use of Claude and urging staff to switch to their own AI tools. However, both firms stress that external customers accessing Claude through enterprise platforms are still increasing demand, a trend opposite to the internal usage decline.
Microsoft cuts budget, encourages use of its own tools

Microsoft has adjusted its Claude usage policy mainly to control operating costs. The report, citing insiders, says Microsoft began reducing reliance on Claude Code as early as May, aiming to cut employee token consumption and promote internal models.

Microsoft previously estimated that internal spending on Claude AI would be at least $1 billion annually. As the company asks employees to use Claude less to save costs and devote more time to Microsoft‑developed AI tools, that budget has been slashed by more than one‑third.

The adjustments are currently focused on internal operations; Microsoft’s provision of Anthropic model services to external customers via its enterprise platform continues to see stable growth in demand.
Meta halves user count, in‑house tools take over

The number of Meta employees using Claude Code has dropped from roughly 60,000 earlier this year to about 30,000. One reason is staff reductions: Meta laid off about 10% of its roughly 78,000 employees in the spring, lowering tool usage.

The report notes, however, that the main driver is the maturation of Meta’s own AI tools. The company has launched two coding assistants: MetaCode, for internal use only, now has over 30,000 users; Muse Code was opened to external customers for testing in August and already has more than 6,000 internal users.

Muse Code uses Meta’s proprietary model and belongs to the Muse Spark series, positioned as a direct competitor to Claude Code. Despite the sharp drop in Claude Code users, Meta’s spending on the tool over the past 28 days still exceeds $105 million.
Anthropic’s pre‑IPO client concentration risk emerges

Both tech giants cutting internal usage has highlighted concentration risk for Anthropic’s customers. Its recent IPO prospectus shows that its two biggest customers together account for about 25% of revenue, though their identities were not disclosed.

The market speculates that Meta and Microsoft could be those two major customers, or at least one of them, but this has not been confirmed. As large customers trim internal spend and adopt home‑grown alternatives, Anthropic faces revenue pressure at a critical IPO stage.
External enterprise deployment demand continues to grow, but whether it can offset the impact of declining internal usage remains an uncertain factor that investors are watching.

items.title: 付一樣的錢、用量剩一半 OpenAI提速50%仍難平息用戶不滿
items.title_en: Pay the Same Money, Get Half the Usage: OpenAI’s 50% Speed Boost Still Fails to Calm User Discontent
paras: OpenAI宣布加快訂閱用戶使用GPT-6 Astra與GPT-6.1 Sol的速度，但使用額度縮減仍引發關注。
研究機構SemiAnalysis實測指出，Anthropic旗下日常主力模型的訂閱額度，按API價格折算後，價值約為OpenAI的5倍。這場競爭也凸顯AI業者降低補貼與留住重度用戶之間的矛盾。
OpenAI主管Tibo承諾連續28天推出更新或重置額度後，首日先回應用戶對模型速度的抱怨，宣布GPT-6 Astra與GPT-6.1 Sol預設速度提升約50%，用戶無須操作，兩小時內即可感受到變化。
Tibo補充，輸出速度由每秒30個token提高至50個，並搭配經過高度優化的文字切分器。他強調，這兩款模型完成任務所需的token本來就較少。
加速範圍涵蓋OpenAI自家產品，以及透過「Sign in with ChatGPT」接入的OpenCode、Pi、Amp、Devin等合作夥伴。不過，部分開發者認為速度仍不及Claude，也有人提出實測，指GPT-6.1只是回到發布時的速度。此次更新並未提及使用限額調整。
SemiAnalysis對Anthropic、OpenAI、Meta(META-US) 、SpaceXAI、MINIMAX(00100-HK) 、月之暗面、智譜(02513-HK) 、Cursor及Cognition的訂閱方案進行極限測試。
由於訂閱方案通常只顯示用量進度條，並以5小時、7天等期間計算，研究團隊分別測試輸入、快取寫入、快取讀取及輸出token，記錄進度條變化對應的用量，將誤差縮小至正負5%以內，再按API價格折算成「API等價價值」。
測試也發現，同一家業者的三個相同訂閱帳號中，其中一個額度少約20%。與業者確認後，才得知該帳號被納入小規模額度A/B測試，顯示訂閱額度可能在用戶未察覺下調整。
日常主力模型 兩家差距最大
旗艦模型GPT-6 Astra與Claude Fable 5.1的額度相近，但Fable最多只能占Claude訂閱總額度的一半。
以200美元方案為例，用戶消耗相當於2,485美元API費用的Fable 5.1後，仍有一半額度可供其他模型使用；同價位OpenAI方案消耗相當於2,897美元的Astra後，額度便已用完。
差距主要出現在日常主力模型Claude Opus 5.5與GPT-6.1 Sol。SemiAnalysis指出，Anthropic在各價位方案的API等價價值均領先，約為OpenAI的5倍；即使直接比較token數量，差距仍大。
OpenAI Pro方案沒有5小時限制，較容易讓用戶充分使用額度，但SemiAnalysis認為，這仍不足以抵消Opus 5.5在Claude訂閱上約4倍的價值優勢。
200美元額度砍半 高價方案未必更划算
SemiAnalysis追蹤指出，OpenAI上週調整後，200美元方案各模型可用token數量減半。由於GPT-6.1 Sol同時下調快取輸入價格，其API等價價值跌幅超過50%。
調整前購買的200美元方案可保留舊額度至10月29日，新購用戶則立即適用新額度。
同期推出的500美元方案，Astra額度僅比舊版200美元方案多21%，Sol的API等價價值甚至下降。主要賣點是每秒300個token的Ultrafast模式，其額度仍在測試。
過去高價方案享有較高補貼，調整後，Pro 100、200及500三檔每美元可換取的token數量相同，購買更高價方案不再享有額度上的單價優勢。
補貼壓力升高 業者各走不同路
SemiAnalysis估算，Anthropic訂閱約占總收入10%，卻可能消耗逾40%的推理算力，使每兆瓦的混合收入減少約3,600萬美元。對訂閱收入占比更高的OpenAI而言，壓力可能更大。
Anthropic採取漸進方式，模型愈高階，提供的API等價價值愈低；OpenAI則直接削減所有模型額度。SemiAnalysis認為，開發者日的正面宣傳，加上舊用戶暫時保留原額度，可能緩和了降額引發的反彈。
提速能否留住用戶 仍待觀察
Tibo主張，模型完成任務所需token較少，單看token數量或API等價價值，無法完整反映實際產出。SemiAnalysis也承認，模型API定價偏高或偏低時，這項換算可能失真。
不過，每項任務究竟能節省多少token，目前仍缺乏第三方量化數據。10月29日舊額度到期後，原先受到保護的重度用戶也將面對降額。
SemiAnalysis指出，OpenAI先前多次重置額度，是Codex近期用戶增加的重要原因之一，也促使Anthropic多次撤回降額計畫。如今，訂閱競爭正從擴大補貼，轉向成本與用戶價值之間的取捨。
paras_en: OpenAI announced it will speed up subscription users’ access to GPT‑6 Astra and GPT‑6.1 Sol, but the reduction in usage quota continues to draw attention.

Research firm SemiAnalysis measured that the subscription quota for Anthropic’s daily‑core models, when converted to API pricing, is worth about five times as much as OpenAI’s. This competition highlights the tension between AI firms cutting subsidies and retaining heavy users.

OpenAI executive Tibo pledged that after 28 consecutive days of updates or quota resets, the first day would address users’ complaints about model speed, announcing that GPT‑6 Astra and GPT‑6.1 Sol would have a default speed increase of roughly 50%, requiring no action from users and noticeable within two hours.

Tibo added that output speed would rise from 30 tokens per second to 50, paired with a highly optimized text tokenizer. He stressed that these two models already require fewer tokens to complete tasks.

The acceleration applies to OpenAI’s own products as well as partner services accessed via “Sign in with ChatGPT,” such as OpenCode, Pi, Amp, and Devin. However, some developers say the speed still lags behind Claude, and others report that GPT‑6.1 is merely back to its launch‑time speed. The update did not mention any changes to usage limits.
SemiAnalysis conducted stress tests on the subscription plans of Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta (META‑US), SpaceXAI, MINIMAX (00100‑HK), Moonlight Darkside, Zhihu (02513‑HK), Cursor and Cognition.

Because subscription plans usually only show a usage progress bar and calculate limits over periods like five hours or seven days, the research team tested input, cache write, cache read and output tokens separately, recorded progress‑bar changes against usage, narrowed error to within ±5%, and then converted the figures to “API‑equivalent value” using API pricing.

The tests also found that among three identical subscription accounts from the same provider, one account had about 20% less quota. After checking with the provider, they learned the account was part of a small‑scale quota A/B test, indicating that subscription quotas can be adjusted without users noticing.
Daily‑core model gap between the two companies is the largest
The flagship models GPT‑6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have similar quotas, but Fable can occupy at most half of Claude’s total subscription quota.

For example, on a $200 plan, after a user consumes Fable 5.1 usage equivalent to $2,485 in API fees, half of the quota remains for other models; on an equally priced OpenAI plan, after consuming Astra usage equivalent to $2,897 in API fees, the quota is already exhausted.

The gap is most pronounced between the daily‑core models Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT‑6.1 Sol. SemiAnalysis notes that Anthropic’s API‑equivalent value leads OpenAI by about five‑fold across all price tiers; even when comparing raw token counts, the disparity remains large.

OpenAI’s Pro plan has no five‑hour limit, making it easier for users to fully utilize their quota, but SemiAnalysis argues this still does not offset the roughly four‑fold value advantage Opus 5.5 has in Claude subscriptions.
$200 quota halved; higher‑price plans not necessarily more cost‑effective

SemiAnalysis tracked that after OpenAI’s adjustment last week, the usable token count for each model on the $200 plan was cut in half. Because GPT‑6.1 Sol also saw a reduction in cache‑input pricing, its API‑equivalent value dropped by more than 50%.
The $200 plan purchased before the change can retain the old quota until October 29, while new purchasers are subject to the new quota immediately.

The concurrently launched $500 plan gives Astra only a 21% increase in quota over the old $200 plan, and Sol’s API‑equivalent value even declines. Its main selling point is an Ultrafast mode of 300 tokens per second, whose quota is still under testing.

Previously, higher‑price plans enjoyed larger subsidies; after the adjustment, the Pro $100, $200 and $500 tiers all provide the same number of tokens per dollar, eliminating any per‑token price advantage for buying a higher‑priced plan.
Subsidy pressure rises; providers take different paths

SemiAnalysis estimates that Anthropic’s subscriptions account for about 10% of its total revenue but may consume over 40% of its inference compute, reducing mixed‑revenue per megawatt by roughly $36 million. For OpenAI, whose subscription revenue share is higher, the pressure could be even greater.

Anthropic is taking a gradual approach, offering lower API‑equivalent value as models become more advanced; OpenAI, by contrast, is cutting quotas across all models. SemiAnalysis believes that positive developer messaging combined with temporarily preserving old quotas for existing users may soften the backlash from quota cuts.
Whether speed gains can retain users remains to be seen

Tibo argues that because the models need fewer tokens to complete tasks, looking only at token counts or API‑equivalent value does not fully reflect actual output. SemiAnalysis also acknowledges that when model API pricing is too high or too low, this conversion can become distorted.

However, there is still no third‑party data quantifying exactly how many tokens each task saves. After the old quota expires on October 29, heavy users who were previously protected will also face reduced allocations.

SemiAnalysis points out that OpenAI’s repeated quota resets were a key factor in the recent surge of Codex users and prompted Anthropic to repeatedly withdraw its own quota‑cut plans. Now the subscription battle is shifting from expanding subsidies to balancing cost against user value.

items.title: 華爾街分析師從未如此看多美股
items.title_en: Wall Street Analysts Have Never Been So Bullish on US Stocks
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，華爾街分析師對股票的看法可謂前所未有的樂觀。隨著第三季財報季即將展開，分析師對企業前景的高度期待，也意味著一旦財報或財測在任何方面不及預期，市場的容錯空間將非常有限。
根據FactSet最新數據，目前有60%的標普500指數成分股獲得華爾街分析師「買進」評級，為有記錄以來最高。
報告還有幾項值得注意的發現：

買進評級占比高於過去5年平均值55.9%，持有評級占比則低於過去5年平均值38.6%。賣出評級占比同樣低於過去5年的平均值5.5%。
分析師最看好通訊服務、資訊科技、原材料、能源與醫療保健等產業，獲買進評級的比例分別為70%、70%、64%、64%及61%。
分析師對必需消費品產業最為悲觀，其買進評級占比僅45%，為所有產業中最低。同時，必需消費品產業的持有評級占比最高，達47%，賣出評級占比也最高，達7%。
自6月30日以來，標普500成分股獲評買進的比例小幅上升，由59.7%提高至59.9%。


Creative Planning首席市場策略師Charlie Bilello表示，「當所有人都期待好消息時，市場能出現正面意外的空間就會變得更小。」
市場目前的樂觀情緒，主要建立在企業獲利前景之上。
標普500指數成分股在剛結束的第三季，預計將實現29.5%的年增獲利。
根據FactSet，如果最終結果符合預期，將是企業獲利連續第三季成長超過25%，同時將創下連續第八季實現雙位數百分比獲利成長的紀錄。
展望第四季，華爾街分析師預期企業獲利將成長27.6%。
對於2026年全年，分析師預測標普500成分股獲利將較去年成長32.4%。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports that Wall Street analysts are more optimistic about stocks than ever before. With the third‑quarter earnings season about to begin, analysts’ high expectations for corporate outlooks also mean that any earnings miss or weaker guidance will leave the market with very little margin for error.
According to the latest FactSet data, 60% of S&P 500 constituents currently have a “Buy” rating from Wall Street analysts, the highest level on record.
The report also highlights several notable findings:

Buy ratings are at 55.9% of the universe, above the five‑year average, while hold ratings are down to 38.6% versus the five‑year average, and sell ratings are also lower than the five‑year average at 5.5%. Analysts are most bullish on communications services, information technology, materials, energy and health care, with buy‑rating shares of 70%, 70%, 64%, 64% and 61% respectively. They are most pessimistic on consumer staples, where the buy‑rating share is only 45%, the lowest among all sectors. Consumer staples also have the highest hold‑rating share at 47% and the highest sell‑rating share at 7%. Since June 30, the proportion of S&P 500 stocks with a buy rating has risen slightly from 59.7% to 59.9%. Creative Planning chief market strategist Charlie Bilello said, “When everyone is expecting good news, there is less room for the market to be positively surprised.”
The market’s current optimism is mainly built on corporate profit outlooks.
S&P 500 constituents are expected to deliver a 29.5% year‑over‑year earnings increase in the just‑concluded third quarter.

FactSet says that if the final results meet expectations, it will mark the third consecutive quarter of earnings growth exceeding 25% and the eighth straight quarter of double‑digit percentage earnings growth.
Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, Wall Street analysts forecast earnings growth of 27.6%.
For the full year 2026, analysts project S&P 500 earnings to rise 32.4% from the prior year.

items.title: 美中半導體設備攻防長期化！美智庫稱中國囤343台DUV、日媒指陸廠靠ASML設備庫存爭取時間
items.title_en: U.S.-China Semiconductor Equipment Conflict Becomes Prolonged: U.S. Think Tank Says China Has Stockpiled 343 DUV Machines, Japanese Media Says Chinese Foundries Rely on ASML Inventory to Buy Time
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，中國大陸半導體製造企業在美國與荷蘭出口管制下，仍以個案審批、既有庫存與國產研發「兩條腿走路」推進光刻能力。
綜合美國智庫報告、《南華早報》及《日經亞洲》相關報導，外界估算中國目前取得的浸沒式深紫外(DUV)光刻機合計約343台，其中約270台為艾司摩爾(ASML)Twinscan NXT:1980i，這批設備雖非極紫外(EUV)，但配合多重曝光已可支撐7奈米邏輯、先進記憶體與AI加速器量產，並為中國國產整機研發爭取緩衝期。
根據華府智庫「技術與中國國家安全中心」(CTS)報告，截至今年初，中國晶圓廠透過管制缺口取得共343台浸沒式DUV，其中艾司摩爾 NXT:1980i約270台。
2024年，中國花費超過130億美元採購90台NXT:1980i，2025年再增購89台，其餘為更早取得或其他合規型號。荷蘭自2019年起應美國要求禁售EUV，但NXT:1980i等較先進浸沒式機型初期仍得以個案審批出口；CTS認為，這是中國得以持續擴充中高階產能的關鍵。
浸沒式DUV在鏡頭與晶圓間注水提升折射率，解析度低於EUV但高於乾式DUV；透過多重曝光重疊線路層，可用於7奈米級邏輯、高階NAND/DRAM及AI晶片。
報告指出，華為昇騰等加速器即依此路線量產。CTS預測，若中國每年維持引進90台NXT:1980i，至2035年年產輝達H100等級AI晶片可達4.34億顆。若自2027年起全面切斷新機進口，同等級產能將降至約1.53億顆。
美國商務部出口管制官員Nicholas Brown與白宮前技術政策顧問Saif Khan因此在報告中呼籲，對浸沒式DUV、低溫蝕刻等一併實施全面封鎖。
美國國會今年4月提出《MATCH法案》，要求荷蘭、日本等盟國150天內擴大對中國設備限制，範圍由EUV延伸至先進DUV與部分蝕刻、量測設備。報告顯示，華府正把管制重心由「禁止最先進」轉向「堵中國先進」。
《日經亞洲》亦報導指出，中國企業確實全力投入國產光刻，但短期仍須依賴ASML成熟機台。光刻機並非單一零件，而是光源、物鏡、工件台、浸潤、計算光刻與控制軟體的系統工程。193奈米浸沒式需ArF光源、高精度投影物鏡、雙工件台與水膜穩定；EUV更涉及13.5奈米雷射等離子光源、真空反射鏡組與極複雜計算光刻。
國際半導體微影技術與計算光學領域享譽盛名的Andreas Erdmann曾說，機械、電子、化學、數學與計算必須協同，才有機會讓整機穩定運行，這也是全球僅ASML、尼康、佳能具整機能力的原因。
ASML優勢在整合全球頂級供應鏈，而尼康、佳能較多自研自產，卻未完全接軌國際分工，先進度被拉開。
中國早期乾式DUV最高約90奈米，而2024年工信部公告新型乾式DUV，鏡頭解析度達65奈米，今年王陽元、陳南翔等產業報告則指出，中國國產浸沒式DUV已完成研發並進入測試；另有外媒稱中國在政府支持下自行組裝DUV系統，去年底曾傳EUV原型機，引發全球晶片股波動，但相關進度尚未獲獨立量產驗證。
日本專家指出，既有的ASML庫存讓中國晶圓廠維持產能與現金流，同時在光源、物鏡、工件台、計算光刻各子系統分頭攻關；「能造整機」與「可替代ASML量產」是兩回事，良率、產能、穩定運行與軟體生態仍需年限。
ASML財報曾顯示中國一度佔其營收約41%，隨著管制收緊，公司預期2026年中國佔比降至約兩成。
中國策略是合規採購DUV保產能、自研整機保長期：先以NXT:1980i與其他浸沒機支援7奈米與儲存擴產，再以國產乾式、浸沒式逐步切入成熟與中階先進線。
除光刻機外，美國分析師稱中國在蝕刻、沉積、清洗、量測等大多設備領域進步明顯。中微、北方華創、盛美、拓荆、華海清科、中科飛測等已進入部分產線；日本設備業者擔心，若中國光刻突破，材料、沉積、量測將連帶國產化，衝擊東京電子、Screen等出口。
南韓媒體亦報導指出，三星、SK海力士因美國限制其在中國的合資廠採購先進設備，已評估採用中微等中國蝕刻與部分製程設備，顯示替代由「非光刻」向更廣設備圈擴散。
整體來看，343台浸沒式DUV與持續採購，使中國在中長期AI晶片、7奈米邏輯與先進儲存上具中端自主能力；若美國推動DUV全面封鎖，2027年後新增產能將受抑，但存量機台、多重曝光與國產機試製可維持基本盤。中國國產光刻機的變數不在理論路線，而在整機穩定性、產出吞吐量、缺陷密度與供應鏈協同。
分析人士認為，美國出口管制短期拖慢中國先進化，長期卻把中國市場讓給本土設備商，加速全鏈替代；若中國國產浸沒式量產、EUV原型轉商用，ASML壟斷溢價與全球晶片定價邏輯都可能重估。半導體設備競爭正由「賣機台」轉為「系統整合與產能自主」的持久戰。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Chinese mainland semiconductor manufacturers, despite U.S. and Dutch export controls, are advancing lithography capability through case‑by‑case approvals, existing inventory and domestic R&D – a two‑track approach.

Based on U.S. think‑tank reports, the South China Morning Post and Nikkei Asia, analysts estimate China now possesses roughly 343 immersion deep‑ultraviolet (DUV) lithography tools, about 270 of which are ASML Twinscan NXT:1980i units. Although not extreme‑ultraviolet (EUV), these machines can, with multiple‑exposure techniques, support volume production of 7‑nm logic, advanced memory and AI accelerators, giving China a buffer for domestic full‑system development.

According to the Washington‑based Center for Technology and National Security (CTS) report, by early this year Chinese wafer fabs have obtained a total of 343 immersion DUV tools through regulatory loopholes, including about 270 ASML NXT:1980i units.

In 2024 China spent more than $13 billion to buy 90 NXT:1980i machines and plans to purchase another 89 in 2025, with the remainder coming from earlier acquisitions or other compliant models. The Netherlands has banned EUV sales since 2019 at U.S. request, but the more advanced immersion models like the NXT:1980i were still allowed to leave on a case‑by‑case basis; CTS says this has been key for China to keep expanding its mid‑to‑high‑end capacity.

Immersion DUV injects water between the lens and wafer to raise the refractive index, offering resolution lower than EUV but higher than dry DUV. By overlapping multiple exposures, it can pattern 7‑nm‑class logic, high‑end NAND/DRAM and AI chips.

The report notes that Huawei’s Ascend accelerators are already being mass‑produced using this route. CTS projects that if China continues to import 90 NXT:1980i units per year, by 2035 it could produce AI chips comparable to Nvidia H100 at a rate of 434 million units annually; cutting off new imports from 2027 would reduce that capacity to about 153 million units.

U.S. Commerce Department export‑control official Nicholas Brown and former White House technology adviser Saif Khan call in the report for a comprehensive ban on immersion DUV, low‑temperature etch and related equipment.

In April the U.S. Congress introduced the MATCH Act, demanding that allies such as the Netherlands and Japan expand equipment restrictions on China within 150 days, extending the scope from EUV to advanced DUV and certain etch and metrology tools. The report shows Washington is shifting its focus from “blocking the most advanced” to “blocking China’s advanced” gear.

Nikkei Asia also reports that Chinese firms are pouring resources into domestic lithography but still rely on mature ASML machines in the short term. A lithography tool is not a single component but a system comprising light source, projection optics, wafer stage, immersion fluid, computational lithography and control software. A 193‑nm immersion system needs an ArF source, high‑precision projection optics, dual wafer stages and a stable water film; EUV adds a 13.5‑nm laser‑plasma source, vacuum reflective mirrors and far more complex computational lithography.

Andreas Erdmann, a renowned expert in semiconductor lithography and computational optics, has said that mechanics, electronics, chemistry, mathematics and computation must work together for a full‑system to run stably – a reason why only ASML, Nikon and Canon have full‑machine capability worldwide.

ASML’s advantage lies in integrating a global top‑tier supply chain, whereas Nikon and Canon develop more in‑house but have not fully aligned with the international division of labor, leaving them behind in advanced technology.

China’s early dry DUV tools topped out at about 90 nm. In 2024 the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology announced a new dry DUV with 65‑nm lens resolution. Industry reports by Wang Yangyuan and Chen Nanxiang say Chinese domestic immersion DUV has completed development and entered testing. Foreign media also claim China, with government backing, assembled its own DUV system and even hinted at an EUV prototype late last year, which rattled global chip stocks, though independent mass‑production verification is still lacking.

Japanese experts note that existing ASML inventory lets Chinese fabs maintain capacity and cash flow while they tackle the light source, optics, wafer stage and computational lithography subsystems separately. “Being able to build a full machine” and “being able to replace ASML at volume” are different; yield, throughput, stable operation and software ecosystem will still take years to mature.
ASML’s financial reports once showed China accounting for roughly 41 % of its revenue; as controls tighten the company expects China’s share to fall to about 20 % by 2026.

China’s strategy is to compliantly purchase DUV tools to keep capacity while developing full‑system domestic machines for the long term: first use NXT:1980i and other immersion tools to support 7‑nm logic and storage expansion, then gradually introduce domestic dry and immersion equipment into mature and mid‑range advanced nodes.

Beyond lithography, U.S. analysts say China has made noticeable progress in etch, deposition, cleaning and metrology equipment. Companies such as SMIC, North Huachuang, Shengmei, Tuojing, Huahai Qingke and Zhongke Feice have entered some production lines. Japanese equipment makers fear that if Chinese lithography breakthroughs occur, related materials, deposition and metrology will also become domestic, hurting exporters like Tokyo Electron and Screen.

South Korean media report that Samsung and SK Hynix, constrained by U.S. limits on buying advanced gear for their Chinese joint ventures, are evaluating Chinese etch and some process equipment from SMIC, showing substitution is spreading from “non‑lithography” to a broader equipment ecosystem.

Overall, the stock of 343 immersion DUV machines and ongoing purchases give China a mid‑term autonomous capability for AI chips, 7‑nm logic and advanced storage. If the U.S. imposes a full DUV embargo, new capacity after 2027 would be curbed, but existing machines, multiple‑exposure techniques and domestic prototypes can sustain a basic production base. The variable for Chinese domestic lithography is not the theoretical approach but the stability of full machines, output throughput, defect density and supply‑chain coordination.

Analysts argue that U.S. export controls will slow China’s advanced progress in the short run but ultimately hand the market to domestic equipment vendors, accelerating full‑chain substitution. If China manages to mass‑produce domestic immersion tools and turn EUV prototypes into commercial products, ASML’s monopoly premium and global chip pricing logic could be reassessed. The semiconductor‑equipment battle is shifting from “selling machines” to a prolonged “system integration and capacity autonomy” fight.

items.title: Schneider砸270億美元轉向工業自動化 AI資料中心電力高成長反被稀釋
items.title_en: Schneider Spends $27 B Shifting to Industrial Automation; AI Data‑Center Power Growth May Be Diluted
paras: 2026年10月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 施耐德電機Schneider Electric(SU-FR)過去幾年最受市場關注的成長來源，是AI資料中心帶動的配電、UPS與電力管理需求。2025年公司約82%營收仍來自能源管理，工業自動化只占18%，因此市場過去給Schneider較高評價，很大一部分建立在AI電力設備需求快速成長之上。
但公司的資本配置已經明顯往另一個方向延伸。Schneider在10月5日正式宣布，以每股205美元全現金收購美國工業軟體公司PTC，交易金額約226億美元，隱含企業價值237億美元，是公司史上最大收購案。交易預計於2027年第3季完成，仍需PTC股東與監管機構批准。
如果再加上今年6月以31億美元收購工業數據與AI平台Cognite，以及既有AVEVA，Schneider正在快速補齊工業軟體版圖。J.P. Morgan估計，光PTC與Cognite兩筆交易，投入工業自動化相關資產的金額就已接近270億美元，也因此重新評估公司未來的成長結構。
PTC主要提供CAD、產品生命週期管理(PLM)與售後服務軟體，擁有超過3萬名客戶；2025年營收約24億歐元，調整後EBITA利潤率約40%。AVEVA偏流程工業軟體，Cognite則著重工業數據與AI。結合以後，Schneider的布局就從原本配電、控制器與自動化硬體，往產品設計、製造流程、數位分身、工業資料與SaaS延伸。
更重要的是收入結構。交易完成後，Schneider的SaaS收入占集團營收比重預計提高到約24%。這代表公司未來不再只是靠一次性的設備銷售，而是希望增加更高比例的軟體訂閱與持續性收入。
不過市場擔心的也正是這一點。
Schneider將透過發行約50億至60億歐元新股，以及160億至170億歐元新債完成交易，代表資產負債表短期壓力會增加；而公司投入更多資本到工業自動化後，原本AI資料中心能源管理業務帶來的高成長特性，是否會被成長速度較不同的軟體與自動化業務稀釋，也成為新的估值問題。
Schneider預計交易在完成後第一個完整年度，就能對調整後EPS帶來低個位數增益，綜效的實現後則可提高至中高個位數。不過，市場第一時間仍偏保守，交易公布後Schneider股價一度下跌超過10%。

paras_en: October 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Schneider Electric (SU-FR) has drawn the most market attention in recent years from growth driven by AI data‑center demand for distribution, UPS and power‑management solutions. In 2025 about 82% of the company’s revenue still came from energy management, with industrial automation accounting for only 18%, so the market’s high valuation of Schneider has largely been built on the rapid growth of AI‑related power‑equipment demand.

However, the company’s capital allocation is now clearly moving in another direction. On October 5 Schneider announced a cash‑only acquisition of U.S. industrial software firm PTC at $205 per share, a deal worth roughly $22.6 billion and an implied enterprise value of $23.7 billion – the largest acquisition in the company’s history. The transaction is expected to close in Q3 2027, subject to PTC shareholder and regulatory approvals.

Adding the June‑2026 $3.1 billion purchase of industrial data and AI platform Cognite and the existing AVEVA assets, Schneider is rapidly filling out its industrial‑software portfolio. J.P. Morgan estimates that just the PTC and Cognite deals represent close to $27 billion of investment in industrial‑automation‑related assets, prompting a reassessment of the company’s future growth structure.

PTC mainly provides CAD, product lifecycle management (PLM) and after‑sales service software and serves over 30,000 customers; its 2025 revenue was about €2.4 billion with an adjusted EBITA margin of roughly 40%. AVEVA focuses on process‑industry software, while Cognite concentrates on industrial data and AI. After integration, Schneider’s footprint will expand from distribution, controllers and automation hardware to product design, manufacturing processes, digital twins, industrial data and SaaS offerings.

More importantly, the revenue mix will change. After the deal closes, Schneider’s SaaS revenue is expected to rise to about 24% of total group revenue. This means the company will no longer rely solely on one‑off equipment sales but will aim for a higher proportion of software subscriptions and recurring income.
Nevertheless, that is exactly what the market worries about.

Schneider plans to fund the transaction by issuing roughly €5‑6 billion of new equity and €16‑17 billion of new debt, which will increase short‑term balance‑sheet pressure; and as the company pours more capital into industrial automation, the high‑growth characteristic of its AI data‑center energy‑management business may be diluted by the slower‑growing software and automation segments, creating a new valuation challenge.

Schneider expects that in the first full year after closing the deal, adjusted EPS will see a low‑single‑digit boost, with synergies later potentially lifting it to mid‑ to high‑single‑digit levels. However, the market remained cautious, and Schneider’s share price fell more than 10% immediately after the announcement.

items.title: 三星電機連續公告供應合約 股價大漲近6% 市場轉向關注訂單兌現
items.title_en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Announces Consecutive Supply Contracts, Stock Rises Nearly 6%, Market Shifts Focus to Order Fulfillment
paras: 2026年10月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 三星電機Samsung Electro-Mechanics(009150-KR)近期連續公告單一銷售與供應合約，訂單消息也開始反映到股價。公司6日在南韓股市上漲5.95%，收在167.5萬韓元，單日上漲9.4萬韓元。
今年以來，三星電機已密集簽下六筆長期供應合約，累計金額約3.9兆韓元，產品主要集中在AI伺服器相關MLCC、矽電容與電感，多數交付時間直接看到2027年，部分甚至延伸至2028年。
最新一筆合約於10月6日公告，金額2,856億韓元，供應期間為2027年1月至12月；9月29日另一筆MLCC與電感合約約2,900億韓元，同樣鎖定2027全年。再往前看，9月1日三星電機簽下1.07兆韓元AI伺服器MLCC合約，是目前最大單筆訂單；5月的矽電容合約金額更達1.56兆韓元，供應期間延伸至2027至2028年。
目前三星電機已與超過10家全球客戶簽訂MLCC長期供應協議，公司也希望透過長約鎖定60%至70%的MLCC產能。
高盛估計，全球AI伺服器MLCC市場將由2025年的14億美元增至2030年的58億美元，年複合成長率約34%。三星電機日前也表示，目前在全球AI伺服器MLCC市場的市占率已超過40%。隨著客戶提前簽訂長約，訂單能見度拉長，也會直接影響後續產能配置與報價空間。
訂單增加後，資本支出也同步往上。三星電機規劃投入4.27兆韓元擴充世宗廠AI伺服器FC-BGA產能，另投入2.51兆韓元擴充越南封裝基板產能，部分全球客戶也參與世宗廠擴建資金並承諾未來採購量。公司另向韓美半導體Hanmi Semiconductor(042700-KR)下達244.8億韓元MSVP設備訂單，用於AI半導體基板製造，設備交付期延伸至2027年12月。

paras_en: On October 6, 2026 (reported by Youshi Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Samsung Electro-Mechanics (009150-KR) has recently announced a series of single-sale and supply contracts, and the order news is already reflected in its share price. The company’s stock rose 5.95% on the Korean market on the 6th, closing at 1,675,000 KRW, up 94,000 KRW in a single day.

Since the start of the year, Samsung Electro-Mechanics has aggressively signed six long‑term supply contracts totaling about 3.9 trillion KRW. The products are mainly AI‑server‑related MLCCs, silicon capacitors and inductors, with most delivery schedules extending into 2027 and some even reaching 2028.

The latest contract, announced on October 6, is worth 285.6 billion KRW and covers the period from January to December 2027; another MLCC and inductor contract announced on September 29 is about 290 billion KRW, also locked in for the full year of 2027. Earlier, on September 1, Samsung Electro‑Mechanics signed a 1.07 trillion KRW AI‑server MLCC contract, the largest single order to date; a silicon‑capacitor contract in May amounted to 1.56 trillion KRW, with supply extending into 2027‑2028.
To date, Samsung Electro‑Mechanics has signed long‑term MLCC supply agreements with more than 10 global customers and aims to lock 60%‑70% of its MLCC capacity through these long‑term deals.

Goldman Sachs estimates that the global AI‑server MLCC market will grow from $1.4 billion in 2025 to $5.8 billion in 2030, a compound annual growth rate of roughly 34%. Samsung Electro‑Mechanics recently said its share of the global AI‑server MLCC market already exceeds 40%. As customers sign long‑term contracts early, order visibility is extended, directly influencing future capacity allocation and pricing flexibility.

With the order surge, capital expenditures are also rising. Samsung Electro‑Mechanics plans to invest 4.27 trillion KRW to expand AI‑server FC‑BGA capacity at its Sejong plant and another 2.51 trillion KRW to expand packaging substrate capacity in Vietnam. Some global customers are participating in the Sejong plant expansion funding and have pledged future purchase volumes. The company also placed a 24.48 billion KRW MSVP equipment order with Hanmi Semiconductor (042700-KR) for AI semiconductor substrate manufacturing, with delivery scheduled through December 2027.
