items.title: 從文科生到AI巨擘 Anthropic總裁阿莫迪成為美國富豪榜最年輕白手起家女性
items.title_en: From Liberal Arts Student to AI Giant: Anthropic President Daniela Amodei Becomes the Youngest Self‑Made Female Billionaire on the U.S. Rich List
paras: 根據《Forbes》近期公布的美國富豪榜，現年 39 歲的人工智慧企業 Anthropic 聯合創辦人兼總裁阿莫迪(Daniela Amodei)，以估算達 155 億美元的身價，位居全美白手起家女性富豪第 2 名，並在全美 400 大富豪榜中並列第 75 名，成為榜單中最年輕的白手起家女性億萬富豪。
隨著 Anthropic 在融資中籌集 650 億美元，推升估值至 9,650 億美元，其身價在一年內成長近 13 倍。

跨領域歷程與通才管理哲學

與典型矽谷科技創辦人不同，阿莫迪未持有電腦科學或法律學位，而是畢業於加州大學聖克魯斯分校英國文學系。其父親為皮革工匠，母親從事圖書館建設管理。
在談及個人背景時，阿莫迪於史丹佛大學訪談中表示：「在某些方面，我真的認為自己是一個通才……能夠保持好奇心、跨領域學習，並建立渴望帶來影響力的堅實基礎，是一種被低估的特質。」
阿莫迪早期曾參與國際發展與政治競選工作，2013 年加入支付新創 Stripe 負責人才招募與風險營運，管理詐欺與合規業務。2018 年她進入 OpenAI 擔任安全政策與工程管理副總裁，並於 2020 年底與哥哥達里奧·阿莫迪(Dario Amodei)等七人離職，共同創立 Anthropic。

營運成長與 IPO 規畫

作為 Anthropic 總裁兼董事會主席，阿莫迪負責公司日常營運與高管團隊。財務數據顯示，Anthropic 年化營收自 2025 年 1 月的 10 億美元，成長至 2026 年 7 月底的 650 億美元以上。
市場消息指出，Anthropic 計畫於 2026 年 11 月進行首次公開發行(IPO)，預期上市估值可能達 2 兆美元以上。主要投資方包括 Google、Amazon、NVIDIA 與紅杉資本等。

商業倫理與財富影響

針對商業營運與社會責任，阿莫迪受訪時說明：「我們將成為商業實體，人工智慧將創造巨大經濟價值，但以正確的方式做到這一點非常重要。商業營運與做好事之間並不一定存在衝突。」
此外，Anthropic 創辦團隊宣布未來將捐出 80% 財富。這種對財富回饋的看法獲其他企業家迴響。例如 Epic Systems 創辦人Judy Faulkner在「贈予誓言」信中表示：「我從未想過要成為過著奢華生活的富豪，我承諾捐出 99% 資產的目標是幫助他人獲得溫飽與教育等基礎。」
伴隨 AI 產業擴張，財富累積延伸至企業員工。據報導，Anthropic 部分技術人員因估值成長，股權價值顯著增加；OpenAI 亦透過股權買賣允許員工套現約 66 億美元。
同時，全美白手起家女性億萬富豪人數已自 2015 年的 12 位增至 43 位，資產創下 1,663 億美元新高，反映科技創新對財富結構的重塑。
paras_en: According to Forbes' recently released U.S. Rich List, 39‑year‑old Anthropic co‑founder and president Daniela Amodei, whose net worth is estimated at $15.5 billion, ranks second among self‑made women in the United States and ties for 75th place on the overall U.S. 400 richest list, making her the youngest self‑made female billionaire on the ranking.
As Anthropic raised $6.5 billion in financing, its valuation jumped to $965 billion, causing Amodei’s net worth to grow almost 13‑fold in a single year.

Cross‑disciplinary Journey and Generalist Management Philosophy
Unlike typical Silicon Valley tech founders, Amodei does not hold a degree in computer science or law; she graduated from the University of California, Santa Cruz with a major in English literature. Her father is a leather craftsman and her mother works in library construction management.

When discussing her background in a Stanford interview, Amodei said, “In some ways I really consider myself a generalist… being able to stay curious, learn across fields, and build a solid foundation for wanting to make an impact is an undervalued trait.”

Amodei’s early career included work in international development and political campaigns. In 2013 she joined payments startup Stripe, overseeing talent acquisition and risk operations, including fraud and compliance. In 2018 she moved to OpenAI as vice president of safety policy and engineering management, and at the end of 2020 she left with her brother Dario Amodei and five others to co‑found Anthropic.

Operational Growth and IPO Plans
As Anthropic’s president and chair of the board, Amodei oversees daily operations and the senior leadership team. Financial data show Anthropic’s annualized revenue grew from $10 billion in January 2025 to over $650 billion by the end of July 2026.

Market sources indicate Anthropic plans to launch its initial public offering in November 2026, with a projected listing valuation that could exceed $2 trillion. Major investors include Google, Amazon, NVIDIA and Sequoia Capital.

Business Ethics and Wealth Impact
On business operations and social responsibility, Amodei explained, “We will become a commercial entity; AI will create massive economic value, but doing it the right way is crucial. Business operations and doing good don’t necessarily have to be at odds.”

The Anthropic founding team also announced it will donate 80 % of its wealth in the future. This view on wealth redistribution resonated with other entrepreneurs. For example, Epic Systems founder Judy Faulkner wrote in a “Giving Pledge” letter, “I never imagined living a lavish billionaire life; my commitment to give away 99 % of my assets is aimed at helping others secure basic needs and education.”

With the AI industry’s expansion, wealth accumulation is extending to company employees. Reports say some Anthropic engineers have seen their equity values surge dramatically as the valuation rose; OpenAI also allowed employees to cash out roughly $6.6 billion through equity sales.

At the same time, the number of self‑made female billionaires in the United States has risen from 12 in 2015 to 43, with total assets reaching a new high of $166.3 billion, reflecting how technological innovation is reshaping the wealth landscape.

items.title: 亞洲AI建設上看8.2兆美元 銀行搶做高風險GPU融資
items.title_en: Asian AI Build-Up Seen at $8.2 Trillion, Banks Rush to Offer High‑Risk GPU Financing
paras: 下一波人工智慧（AI）債務融資浪潮正在亞洲興起。
在亞洲各地興建數百座資料中心的企業，也正籌措資金，購買驅動這些設施的先進晶片。透過借款購入圖形處理器（GPU）的模式，已在美國快速成長；亞洲目前少數完成的相關貸款，多半由願意承擔較高風險的私募信貸基金提供。
如今，銀行對GPU融資的接受度逐漸提高，大幅擴充下一階段AI競賽可取得的資金來源。這些資金將至關重要，因為資誠（PwC）估計，到2050年，亞洲資料中心支出可能達8.2兆美元，其中絕大多數將用於GPU、伺服器等硬體。
近幾個月，銀行在GMI Cloud及另外兩家AI基礎設施供應商Zankore、PaleBlueDot AI合計約38億美元的GPU貸款案中，扮演關鍵角色。
花旗是Zankore在印尼取得31億美元貸款的唯一債務顧問，摩根大通則擔任PaleBlueDot AI授信案的安排機構。
亞洲六名銀行業者與財務顧問表示，他們正在洽談，或知悉更多GPU相關融資案。不過，由於晶片長期估值，以及地緣政治與AI本身的風險仍難以評估，這類貸款仍處於起步階段。
Hogan Lovells Cadwalader銀行與金融業務合夥人Eric Tan表示：「隨著交易規模擴大，借款人要求更具競爭力的融資條件，銀行將愈來愈重要。」但他也指出，技術變化快速，使GPU融資的貸款機構面臨「快速折舊、技術淘汰及租金波動」等風險。
國際投行率先布局 亞洲銀行跟進
知悉相關洽談的人士表示，在已投入亞洲GPU融資的傳統貸款機構中，全球投資銀行目前是主要參與者，因為它們具備處理複雜融資架構的專業能力。一名銀行業者指出，部分美國貸款機構也借重總部專家，評估晶片價值。
知情人士透露，花旗、摩根大通、巴克萊、德意志銀行、桑坦德銀行及日本三井住友銀行，目前都在評估GPU相關貸款。另有知情人士上月表示，GMI Cloud正與銀行及民間貸款機構洽談一筆新的3億美元貸款，用於購買泰國資料中心所需晶片。
花旗、巴克萊及德意志銀行代表拒絕置評。摩根大通、桑坦德及三井住友銀行未立即回應置評請求。
亞洲銀行也開始更積極參與。Zankore董事長Vikram Sinha表示，新加坡大華銀行先前與另外四家銀行共同承銷Zankore的31億美元貸款，如今正主導新一輪洽談，協助這家資料中心業者向銀行籌措60億美元。
Sinha在9月22日的一場會議上表示，與銀行合作是「正確的方式」，因為Zankore計劃將AI資料中心容量擴大至目前的10倍、達到1吉瓦，未來仍須持續籌資。
他說：「我們非常清楚自己追求的規模。我們想走較艱難的路，也就是與銀行及銀行聯貸團合作。」
資金增加 還款能力要求也提高
隨著銀行成為更重要的資金來源，企業若想借款購買晶片，就必須更充分證明，專案能創造足夠營收償還貸款。傳統貸款機構可能採取更保守的授信審核標準，並要求提存更多償債準備金。
亞洲最大私募信貸業者之一Ares Management的執行長Mike Arougheti表示，即使GPU融資是AI熱潮中資金缺口最大的領域，公司仍維持高標準。
Arougheti在9月的巴克萊全球金融服務會議上說：「你必須以願意承擔的風險為依據，而不是以投放資金的意願為依據。」
他表示：「至少對我而言，沒有人能真正說清楚這項技術的折舊曲線。」他並補充，這類貸款的報酬溢價有限，通常僅比其他AI基礎設施貸款高出100至200個基點。
亞洲GPU貸款大多沿用CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 率先採用的架構。CoreWeave是最早、也是規模最大的此類融資使用者之一。許多交易以資料中心出售算力的收入償還貸款，客戶合約及晶片本身則經常作為貸款擔保。
因此，對貸款機構而言，最重要的問題是：這些客戶有多可靠，合約期限又有多長？
輝達提供保障 中國客戶帶來需求
有輝達(NVDA-US) 支持的交易，較容易獲得貸款機構同意。在GMI Cloud與Zankore上月完成的貸款案中，輝達同意購買任何未售出的算力，若客戶合約未能履行，便可提供保障。
作為交換，這些參與輝達雲端合作夥伴計畫的企業，將以高於輝達承諾支付的價格向買家收費，並與輝達分享營收。
中國大型科技公司也成為亞洲算力需求的另一個重要來源。一家歐洲銀行的貸款業務人士表示，這些企業相對可靠，因為它們也能吸引中國銀行參與融資。
知情人士上月表示，GMI Cloud計劃為泰國資料中心購買的晶片，最終使用者將是騰訊。另有知情人士去年12月透露，中國熱門社群平台小紅書，預計購買PaleBlueDot AI日本專案所採購晶片提供的算力。
中國客戶的監管風險仍待釐清
不過，中國客戶也帶來額外風險。美國已限制晶片出口至中國，並正考慮新法案，旨在限制中國企業透過雲端運算遠端使用輝達晶片，進而限制它們租用位於其他國家的算力。
標普全球評級分析師Yijing Ng表示：「中國大型雲端業者普遍具備良好的信用體質。」但她指出，銀行必須進行更充分的盡職調查，確保符合監管規定，且算力最終使用者未違反任何制裁或限制。
與此同時，AI是否構成生存威脅，以及是否有必要為其發展設立防護機制的辯論，也將持續影響風險評估。
Hogan Lovells Cadwalader的Tan表示：「市場可能需要一段時間才能找到平衡。交易架構可能變得更嚴格，政府支持可能介入，交易模式也將隨之演變。」
paras_en: The next wave of artificial‑intelligence (AI) debt financing is taking off in Asia.

Companies building hundreds of data centres across Asia are also raising funds to buy the advanced chips that power those facilities. The model of borrowing to purchase graphics processing units (GPUs) has grown rapidly in the United States; the few related loans that have been completed in Asia so far have mostly been supplied by private‑credit funds willing to take higher risk.

Now banks are becoming more receptive to GPU financing, dramatically expanding the pool of capital available for the next stage of the AI race. That capital will be crucial, as PwC estimates that Asian data‑centre spending could reach $8.2 trillion by 2050, with the vast majority earmarked for hardware such as GPUs and servers.
In recent months, banks have played a key role in roughly $3.8 billion of GPU loan transactions involving GMI Cloud and two other AI‑infrastructure providers, Zankore and PaleBlueDot AI.
Citigroup acted as the sole debt adviser for Zankore’s $3.1 billion loan in Indonesia, while JPMorgan served as the arranger for PaleBlueDot AI’s credit facility.

Six Asian banks and financial advisers said they are in talks or are aware of additional GPU‑related financing deals. However, because chip valuations are long‑term, and geopolitical and AI‑specific risks remain hard to gauge, such loans are still in an early stage.

Hogan Lovells Cadwalader banking and finance partner Eric Tan said, “As deal sizes grow, borrowers demand more competitive financing terms, and banks will become increasingly important.” He also warned that rapid technology change exposes GPU lenders to “fast depreciation, technological obsolescence and rent volatility.”
International investment banks are moving first; Asian banks are following.

Sources familiar with the discussions said that among traditional lenders that have entered Asian GPU financing, global investment banks are currently the main participants because they have the expertise to structure complex financing. One banker noted that some U.S. lenders also rely on head‑office specialists to assess chip values.

Insiders disclosed that Citigroup, JPMorgan, Barclays, Deutsche Bank, Santander and Japan’s Sumitomo Mitsui Bank are all evaluating GPU‑related loans. Another source said that last month GMI Cloud was negotiating a new $300 million loan with banks and private lenders to buy chips for a data centre in Thailand.
Representatives of Citigroup, Barclays and Deutsche Bank declined to comment. JPMorgan, Santander and Sumitomo Mitsui Bank did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Asian banks are also becoming more active. Zankore chairman Vikram Sinha said that Singapore’s United Overseas Bank, which previously syndicated Zankore’s $3.1 billion loan together with four other banks, is now leading a new round of talks to help the data‑centre operator raise $6 billion from banks.
Sinha told a meeting on September 22 that working with banks is “the right way” because Zankore plans to expand AI data‑centre capacity ten‑fold to 1 GW and will need ongoing financing.
He added, “We are very clear about the scale we are chasing. We want to take the harder road, which means working with banks and a bank‑loan syndicate.”
More Funding, Higher Repayment Standards

As banks become a more important source of capital, companies that want to borrow to buy chips must more convincingly demonstrate that projects will generate enough revenue to repay the loans. Traditional lenders may adopt more conservative credit standards and require larger debt‑service reserves.

Mike Arougheti, CEO of Ares Management, one of Asia’s largest private‑credit firms, said that even though GPU financing is the biggest funding gap in the AI boom, the firm still maintains high standards.

Speaking at Barclays’ Global Financial Services conference in September, Arougheti said, “You have to base your underwriting on the risk you are willing to take, not on the willingness to deploy capital.”

He added, “At least for me, no one can really predict the depreciation curve of this technology.” He noted that the risk premium on such loans is limited, typically only 100 to 200 basis points above other AI‑infrastructure loans.

Most Asian GPU loans follow the structure pioneered by CoreWeave (CRWV‑US). CoreWeave was one of the earliest and largest users of this financing model. Many transactions repay the loan from revenue generated by selling compute capacity, while customer contracts and the chips themselves often serve as collateral.
Thus, for lenders the key questions are: how reliable are these customers and how long are the contracts?
Nvidia Provides Guarantees, Chinese Customers Drive Demand

Deals backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US) are easier for lenders to approve. In the loan transactions completed last month for GMI Cloud and Zankore, Nvidia agreed to purchase any unsold compute capacity, providing a safety net if a customer contract falls through.
In return, the companies participating in Nvidia’s cloud partner program will charge buyers at rates higher than Nvidia’s committed price and share revenue with Nvidia.

Large Chinese tech firms are also becoming a major source of compute demand in Asia. A loan‑officer at a European bank said these firms are relatively reliable because they can also attract Chinese banks to participate in financing.

Sources said that the end‑user of the chips GMI Cloud plans to buy for a Thai data centre will be Tencent. Another source disclosed in December that China’s popular social platform Xiaohongshu plans to purchase compute capacity from the chips procured for PaleBlueDot AI’s Japan project.
Regulatory Risks From Chinese Customers Remain Unclear

However, Chinese customers also bring additional risk. The United States has restricted chip exports to China and is considering new legislation aimed at limiting Chinese firms’ remote use of Nvidia chips via cloud services, thereby curbing their ability to rent compute located abroad.

S&P Global Ratings analyst Yijing Ng said, “Large Chinese cloud providers generally have solid credit profiles,” but she warned that banks must conduct thorough due‑diligence to ensure compliance with regulations and that the ultimate compute users do not violate any sanctions or restrictions.
At the same time, the debate over whether AI poses an existential threat and whether protective mechanisms should be built into its development will continue to shape risk assessments.

Tan of Hogan Lovells Cadwalader concluded, “The market may need time to find a balance. Deal structures could become stricter, government support may intervene, and transaction models will evolve accordingly.”

items.title: 沙烏地輸油管再遇襲停運 胡塞放話：領空將成戰場
items.title_en: Saudi Oil Pipelines Hit Again, Houthi Says Saudi Airspace Will Become Battlefield
paras: 葉門戰事升溫。胡塞武裝持續推進塔伊茲前線，政府軍消息人士稱，城內部隊已遭圍困。沙烏地阿拉伯主導的多國聯軍則宣布，出動100架戰機執行「葉門黎明」行動，支援政府軍反攻。胡塞武裝隨後警告，沙烏地領空將成為作戰區域；法新社報導稱，沙烏地東西輸油管再度遇襲停運。
根據戰報，胡塞武裝10月4日攻入圖爾巴鎮，沿塔伊茲公路推進，控制哈亞米、納許馬、比林及加札利亞等地，並向阿盧姆地區進攻。至5日，胡塞武裝推進至連接塔伊茲與亞丁的最後一條主要公路部分路段，進一步收緊包圍圈，圖爾巴及南部通道仍持續交戰。
沙烏地支援的部隊同時在塔伊茲其他地區及杜巴卜、曼德海峽附近反攻。聯軍發言人馬利基5日表示，100架戰機當天凌晨參與「葉門黎明」行動，已摧毀324個「高價值目標」，並持續打擊移動目標。聯軍另稱，正為政府軍提供全天候空中支援，同時保護曼德海峽。
葉門軍方發言人努扎伊利表示，包括南方巨人旅及民族之盾部隊在內的政府軍已控制曼德海峽。地面部隊從卡赫布山脈發動側翼包抄，控制杜巴卜區及當地戰略機場，隨後切斷通往北部港口城市摩卡的公路。
政府軍宣稱，已在杜巴卜地區包圍數百名胡塞武裝人員，截斷撤退路線並要求投降。胡塞武裝發布的影片則顯示，聯軍車隊遭飛彈與無人機攻擊。
胡塞武裝透過旗下薩巴通訊社發布警告，稱沙烏地領空已不再安全，將成為其部隊作戰區域，並向在該空域營運的航空公司示警，利雅德與吉達的民航運作受到影響。
法新社報導，沙烏地官方確認東西輸油管因再度遇襲而停運，其他受損泵站仍在修復，又有一座泵站遭到攻擊。
葉門總統領導委員會主席阿里米5日宣布，發動「葉門黎明」行動，目標是恢復國家機構運作、收復首都薩那並結束胡塞武裝叛亂。
paras_en: Yemen’s war is heating up. Houthi forces continue to advance on the Taiz front, and government‑military sources say city troops are now besieged. The Saudi‑led multinational coalition announced it deployed 100 warplanes for the “Yemen Dawn” operation to support the government’s counter‑offensive. The Houthis then warned that Saudi airspace would become a combat zone; AFP reported that Saudi east‑west oil pipelines were hit again and shut down.

According to battle reports, on October 4 the Houthis entered the town of Turba, pushing along the Taiz highway and taking control of Hayami, Nashma, Biling and Gazzalia, and advancing toward the Al‑Ulum area. By the 5th they had reached sections of the last main road linking Taiz and Aden, tightening the encirclement, while fighting continued in Turba and the southern corridor.

Saudi‑backed forces were also counter‑attacking in other parts of Taiz as well as near Duba and the Mandeb Strait. Coalition spokesman Malikhi said on the 5th that 100 aircraft took part in the “Yemen Dawn” operation in the early hours, destroying 324 “high‑value targets” and continuing to strike moving targets. The coalition added it is providing round‑the‑clock air support to government forces while also protecting the Mandeb Strait.

Yemen’s military spokesperson Nuzaili said government forces, including the Southern Giant Brigade and the National Shield units, have secured the Mandeb Strait. Ground troops launched a flanking maneuver from the Kahab mountains, seized the Duba area and its strategic airfield, and then cut the road to the northern port city of Mokha.

Government forces claim they have surrounded hundreds of Houthi fighters in the Duba area, cut off their retreat routes and called for their surrender. Houthi‑released video shows coalition convoys being hit by missiles and drones.

The Houthis, via their Saba news agency, warned that Saudi airspace is no longer safe and will become a combat zone for their forces, alerting airlines operating in the area that civil aviation in Riyadh and Jeddah is being affected.

AFP reported that Saudi officials confirmed the east‑west oil pipelines were shut down after being hit again; other damaged pump stations are still being repaired and another station has also been attacked.

Ali Mi, chairman of Yemen’s Presidential Leadership Council, announced on the 5th the launch of the “Yemen Dawn” operation, aimed at restoring state institutions, recapturing the capital Sana’a and ending the Houthi rebellion.

items.title: 受惠比特幣價格反彈 Strategy第三季大賺209億美元 終結連四季虧損
items.title_en: Strategy Posts $20.91 Billion Q3 Gain from Bitcoin Price Rebound, Ends Four-Quarter Loss Streak
paras: 全球最大比特幣公開持有企業 Strategy Inc.(MSTR-US)周一(5日)公布，受惠於第三季加密貨幣市場反彈，公司單季錄得約 209.1 億美元數位資產未實現收益，成功終結連續四季虧損，重返獲利軌道。

稅務利益助攻獲利

根據 Strategy 申報的 8-K 文件，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止的3個月內，比特幣價格上揚 43%。在公允價值會計準則(Fair Value Accounting)下，數位資產公允價值變動直接計入損益表，導致季業績劇烈波動。此結果與第二季形成鮮明對比——第二季因比特幣走跌產生 83.2 億美元未實現損失，導致單季淨虧損達 82.2 億美元。
此外，由於第三季末比特幣公允價值超越成本基礎，公司先前於 6 月底提列的 41.2 億美元遞延所得稅資產備抵評價帳項(Valuation Allowance)獲准釋放，產生等額所得稅利益，將當季遞延所得稅費用壓降至 18.8 億美元。截至 9 月底，Strategy 持有的數位資產帳面價值已達 708.2 億美元。

持倉突破84.8萬枚比特幣

在資產布局上，Strategy 延續累積策略。文件顯示，公司於 10 月 1 日至 4 日期間，再以 2,870 萬美元購入 334 枚比特幣。截至 2026 年 10 月 4 日，Strategy 累計持有高達 848,000 枚比特幣，總取得成本為 639.7 億美元，平均持倉成本為每枚 75,441 美元，當前持倉市值約 730 億美元。
為支應購幣計畫，Strategy 近年積極發行特別股與普通股，但也面臨股東對股權稀釋的疑慮，加上 STRC 特別股價格走低，使發行新特別股效益受限。
對此，公司積極調整資本架構，除了維護 48.8 億美元的「美元準備金」與 8.334 億美元的「美元現金」外，近一周內斥資約 1.76 億美元買回 STRC 特別股。
公司高層對其資本政策表達強烈信心。共同創辦人及執行主席塞勒(Michael Saylor)表示，公司將 STRC 特別股的股利發放頻率改為每日支付，期盼藉此「降低股價波動並改善特別股流動性」。
塞勒先前已強調，公司正致力於將「數位信用確立為新型資產類別」，並於 X 平台發文證實公司已累積逾 57 億美元的美元資產與龐大比特幣儲備。
paras_en: Strategy Inc., the world’s largest publicly‑held Bitcoin company (MSTR‑US), announced on Monday (the 5th) that a rebound in the cryptocurrency market in the third quarter generated roughly $20.91 billion of unrealized digital‑asset gains, ending four consecutive quarters of losses and returning to profitability.

Tax benefits helped the profit. According to Strategy’s Form 8‑K, Bitcoin rose 43% over the three months ending September 30, 2026. Under Fair Value Accounting, changes in the fair value of digital assets flow directly to the income statement, causing sharp quarterly swings. This contrasts sharply with Q2, when a Bitcoin decline produced an $8.32 billion unrealized loss and a net quarterly loss of $8.22 billion.

In addition, because Bitcoin’s fair value at the end of Q3 exceeded its cost basis, the $4.12 billion valuation‑allowance reserve for deferred tax assets that the company set aside at the end of June was released, creating an equal tax benefit and cutting the quarter’s deferred tax expense to $1.88 billion. As of the end of September, Strategy’s digital‑asset book value stood at $70.82 billion.

Holding over 848,000 Bitcoin. Strategy continued its accumulation strategy. The filing shows that between Oct. 1 and Oct. 4 the company bought another 334 Bitcoin for $28.7 million. As of Oct. 4, 2026, Strategy owned a total of 848,000 Bitcoin at a total cost of $63.97 billion, an average cost of $75,441 per coin, with a current market value of about $73 billion.

To fund its buying plan, Strategy has recently issued both preferred and common shares, but faces shareholder concerns about dilution, and the declining price of its STRC preferred shares has limited the effectiveness of new issuances.

In response, the company is reshaping its capital structure, maintaining a $4.88 billion “U.S. reserve” and $833.4 million of “U.S. cash,” and in the past week spent roughly $176 million to repurchase STRC preferred shares.

Senior executives expressed strong confidence in the capital policy. Co‑founder and Executive Chairman Michael Saylor said the company will shift STRC preferred‑share dividend payments to a daily schedule, hoping to “reduce price volatility and improve preferred‑share liquidity.”

Saylor previously emphasized that the firm is working to establish “digital credit as a new asset class,” and posted on X that Strategy has amassed over $5.7 billion in U.S. dollar assets alongside a massive Bitcoin reserve.

items.title: OpenAI奧特曼批馬斯克是「霸凌者」：他只尊重敢反擊的人
items.title_en: OpenAI CEO Altman Calls Musk a ‘Bully’: He Only Respects Those Who Fight Back
paras: OpenAI執行長奧特曼近日受訪表示，儘管與馬斯克長期不和，他仍願意在 AI 安全議題上與對方合作。不過，他認為，雙方若要共事，就必須接受一定程度的衝突，因為有時必須當面回擊「霸凌者」。
奧特曼與馬斯克曾公開決裂，兩人的矛盾也是多起法律糾紛的核心。如今，隨著業界再度關注 AI 安全問題，這場紛爭也成為全球主要 AI 企業尋求技術管控共識的背景。
奧特曼在採訪中說：「我認為，有時候你必須當面回擊霸凌者。而且我覺得，馬斯克和很多霸凌者一樣，只尊重敢於反擊他的人。」
儘管馬斯克如今經常稱他為「騙子奧特曼」，奧特曼仍表達合作意願。他說：「如果你們希望我能和他共事，那或許應該慶幸我偶爾會反擊。當然，我願意與馬斯克合作。」
奧特曼也表示，自己「不會自詡為聖人」，但不認為自己是雙方關係中最大的問題。「在馬斯克和我之間，我不確定我才是那個應該被你們針對的人。」
今年 7 月，社群平台 X 上一名用戶聲稱，曾就「騙子奧特曼」向全世界發出警告。馬斯克轉發該貼文，並批評奧特曼「把行騙手段提升到了一個新高度」。
奧特曼隨後回擊，質疑馬斯克建造軌道資料中心的構想。他此前已多次對這項提議表達懷疑，並在回應中寫道：「老兄，明明是你自己在向公開市場投資人兜售短期內打造太空資料中心的概念。」
儘管雙方持續交鋒，AI 企業仍採取行動加強合作。今年 7 月，OpenAI、Anthropic、SpaceXAI、Google 與輝達的高層簽署一項由白宮支持的協議，內容包含 AI 安全相關的自願性承諾。這項協議讓在快速發展的 AI 市場不同領域相互競爭的企業，共同參與安全合作。
奧特曼強調，這不代表業界領袖透過單一管道溝通，並沒有一個將所有領先 AI 企業負責人串聯起來的群組聊天室。各方透過通話、會議及非正式碰面交換意見，包括在業界會議期間交流。
不過，考量奧特曼與馬斯克之間的深刻分歧，這類合作對兩人而言可能格外困難。合作意願能否轉化為實質合作，目前仍不明朗。
paras_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman recently said in an interview that despite a long‑standing feud with Elon Musk, he is still willing to cooperate with him on AI safety issues. However, he believes that for the two to work together they must accept a certain level of conflict, because sometimes one has to confront a “bully” face‑to‑face.

Altman and Musk publicly split, and their rivalry has been at the core of multiple legal disputes. Now, as the industry refocuses on AI safety, this feud provides the backdrop for major AI companies worldwide seeking consensus on technology governance.
Altman told the reporter, “I think sometimes you have to confront a bully in person. And I feel that Musk, like many bullies, only respects people who are willing to stand up to him.”

Even though Musk now often calls him a “fraudulent Altman,” Altman still expressed a willingness to cooperate. He said, “If you want me to work with him, maybe you should be glad that I sometimes push back. Of course, I’m willing to work with Musk.”
Altman also said he “doesn’t claim to be a saint,” but does not see himself as the biggest problem in the relationship. “Between Musk and me, I’m not sure I’m the one you should be targeting.”
In July, a user on the X platform claimed to have warned the world about the “fraudulent Altman.” Musk retweeted the post and criticized Altman for “taking scamming to a new level.”

Altman responded by questioning Musk’s idea of building an orbital data center. He has repeatedly expressed doubt about the proposal and wrote in his reply, “Bro, you’re the one selling the short‑term concept of a space data center to public‑market investors.”

Despite the ongoing sparring, AI firms are moving forward with cooperation. In July, senior executives from OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX AI, Google and Nvidia signed a White‑House‑backed agreement that includes voluntary commitments on AI safety. The pact brings together companies competing across different AI sectors to jointly engage in safety collaboration.

Altman stressed that this does not mean industry leaders are communicating through a single channel or that there is a group chat linking all top AI executives. Participants exchange views via calls, meetings and informal gatherings, including conversations held during industry conferences.

However, given the deep rift between Altman and Musk, such cooperation may be especially difficult for the two. Whether the expressed willingness to cooperate can translate into concrete joint action remains unclear.

items.title_en: Stocks and Currency Surge! Bolsonaro Leads Brazil Presidential Election, Stock Market Jumps 9% to Six‑Year High, Real Rises 5%, 3× Leveraged ETN Soars 37%
paras: 由於參議員波索納洛在巴西大選首輪投票中意外領先現任總統魯拉，巴西資產大漲，雷亞爾一度飆升5%，股市創六年來最大單日漲幅，三倍做多巴西ETN更大漲37%。
當地時間周日(4日)晚上，巴西總統大選首輪投票結果出爐，前總統之子、自由黨候選人弗拉維奧·波索納洛以約47%得票率意外領先現任總統魯拉以約45%位居第二，兩人將於10月25日進行第二輪角逐。
波索納洛比魯拉更親市場，首輪表現好於預期，帶動巴西股市、匯市全線大漲，巴西基準股指Bovespa一度大漲超9%，創2022年以來最大漲幅，巴西雷亞爾狂升值逾5%。
花旗建議投資人加碼巴西股票和本幣債券的看漲押注。該行策略師在最新研報中寫道：「波索納洛是對市場更友善的候選人，承諾實施財政緊縮、私有化、放鬆監管以及下調增值稅，其政黨在參議院的強勁表現應有助於推動其立法議程獲得通過。」
預測市場定價也顯示，預期波索納洛在10月25日決選中獲勝的機率很高，花旗建議買入巴西股票以及2031年到期的政府債券，即所謂的NTN-F。
paras_en: Because Senate candidate Jair Bolsonaro unexpectedly led incumbent President Lula in the first round of Brazil's presidential election, Brazilian assets rallied sharply, the real spiked up to 5% and the stock market posted its biggest single‑day gain in six years, while a 3× long Brazil ETN surged another 37%.

On Sunday night local time (the 4th), the first‑round results of Brazil's presidential election were released: former president’s son and Liberal Party candidate Flávio Bolsonaro captured about 47% of the vote, unexpectedly ahead of incumbent President Lula who came second with roughly 45%, and the two will face off in a runoff on October 25.

Bolsonaro is seen as more market‑friendly than Lula, and his better‑than‑expected first‑round performance drove a broad rally in Brazil’s equities and foreign‑exchange markets. The benchmark Bovespa index surged more than 9% at one point, the biggest jump since 2022, while the Brazilian real appreciated by over 5%.

Citigroup recommends investors increase exposure to Brazilian equities and local‑currency bonds. In its latest research note, the bank’s strategists wrote: “Bolsonaro is a candidate more favorable to markets, pledging fiscal tightening, privatizations, deregulation and a cut to the value‑added tax; his party’s strong showing in the Senate should help push his legislative agenda through.”

Market pricing forecasts also show a high probability that Bolsonaro will win the October 25 runoff. Citigroup advises buying Brazilian stocks and government bonds maturing in 2031, the so‑called NTN‑F.

paras: 美元周一(5日)小幅走高，主要受到歐元下跌的帶動。歐元一度跌至近17個月來最低水準，因市場對法國政府債務危機的擔憂升溫。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報102.14，創2025年4月9日以來最高。
歐元兌美元下跌0.3%，至1歐元兌1.1222美元，盤中一度跌至1.1161美元，為2025年5月16日以來最低。
歐洲外匯市場參與者正密切關注法國日益嚴重的財政衝擊。由於法國公共債務持續攀升，加上在明年總統大選前政治僵局嚴重，市場開始重新評估法國主權債券的風險溢價。
法國政府債券遭到猛烈拋售，兩年期公債殖利率單日大幅上升76個基點。同時，法國10年期 OAT國債與德國10年期Bund國債之間殖利率利差突破140個基點，創下2012年歐元區債務危機以來最大利差。
此外，法國5年期信用違約交換(CDS)價格飆升至87個基點，顯示外匯市場交易員正積極反映法國財政問題可能進一步蔓延至整個歐元區的風險。
法國上週公布了2027年度預算案，目標透過削減540億歐元(約605.9億美元)支出，將政府財政赤字控制在GDP的5%。然而，法國目前仍面臨嚴重財政問題。今年財政赤字預計將達GDP的5.4%，公共債務則接近GDP的120%。
美債拋售仍推升美元
在美國方面，美國公債遭到大量拋售，導致殖利率大幅上升。
10年期美國公債殖利率上升2.9個基點，至5.309%，30年期公債殖利率則上升3個基點，至5.660%。兩者目前都徘徊在數十年來高點附近。
上周，對利率變化較敏感的短天期美債曾稍微獲得喘息，因美國經濟數據公布後，市場對聯準會(Fed)即將升息的預期有所下降。
聯準會偏好的通膨指標最新數據顯示，年增率有所放緩，同時，意外疲弱的非農就業報告也顯示美國勞動市場可能正在稍微降溫。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場預期本月底升息25個基點的機率，在上周結束時已降至約20%，而在該周初時還約為70%。
本周美國經濟數據相對清淡，市場主要關注聯準會上一次利率會議的會議紀要
周一，美國供應管理協會(ISM)公布9月服務業報告，顯示服務業經濟活動較8月放緩，但仍維持在代表擴張的區域。值得注意的是，服務業企業支付的價格指標在9月加速上升，創下2022年7月以來最高水準。
Lloyds Bank分析師表示，「本月初的數據相對清淡。這周主要焦點將是最終版的服務業與綜合PMI數據。這些數據應能提供更多歐元區經濟細節，並可能進一步說明能源價格上升所帶來的影響。此前公布的初步數據中，能源價格上漲的影響並不明顯。」

European FX market participants are closely watching France's worsening fiscal shock. With French public debt continuing to climb and a severe political deadlock ahead of next year’s presidential election, markets are reassessing the risk premium on French sovereign bonds.

French government bonds faced a sharp sell‑off, with the two‑year yield jumping 76 basis points in a single day. At the same time, the spread between France’s 10‑year OAT and Germany’s 10‑year Bund surged past 140 basis points, the widest gap since the euro‑area debt crisis of 2012.

The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose 2.9 basis points to 5.309%, while the 30‑year yield climbed 3 basis points to 5.660%. Both are now hovering near multi‑decade highs.

The Fed‑preferred inflation gauge showed a slowdown in the annual growth rate, and a surprisingly weak jobs report suggested the U.S. labor market may be cooling slightly.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a 25‑basis‑point rate hike by the end of the month fell to about 20% by the end of last week, down from roughly 70% at the start of the week.
U.S. economic data this week is relatively light, with the market mainly focused on the Fed’s minutes from the last rate‑setting meeting.

Lloyds Bank analyst said, “Data early this month have been relatively light. This week’s main focus will be the final services and composite PMI releases. Those numbers should provide more detail on the euro‑area economy and may further clarify the impact of rising energy prices. items.title: 美元快衝今年新高！策略師卻提醒別急著追
items.title_en: Dollar races to new high this year! Strategists warn not to chase it hastily
paras: 美元逼近今年最強水準，歐洲財政壓力與政治不確定性推升避險需求，但連續上漲也讓市場擔心漲勢過熱。本周美國經濟數據與聯準會(Fed)政策訊號，將成為美元能否續強的關鍵。
隨著歐元走弱，彭博美元現貨指數一度上漲0.4%，延續此前連續3周的漲勢。不過，部分技術指標顯示美元已進入超買區域，意味後續可能面臨回檔。
市場將密切關注ISM服務業採購經理人指數(PMI)、就業數據，以及周五公布的密西根大學消費者信心指數。Fed上月首次在3年來升息的會議紀錄與官員談話，也將影響市場對後續利率走向的判斷。
法國農業信貸銀行(Credit Agricole)(ACA-FR)G10外匯研究與策略主管Valentin Marinov表示，美元已超買且估值偏高，若本周美國數據不如預期，尤其促使投資人重新評估聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)鷹派共識的穩固程度，美元可能承壓。該行一項模型目前建議做多英鎊及瑞典克朗兌美元。
歐元疲弱與美國進一步升息預期，是近期美元走強的主要動力。但若市場開始質疑Fed政策路徑，或重新擔憂美國財政狀況，美元可能從高點回落。
分析師雖預期歐元仍有下跌空間，也指出近期賣壓主要來自歐洲債市緊張，若疑慮緩解，跌勢可能逆轉。相較瑞士法郎與挪威克朗，歐元兌美元跌幅仍較有限，顯示市場的看空押注並非只集中在歐元。
近期轉向看好美元的摩根士丹利(MS-US)也保持謹慎。David Adams領軍的外匯策略團隊警告，若不利美元的風險溢價突然升高，美元多頭部位可能觸發停損。因此，該行傾向等待回檔再買進，而非在目前價位追高。
paras_en: The dollar is nearing its strongest level of the year, as fiscal pressure in Europe and political uncertainty boost safe‑haven demand, but its continuous rise is causing the market to worry about an overheated rally. This week’s U.S. economic data and Federal Reserve policy signals will be key to whether the dollar can keep strengthening.

With the euro weakening, the Bloomberg Dollar Spot Index rose as much as 0.4%, extending a three‑week winning streak. However, some technical indicators show the dollar has entered overbought territory, suggesting a possible pull‑back ahead.

The market will watch the ISM Services PMI, employment figures, and Friday’s University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index closely. The Fed’s minutes from last month’s first rate‑hike meeting in three years, along with officials’ remarks, will also shape expectations for future rate moves.

Valentin Marinov, head of G10 FX research and strategy at Credit Agricole (ACA‑FR), said the dollar is overbought and overvalued; if this week’s U.S. data disappoint, especially if it leads investors to reassess the firmness of the FOMC’s hawkish consensus, the dollar could come under pressure. The bank’s model currently recommends going long the pound and the Swedish krona against the dollar.

The euro’s weakness and expectations of further U.S. rate hikes have been the main drivers of the dollar’s recent strength. But if the market begins to doubt the Fed’s policy path or revives concerns about U.S. fiscal conditions, the dollar could retreat from its highs.

Analysts, while still seeing downside potential for the euro, note that recent selling pressure stems mainly from tension in European bond markets; if those worries ease, the euro’s decline could reverse. Compared with the Swiss franc and Norwegian krone, the euro’s fall against the dollar remains relatively modest, showing bearish bets are not solely focused on the euro.

Morgan Stanley (MS‑US), which has recently turned more bullish on the dollar, remains cautious. Led by David Adams, the FX strategy team warns that a sudden spike in the risk premium against the dollar could trigger stop‑losses on long positions, so the firm prefers to wait for a pull‑back before buying rather than chasing higher prices now.

items.title: 〈台幣〉聯準會10月不見得會再升息 股匯齊揚升值4.2分收31.788元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar: Fed May Not Raise Rates Again in October, Stocks and Currency Both Rise, Up 4.2 Points to 31.788
paras: 隨著市場對美國繼續升息的預期轉弱，台股持續攻高，今(5)日飆漲多達1236點，台北匯市也同步走強，新台幣全日處在升值態勢，終場收在31.788元，升值4.2分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值18.18億美元。
新台幣今日以31.81元、升值2分開出後，最高來到31.74元，全日高低價差7分。
觀察主要亞幣，美元指數波動大，目前反彈約0.2%，泰銖貶逾0.6%，人民幣和星元貶0.05%左右，日元和韓元處平盤左右，新台幣收升0.13%。
聯準會預計10月27日舉行會議，元大投顧說明，聯準會副主席認為可能需要更多時間評估是否需要進一步升息，負責金融監理的副主席鮑曼也表示，需要更多時間了解經濟的基本趨勢，因此，市場對再度升息的擔憂緩解，目前台股關注議題回到9月營收和季報公告，個股強弱分明。
國泰證期研究部也指出，美國9月非農就業僅增2.9萬人，遠低於預期8.4萬人，且前值遭下修，失業率升至4.2%、時薪放緩，使市場對聯準會在10月底升息至少1碼的機率從64.2%一口氣降至22.7%。
惟10年期美債殖利率逆勢升至5.28%，對於台股而言會限制權值股的發揮，預期維持高檔震盪與題材輪動。
paras_en: As market expectations for further US rate hikes weaken, Taiwan’s stock market kept climbing, surging as much as 1,236 points today (Oct 5). The Taipei foreign exchange market also strengthened, with the New Taiwan dollar appreciating throughout the day and closing at 31.788, up 4.2 points. Taipei FX brokers reported a turnover of $1.818 billion.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.81, up 2 points, and peaked at 31.74, with a daily high‑low spread of 7 points.

Looking at other major Asian currencies, the US dollar index was volatile, rebounding about 0.2%. The Thai baht fell over 0.6%, the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each weakened roughly 0.05%, while the Japanese yen and South Korean won stayed near flat. The New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.13%.

The Fed is slated to meet on Oct. 27. According to Yuanta Securities, the Fed’s vice‑chair said more time may be needed to assess whether further hikes are required, and the vice‑chair for financial supervision, Bowman, also said more time is needed to understand the economy’s underlying trend. Consequently, concerns about another hike have eased, and market focus on Taiwan stocks has shifted back to September revenue and earnings releases, with clear winners and losers among individual stocks.

Cathay Securities’ research team noted that US non‑farm payrolls rose by only 22,900 in September, far below the forecast of 84,000 and a revision of the prior figure. The unemployment rate rose to 4.2% and wage growth slowed, cutting the market’s estimate of a 1‑point Fed hike by the end of October from 64.2% to 22.7%.

However, the 10‑year US Treasury yield rose against the trend to 5.28%, which could limit the performance of large‑cap stocks in Taiwan. The market is expected to stay in a high‑level range with sector rotation continuing.

items.title: 歐元重挫至17個月新低 美元走強引發全球匯市波動
items.title_en: Euro Plummets to 17-Month Low as Strong Dollar Sparks Global FX Turmoil
paras: 受歐元區政治動盪與財政風險加劇影響，歐元兌美元於亞市周一(5日)盤中一度重挫 0.8% 至 1.1161，創下自 2025 年 5 月以來的 17 個月新低。
亞洲現貨市場的快速資金大量拋售歐元換取美元，推動價格突破止損點並引發期權相關賣盤，進一步加劇跌勢。同時，美元指數升至 102.48 左右，亞洲貨幣、英鎊與日元普遍承壓。
針對法國與歐元區的局勢，外匯分析公司 Spectra Markets 交易總裁Brent Donnelly表示：「許多人原本預期隨著 2027 年 4 月大選臨近，法國政治效應會在今冬升級，但這波交易現在已經爆發。」他補充稱：「有鑑於政權即將更迭，法國政府目前做出的預算承諾可信度並不高，目前尚不清楚該如何修復局勢。」
摩根大通包括Meera Chandan在內的策略師團隊則指出，歐元尚未完全反映法國國債市場擴大的利差與相關尾部風險。他們在報告中寫道：「歐元兌瑞郎匯率依然偏高，未來可能繼續向下調整。」
馬來亞銀行資深外匯策略師Fiona Lim分析：「儘管美國勞工報告偏弱，但美元似乎已擺脫影響；在法國信用違約交換(CDS)利差大幅擴大後，市場焦點轉向了歐元區。」
她指出，這引發了對歐元區其他高負債邊緣經濟體財政狀況的關注，從而進一步支撐了美元的強勢。
paras_en: Affected by political turmoil and heightened fiscal risks in the euro area, the euro fell sharply against the dollar in Asian markets on Monday (the 5th), dropping 0.8% intraday to 1.1161, a 17‑month low not seen since May 2025.

Rapid fund outflows in the Asian spot market saw massive euro sales for dollars, pushing the price through stop‑loss levels and triggering related option sell‑offs, further deepening the decline. At the same time, the dollar index rose to around 102.48, putting pressure on Asian currencies, the pound and the yen.

Commenting on the situation in France and the euro area, Brent Donnelly, President of Trading at forex analysis firm Spectra Markets, said: “Many had expected the French political effect to intensify this winter as the April 2027 election approached, but this wave of trading has now erupted.” He added: “Given the impending change of government, the credibility of the budget commitments made by the French government is low, and it is unclear how the situation can be repaired.”

A strategy team at JPMorgan, including Meera Chandan, noted that the euro has not yet fully priced in the widening spread in French sovereign bonds and the associated tail risk. In their report they wrote: “The euro/CHF exchange rate remains elevated and may continue to be adjusted downward in the future.”

Senior FX strategist Fiona Lim of Maybank analyzed: “Even though the US labor report was weak, the dollar seems to have shrugged off the impact; after French credit default swap (CDS) spreads widened dramatically, market focus shifted to the euro area.”
She pointed out that this has sparked concerns about the fiscal health of other highly indebted fringe economies in the euro zone, further underpinning the dollar’s strength.

據日本經濟財政大臣城內實稱，日本已不再處於通貨緊縮狀態，因此無需採取旨在追求更高通貨膨脹率的過度寬鬆貨幣政策，提供日圓支撐，並隨著美國勞工部公布9月非農業就業崗位僅增加2.9萬個及失業率升至4.2%，平均時薪則較前月微升0.1%，皆遜於預期，同時8月就業崗位增幅下修至13.3萬個，而且美國8月工廠訂單增0.1%與預期相符，但耐久財訂單修正較前月跌0.1%遜於預估值，促使利率期貨市場大幅削減FED於10月加息的可能性至低於20%，打擊美元兌日圓至156.94低點，但市場仍預計FED維持鷹派利率立場，扶助美元拉回部分跌幅。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於157.70-90，支撐於156.70-90。
◆EUR/USD
美國公債收益率上升，導致澳洲公債相對於美國公債的收益率優勢縮減至一年多以來最低，並據上週五消息人士表示，外交斡旋前景暗淡，若美國恢復大規模軍事襲擊，伊朗醞釀強力報復來迎戰美國新攻擊，提升避險情緒，打壓澳幣和紐元至數月低點附近，而且市場對法國債務問題的擔憂加劇，拖累歐元兌美元下滑至1.1220低點。

隨後歐盟統計局數據顯示，受燃料和天然氣價格上漲推動，歐元區9月消費者物價調和指數(HICP)初值升至3.8%，整體通貨膨脹率進一步超過歐洲央行(ECB)的2%目標，讓ECB面臨再升息壓力，並據德國央行(Bundesbank)總裁納格爾稱，強勁出口需求及政府投資推動，德國今年經濟增長料為最新預測兩倍約1%，而且美國就業數據弱打擊美元，提振歐元兌美元至1.1285高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1250-70，支撐於1.1160-80。
◆GBP/USD
能源價格走高，引發全球債券市場風暴，英國公債收益率創1998年以來新高，突顯市場擔憂英國財政狀況，上週五推低英鎊兌美元至1.3178低點。隨著歐洲部分債務負擔沉重國家財政前景憂慮加劇，拖累歐元兌英鎊，而且美國就業數據弱損及美元，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3255高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3240-60，支撐於1.3140-60。

Last week two senior Federal Reserve officials argued that more data should be gathered before deciding the next monetary‑policy move, prompting market participants to stop betting on a rate hike at the Fed’s late‑October meeting. However, reports of the United States sending additional troops and an aircraft carrier to the Middle East and China suspending oil‑product exports sent oil prices soaring and U.S. Treasury yields climbing to their highest level since 2002, supporting the dollar near a 17‑month high. Meanwhile, Japan’s August unemployment rate rose to 2.5% according to Friday’s data, the job‑seeking ratio held steady at 1.18, and Tokyo’s September core CPI accelerated 2.7% year‑on‑year – the biggest rise in ten months and above expectations. This figure is widely seen as a leading indicator of nationwide inflation and will be one of the factors the Bank of Japan (BOJ) considers when updating its quarterly inflation forecast at its October 29‑30 policy meeting, providing a rationale for further rate hikes. Although bets on consecutive BOJ hikes have faded, many still expect a hike in December, which could boost the yen and pull USD/JPY down from its 158.21 peak.

According to Japan’s Finance Minister Shiroi, Japan is no longer in deflation, so there is no need for overly accommodative policy aimed at chasing higher inflation, which should support the yen. At the same time, the U.S. Labor Department reported that September non‑farm payrolls rose by only 29,000 jobs and the unemployment rate climbed to 4.2%, while average hourly earnings edged up 0.1% from the previous month – all below expectations. August job gains were revised down to 133,000, and August factory orders rose 0.1% in line with forecasts, but durable‑goods orders fell 0.1% month‑over‑month, missing estimates. These weak data caused the rate‑futures market to slash the probability of a Fed hike in October to below 20%, pushing USD/JPY down to a low of 156.94, though the market still expects the Fed to maintain a hawkish stance, helping the dollar recover some losses. The dollar‑yen resistance today is projected at 157.70‑90 with support at 156.70‑90.
EUR/USD

Sources said on Friday that diplomatic prospects look bleak; if the United States resumes large‑scale military strikes, Iran is poised to launch a strong retaliation against new U.S. attacks, heightening risk‑off sentiment and pushing the Australian and New Zealand dollars toward multi‑month lows. At the same time, growing concerns over France’s debt issues have weighed on the euro, pulling EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1220.

Eurostat data released later showed that the Eurozone’s September Harmonised CPI (HICP) preliminary reading rose to 3.8% on the back of higher fuel and natural‑gas prices, pushing overall inflation further above the European Central Bank’s 2% target and adding pressure for another rate hike. Bundesbank President Nagel said strong export demand and government investment are driving Germany’s growth forecast to about 1% this year – roughly double the latest estimate – and weak U.S. employment data have hurt the dollar, lifting the euro to a high of 1.1285. The euro‑dollar resistance today is estimated at 1.1250‑70 with support at 1.1160‑80.

paras: 《Marketwatch》報導，投資銀行摩根士丹利 (Morgan Stanley) 外匯策略團隊於近期發布的研究報告中公開承認預測失誤，表示原先看空美元的理由已不復存在，並同步調升今年底至 2027 年的美元指數與主要貨幣目標價。
衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣價值的美元指數 (DXY) 近期強勢走高，本週攀升至 101 附近，創近八週新高。美元走強雖提升了美國民眾海外消費的購買力，卻也令美國出口商品成本上升。近期連美國總統川普在會晤日本首相高市早苗時，亦公開提及對日元過度貶值的關切。
由 David S. Adams 領軍的小摩外匯策略團隊在報告中坦言：「我們錯了！」
小摩團隊先前預期美元將於今年下半年持續下行、年底觸底，並至 2027 年轉強，該預測建立在美國與全球利差將縮小、聯準會 (Fed) 暫停升息而其他央行追趕的假設上。
然而，居高不下的能源價格與強勁的美國經濟數據，促使聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 展現偏鷹派政策立場，使美國進一步升息的可能性大幅增加。
根據 CME FedWatch 利率期貨數據顯示，市場預期 Fed 於 10 月會議升息 1 碼 (至 4.00% 至 4.25% 區間)) 的機率已達 68.6%，12 月再度升息 1 碼的機率亦超過五成。
摩根士丹利指出，市場仍有相當大的空間繼續推升升息預期，這將為美元提供穩固的支撐力量。
因應基本面變化，摩根士丹利全面調升美元目標價：

將今年底美元指數預測由原先的 96 大幅上修至 102；
歐元兌美元由 1.20 下調至 1.12 美元；
英鎊兌美元由 1.38 下調至 1.30 美元；
美元兌日元則由 157 上調至 159 日元。


展望 2027 年年中，隨著歐洲政治與財政疑慮再現，預期美元指數將上看 104，歐元兌美元可能進一步走軟至 1.10 美元。在交易策略上，團隊建議可於美元兌日元 158 時建立多頭部位，目標價看 163 日元，停損價設於 150 日元。
不過，摩根士丹利亦提出幾點風險警示。
首先，美元此波強勢主要集中於對抗日元、歐元及瑞士法郎等低利率融資貨幣，而澳元及挪威克朗等商品貨幣仍將維持相對強勢。
其次，部分貶值預期已反映於市場期權價格中，變動幅度可能相對有限。
最後，政治與政策等突發事件仍可能引發震盪，例如關稅政策宣佈或外匯干預等黑天鵝事件，都可能引發美元多頭部位的連鎖停損賣壓。
事實上，不僅是小摩，一些投行也紛紛看多美元。
德國商業銀行分析師 Thu Lan Nguyen 指出，Fed 9 月一致決議升息，暫時恢復了市場對其政策可信度的信心，並支撐美元。該行因此將今年底歐元兌美元預測從 1.17 下修至 1.15，預期 Fed 年底前還會升息一次；此前該行預估 Fed 將維持利率不變。
展望 2027 年，德國商業銀行認為，美國及歐元區的升息預期都可能下修，但美元承受的壓力將更大，歐元兌美元可望逐步回升。
該行預期 Fed 今年 12 月升息後，利率將維持至 2027 年底，同時認為若中東危機逐漸緩和、通膨衝擊消退，Fed 在 2027 年底前也有降息的可能；白宮對 Fed 獨立性的影響，則是美元的另一項壓力來源。

日元方面，MUFG 預期日本央行將在 2027 年 1 月及 6 月再度升息，使政策利率升至 1.75%。因此，雖然美元兌日元短期可能續漲，後續升息及匯市干預風險仍會限制漲幅；該行預期，匯價在突破 160 日元前，買盤就可能減弱。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley’s foreign‑exchange strategy team publicly admitted a forecasting error in a recent research report, stating that the reasons for a short position on the dollar no longer exist and simultaneously raised its year‑end to 2027 targets for the dollar index and major currencies.

The dollar index (DXY), which measures the dollar against a basket of major currencies, has recently surged, climbing to around 101 this week and setting a new high for nearly eight weeks. While a stronger dollar boosts the purchasing power of U.S. consumers abroad, it also raises the cost of U.S. exports. President Trump recently voiced concerns about the excessive depreciation of the yen during a meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.
Led by David S. Adams, the Morgan Stanley FX team admitted, “We were wrong!”

The team had previously expected the dollar to continue falling in the second half of the year, bottoming out by year‑end and strengthening by 2027, based on assumptions that U.S. and global interest‑rate spreads would narrow, the Fed would pause rate hikes while other central banks would catch up.

However, persistently high energy prices and robust U.S. economic data have prompted the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) to adopt a hawkish stance, greatly increasing the likelihood of further U.S. rate hikes.

CME FedWatch futures data show that the market now assigns a 68.6% probability to a 25‑basis‑point hike at the October meeting (raising the policy range to 4.00%–4.25%) and more than 50% probability of another 25‑basis‑point hike in December.
Morgan Stanley notes that there remains substantial room for the market to further lift rate‑hike expectations, which would provide solid support for the dollar.
In response to changing fundamentals, Morgan Stanley has fully revised its dollar targets:

The year‑end DXY forecast has been sharply raised from 96 to 102; the EUR/USD forecast has been lowered from 1.20 to 1.12; the GBP/USD forecast has been lowered from 1.38 to 1.30; and the USD/JPY forecast has been raised from 157 to 159.

Looking ahead to mid‑2027, as European political and fiscal concerns resurface, the dollar index is expected to rise to 104, with the euro potentially softening further to 1.10. In trading terms, the team recommends taking a long position at USD/JPY 158 with a target of 163 and a stop‑loss at 150.
Nonetheless, Morgan Stanley issued several risk warnings.

First, the dollar’s recent strength is mainly focused on countering low‑rate currencies such as the yen, euro, and Swiss franc, while commodity currencies like the AUD and NOK will remain relatively strong.
Second, some depreciation expectations are already reflected in market option prices, so the upside may be limited.
Finally, political and policy shocks—such as tariff announcements or foreign‑exchange interventions—could trigger chain stop‑loss selling of dollar long positions.
In fact, it is not only Morgan Stanley; other investment banks are also bullish on the dollar.

German commercial bank analyst Thu Lan Nguyen noted that the Fed’s unanimous rate hike in September temporarily restored market confidence in its policy credibility and supported the dollar. The bank therefore lowered its year‑end EUR/USD forecast from 1.17 to 1.15 and expects another Fed hike before year‑end, after previously predicting a pause.

Looking to 2027, the German commercial bank believes that U.S. and euro‑area rate‑hike expectations may be cut, but the dollar will face greater pressure, and the euro may gradually recover against the dollar.

The bank expects the Fed to keep rates unchanged after the December 2023 hike until the end of 2027, and if the Middle‑East crisis eases and inflationary shocks subside, the Fed could also cut rates before the end of 2027; the White House’s influence on Fed independence is another pressure source for the dollar.
(Duplicate paragraph 18 and 19 omitted for brevity)

MUFG’s September 18 report stated that Fed hikes and hawkish signals support the dollar, while the Bank of Japan’s post‑hike stance fell short of market expectations, leaving short‑term upside for USD/JPY. However, MUFG did not significantly raise its dollar forecast, still projecting a 4.2% decline in the DXY by Q2 2027 from the report’s level, as other G10 central banks may continue to hike, potentially preventing spreads from widening favorably for the dollar.

Regarding the yen, MUFG expects the Bank of Japan to hike again in January and June 2027, raising the policy rate to 1.75%. Thus, while USD/JPY may continue to rise in the short term, subsequent hikes and intervention risk will likely cap gains; the bank expects buying pressure to weaken before the 160‑yen breakout.
